title: Systems Engineer, Browser Isolation
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Locations: </strong>Austin, TX (US)</p> <p><strong>About the team</strong></p> <p><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/zero-trust/products/browser-isolation/">Cloudflare Browser Isolation</a> runs web content in remote browsers, helping protect users from threats while preserving a responsive browsing experience. Our team builds the Chromium-based browsing engine, remote rendering and streaming technology, and distributed services that manage browser sessions across Cloudflare’s global network.</p> <p>You will work at the intersection of systems programming, distributed systems, and security. Engineers contribute across the product, collaborating on browser changes, service orchestration, observability, and build infrastructure.</p> <p><strong>Scope and growth</strong></p> <p>At this level, you will be accountable for reliable delivery within a defined component or problem area. You will make sound implementation decisions, seek help when needed, and build broader system knowledge over time. You do not need to have led an organization-wide architecture effort to succeed in this role.</p> <p><strong>Technologies we use</strong></p> <ul> <li>Browser engine: Chromium and C++.</li> <li>Systems programming: Rust.</li> <li>Distributed services and orchestration: Go, TypeScript, Cloudflare Workers, Nomad, and Consul.</li> <li>Remote rendering and streaming: WebRTC and Skia.</li> <li>Browser client: TypeScript, WebAssembly, and WebGL.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What you will do</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own well-scoped features and improvements from design and implementation through testing, rollout, and production follow-up, with support from experienced teammates.</li> <li>Develop and maintain C++ code in our Chromium-based browser, and contribute across distributed services and systems components written in Go, Rust, and TypeScript.</li> <li>Debug failures across browser processes, Linux hosts, and distributed services using logs, metrics, traces, and profiling tools.</li> <li>Improve session reliability, startup time, interactive latency, and resource efficiency; validate improvements with measurements.</li> <li>Write maintainable code, automated tests, and clear design notes; participate in constructive code and design reviews.</li> <li>Collaborate with teammates and partner teams, communicate trade-offs and blockers, and incorporate feedback.</li> <li>Participate in the team’s production on-call rotation after onboarding, and contribute to incident mitigation and follow-up improvements.</li> </ul> <p>This role may require flexibility to be on-call outside of standard working hours to address technical issues as needed.</p> <p><strong>Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience delivering and maintaining production software, with practical C++ proficiency and an understanding of memory ownership, resource lifetimes, and concurrency.</li> <li>Linux/UNIX fundamentals, including processes, threads, networking, and tools for diagnosing system behavior.</li> <li>Working knowledge of data structures, algorithms, and software design.</li> <li>Experience developing or operating distributed systems, with an understanding of service-to-service communication, timeouts, retries, partial failure, and basic consistency trade-offs.</li> <li>Ability to navigate an unfamiliar codebase, break a defined problem into deliverable steps, and test correctness and failure cases.</li> <li>A systematic approach to debugging and performance analysis, using evidence to form and test hypotheses.</li> <li>Clear communication, collaborative problem-solving, and a willingness to learn Rust, Go, TypeScript, and the rest of our stack.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Bonus Points</strong></p> <p>These are preferred qualifications, not prerequisites. Prior Browser Isolation or Cloudflare experience is not required.</p> <ul> <li>Browser engines, Chromium, browser sandboxing, or security-sensitive systems.</li> <li>Low-latency streaming, graphics, remote computing, or other real-time systems.</li> <li>Container and workload orchestration, including Nomad or Kubernetes, and service discovery.</li> <li>Experience using Rust for systems programming or distributed services.</li> <li>Go or TypeScript; WebRTC, Skia, WebAssembly, or WebGL.</li> <li>Production observability, capacity planning, incident response, or build and release infrastructure.</li> </ul> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual</span> <span style="font-weight: 400;">race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.  If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">hr@cloudflare.com</span><span style="font-weight: 400;"> or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.</span></p></div>

title: Senior Odoo Engineer ERP & E-Commerce (all genders)
description: Introduction Do you want to do more than just maintain an ERP system—do you want to help shape its future? As a Senior Odoo Engineer for ERP & E-Commerce (all genders), you’ll take responsibility for our Odoo platform—the system that powers sales, order processing, logistics, and accounting. You’ll further develop our in-house modules, continue the migration to the Odoo standard, integrate new countries, standardize payment processes, and build our new online store—ensuring it’s fully upgradeable, with streamlined workflows and genuine creative freedom. Your mission The focus is on further developing our Odoo platform—which includes approximately 25 in-house modules—and upgrading it to the target version. In doing so, you’ll rely on an upgrade-friendly architecture based on inheritance rather than modifications to the Odoo core Another key focus of your work will be migrating existing processes to the Odoo standard and integrating new countries—including localization, accounting, and country-specific requirements You’ll ensure seamless and efficient payment processes by integrating PSP connections, SEPA direct debit, and PSD2/SCA, and by managing the interfaces with adjacent systems Together with the relevant stakeholders, you’ll implement our new, mobile-friendly website and online store based on Odoo E-Commerce You ensure code quality and testability, document architecture and design decisions, and provide technical guidance to development partners Your profile You have several years of experience in Odoo development with Python and have implemented your own modules from requirements to go-live You have worked with Odoo Enterprise in production environments—including Odoo.sh—for several years and are proficient with Git in professional development and deployment processes For you, Odoo is not just a configuration tool: ORM, inheritance, Views, and QWeb, access rights, and cron jobs are all part of your skill set—ideally complemented by Odoo E-Commerce You confidently analyze existing software, refactor it strategically, and further develop it with a focus on quality, maintainability, and stability Experience with Odoo upgrades, data migrations, multi-company setups, or integrating payment service providers is a definite plus You work in a structured and independent manner, document clearly, and communicate on an equal footing in German and English Why us? Work Environment & Organization: You enjoy working in our Munich office and value face-to-face interaction with your team. In addition, you can work from home one day a week. You’ll have the freedom to manage your own schedule within the framework of our operational requirements. Workation: Upon agreement, up to 4 weeks of EU workation per year are possible. If you choose Fuerteventura, we’ll also cover your flight, accommodations, and rental car. Freedom & Responsibility: With us, you’ll take on responsibility, actively contribute your ideas, and work in an environment with short decision-making paths and no rigid processes. Modern Office: Look forward to an ergonomic workspace in Munich with a height-adjustable desk, plenty of greenery from plants, an open atmosphere, and short decision-making paths. Attractive Benefits: Monthly deposits to your EmployeeCARD, subsidies for cell phone and internet service, bike leasing, car subscription, retirement savings, and more . Please note: The application process is coordinated centrally by the ValueNet Group. Embracing Diversity Together At ValueNet, we actively promote diversity and equal opportunity. We invite people from all backgrounds to apply—regardless of race, nationality, religion, beliefs, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, or disability. Diversity enriches our team and creates space for innovation and shared success. Values that bring us together For ValueNet, sustainability is more than just a word—it is an integral part of our actions, our products, and our services. Enthusiasm, trust, courage, and responsibility shape our culture. We are actively committed to fostering an inclusive environment that respects each individual’s uniqueness and strengthens our shared goals. title: Senior Backend Engineer (f/m/d)
description: Our Opportunity Over the past three years, Predium has built the leading real estate intelligence platform for ESG and value management in the DACH region - with the strongest names in the industry as customers: asset managers, housing companies, banks. Our customer base, our data, our credibility - that's valuable capital for the next step. Investment, credit, and asset management decisions in real estate are still made in Excel, case by case. We're now building the AI analyst that takes this work off people's hands - working directly on the customer's own data, scalable without adding headcount. We're well-funded, and we're bringing AI into real estate. Your Mission As a Senior Backend Engineer, you own the systems behind our platform: the GraphQL API, the relational data model, the background processing that turns customer documents and spreadsheets into structured data, and the permission model that lets a single owner and a bank with hundreds of portfolios use the same product. Most of your work runs from schema design all the way to the resolver. You partner with product, design and other engineers to make sure we build what matters - not just what you have been told to do. You take real responsibility for production: when something is slow, you find out why, whether the answer is a bad query, application code or the infrastructure underneath. You also help us make AI reliable in production. Document extraction, long-running analysis jobs and agentic features are core to where the product is going, and we need people who make these workflows testable and dependable rather than impressive in a demo. Our company size of ~40 people ensures that the best idea wins and political discussions are kept aside. And every line of code helps to improve the carbon footprint of real estate properties. Tech stack: TypeScript (NestJS backend, React frontend), Hasura/GraphQL, PostgreSQL (multiple databases incl. PostGIS), queue-based job processing, AWS (ECS / Elastic Beanstalk, S3, SES, Textract), IaC, Claude but all agents welcome What you'll own Build features across our Hasura GraphQL API, NestJS and Postgres. From schema design to resolver. Model complex real estate and ESG domains in relational schemas. We run several Postgres databases side by side (one of them geospatial), and schema decisions here have consequences but also positive impact. Own background processing: Excel imports, document extraction, long-running analysis jobs, 3D and image processing. Queues, retries, jobs that spawn other jobs - and figuring out what to do when step 3 of 7 fails at 2am. Develop our permission model. Customers range from a single owner to enterprises with organization/portfolio/building-level access. Integrate LLMs into backend workflows - especially document and data extraction - and make them reliable, verifyable and testable. Debug production. Navigate Grafana dashboards and traces to find out why something is slow or failing, whether in the app, the CI/build pipeline or the infrastructure. Spot overgrown or overly complex parts of the codebase and simplify them without being asked. Paying down complexity is part of the job. What success looks like You have shipped features end-to-end across schema, API and background processing that our customers actively use. Our async processing (imports, extraction, analysis jobs) is measurably more robust: fewer silent failures, clear retry and recovery paths, and observability that tells us what broke and why. You have taken ownership of at least one core area e.g. the permission model, the job orchestration layer or the LLM extraction pipeline and are the person the team goes to for it. You have raised the bar on testing and developer experience in the backend, and other engineers ship faster because of you. You are a trusted sparring partner for product and the team when we decide what to build and how. What it takes You're strong with Postgres. Schema design comes naturally, you can read a query plan, and you know when the ORM is lying to you. Geospatial experience is a bonus, not a requirement. You're fluent in typed backend TypeScript. We work in NestJS and GraphQL every day; if your experience is in a comparable stack, that's fine, you'll pick it up fast. You've built real queue-based processing. You designed workers, dealt with retries and partial failures, orchestrated multi-step workflows. You've designed or worked with authorization for a multi-tenant product and know where it might get hairy. You'd rather have one integration test that hits a real database schema than ten unit tests mocking everything. You write the test that catches the broken migration. You treat production as a debuggable system. You can navigate dashboards and traces to figure out why something is slow, and you don't treat infrastructure as someone else's problem. You communicate clearly - with engineers, product and, when needed, directly with customers. You speak German at C1 level or better and English fluently. Our customers are German banks and asset managers, and you will talk to them. Bonus: AWS (S3, SES, ECS, RDS, …) and IaC. LLMs in production, especially document or data extraction and making it reliable for actual user workflows. Data pipeline work: staged, reproducible processing, dataset versioning. Mentoring or leading engineers, or wanting to grow into it. Debugging tooling and build issues, not just application code. Our toolchain moves fast and is occasionally non-standard. Why Predium? Stage: ~40 people, well-funded, on the way to defining the category. Early enough that a lot still needs to be built. Yes, it's messy sometimes - that's the whole point. If you're looking for a job with a finished playbook, this isn't the right fit. Impact: You're not cog #100 in some company. What you build here runs in production and is what customers rely on every day. Your contribution shows up directly, in revenue and in the product. Ownership: We don't manage your time, we measure your results. You get responsibility and freedom - and the expectation that you'll use both. Compensation: Competitive salary, bonus, and equity. We want you to share in the success you help create. Team: Office-first in Munich's Werksviertel, 4 days/week. 30 vacation days (including company vacation) · Wellpass · Deutschland-Ticket · Jobrad · team events Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Business Analyst
description: <h3>🧡 About Alma</h3> <p>At Alma, we believe sustainable commerce depends on fair, well-balanced trade. It brings together Marketing, Partnerships, Sales and Account Management, representing more than 100 talented professionals.</p> <p>Revenue Operations plays a key role in helping these teams work together around shared goals, reliable data and efficient processes. growth opportunities and improve their speed and efficiency.</p> <p>You will work at the intersection of data, business and strategy, turning complex questions into clear recommendations and practical tools.</p> <h4>Build reliable data foundations for Revenue</h4> <ul> <li>Build and evolve business-facing data models by combining relevant CRM, revenue and operational data sources.</li> <li>Improve and maintain existing models and contribute to reliable end-to-end data pipelines.</li> </ul> <h4>Turn business questions into strategic insights</h4> <ul> <li>Analyse Alma's target markets, market share, market dynamics and the key drivers behind commercial wins.</li> <li>Design ad hoc tools and models to help Revenue teams answer tactical business questions and make faster decisions.</li> </ul> <h4>Improve performance monitoring and revenue growth</h4> <ul> <li>Build and manage dashboards, KPIs and revenue forecasts so teams and leadership can monitor business health and progress against their goals.</li> <li>Support Revenue leaders in setting the right targets, understanding growth dynamics and prioritising their roadmap.</li> </ul> <h4>Drive data excellence across Revenue</h4> <ul> <li>Promote data-informed ways of working across Marketing, Partnerships, Sales and Account Management.</li> <li>Collaborate closely with the Central Data Team to maintain high standards of data quality and consistency across the organisation.</li> </ul> <h3>🧰 You will work with</h3> <p>SQL, Looker, LookML, Claude Code, Python, dbt, BigQuery, GCP, Rudderstack, Segment, Salesforce</p> <h3>🧩 About you</h3> <h4>To succeed in this job</h4> <ul> <li>You have strong SQL skills and are comfortable working with large datasets, raw CRM data and revenue-related information, including Salesforce data.</li> <li>You have experience building business-facing data models, dashboards, forecasts or performance analyses from the initial question through to clear recommendations.</li> <li>You can define relevant KPIs, assess business impact and communicate complex analysis in a clear and actionable way to different stakeholders.</li> <li>You have approximately 4 to 7 years of experience in data analysis, business analysis or a similar role, ideally in a fast-growing technology or fintech environment.</li> </ul> <h4>And it will be nice if you also</h4> <ul> <li>You have experience with Looker and LookML.</li> <li>You are comfortable with Python and modern data tools such as dbt, BigQuery or GCP.</li> <li>You have worked with tracking tools such as We value potential, curiosity and the ability to grow as much as experience.</p> <h3>🧘 Your Alma experience</h3> <h4>The culture</h4> <p>At Alma, collective intelligence is at the heart of the way we work. We are building an international company in a fast-growing environment, where people are encouraged to take ownership, share ideas and learn from one another.</p> <p>You will have access to our Learning & Development Platform, regular feedback and opportunities to develop your expertise and career path. As Alma continues to grow across Europe, you will have the opportunity to work with colleagues from different teams, countries and areas of expertise.</p> <p>We are committed to building a fair and inclusive workplace. We monitor our gender equality index and remain committed to pay equity, transparency and equal opportunities across the organisation.</p> <h4>The role itself</h4> <p>If you join Alma, you will be able to grow and have an impact by:</p> <ul> <li>Influencing strategic decisions across the full Revenue organisation, from lead generation to churn.</li> <li>Combining analytical depth, business understanding and direct exposure to senior stakeholders.</li> <li>Helping Revenue teams build a stronger data culture and create more efficient ways of working as Alma scales across Europe.</li> </ul> <h3>🤑 Compensation & benefits</h3> <ul> <li><strong>Competitive salary</strong> based on 12 months</li> <li><strong>Profit-sharing and employee savings plan</strong></li> <li><strong>Health insurance</strong>: <strong>100%</strong> covered by Alma, including family package</li> <li><strong>Disability insurance</strong>: <strong>100%</strong> covered by Alma</li> <li><strong>Sport</strong>: partnerships with <strong>Gymlib</strong> and <strong>ClassPass</strong>, or <strong>€30/month</strong> reimbursement for your sports activities</li> <li><strong>Maternity/paternity leave</strong>: salary maintained at 100% during leave, with no seniority requirement. title: Talent Acquisition Manager

You will manage recruitment processes end-to-end, from understanding the hiring need and identifying the right sourcing strategy to interviewing candidates, managing the selection process and closing the hire. A significant part of your activity will involve recruiting technical and highly specialized profiles, including Software Engineers, AI and Research profiles, Infrastructure experts, senior technical specialists and, depending on business needs, leadership and C-level positions. You will work with a wide variety of stakeholders across the company: experienced hiring managers, technical experts, senior leaders and managers who may need more guidance throughout the recruitment process. Being able to adapt your approach, challenge when necessary and keep recruitment processes moving will therefore be an important part of your role. You will join a collaborative Talent Acquisition team composed of a Talent Acquisition Team Lead, another Talent Acquisition Manager and an HR team member combining recruitment with broader HR projects, within the HR department. We are looking for someone who is already comfortable managing recruitment independently, while remaining curious and eager to learn, develop their expertise and adopt our recruitment practices. Recruit across a variety of roles, with a strong focus on technical and complex profiles , including senior Software Engineers, AI/Research profiles, Infrastructure specialists, technical leadership and other hard-to-find profiles. Take ownership of direct sourcing and headhunting , identifying and engaging passive candidates rather than relying primarily on inbound applications. Build relevant talent pools and continuously explore new sourcing channels, tools and approaches. Conduct structured interviews to assess candidates' experience, skills, motivations and potential fit with the role and environment. Provide hiring managers with clear, fact-based candidate assessments and recommendations throughout the selection process. Manage candidate communication throughout the recruitment journey and contribute to a professional, transparent and engaging candidate experience. Adapt your way of working to different stakeholders, from very experienced senior leaders to managers who require more support in structuring their recruitment process. Keep our ATS and recruitment data accurate and up to date and contribute to the monitoring of key recruitment indicators. Share market insights with the team and hiring managers, including candidate availability, compensation expectations, competitive dynamics and sourcing challenges. Contribute to continuous improvement projects within Talent Acquisition, such as sourcing practices, interview methodologies, candidate experience, automation, documentation and recruitment processes. Work closely with the rest of the Talent Acquisition and HR team, sharing knowledge, candidates, sourcing techniques and best practices. What we are looking for You already have a first solid experience in Talent Acquisition, ideally around 3 to 5 years, either in-house or in a recruitment agency/search environment. You are able to manage a recruitment process independently from initial briefing to hire, while knowing when to ask for input or collaborate with the team. You have already recruited technical and/or particularly complex profiles. Previous exposure to Software Engineering, AI/Data, Infrastructure, Research or senior technical positions would be particularly relevant. You are comfortable working on senior and hard-to-find profiles and understand that some searches require persistence, creativity and a highly targeted approach. Direct sourcing is part of your recruiter DNA: you are comfortable approaching passive candidates and using tools and techniques such as LinkedIn Recruiter, Boolean searches, talent mapping and other relevant sourcing channels. You are comfortable interacting with stakeholders at different levels of seniority, including senior leaders and C-level executives, and can adapt your communication and level of guidance accordingly. You know how to manage several recruitment processes simultaneously, prioritize effectively and maintain momentum even when working with busy stakeholders. You combine autonomy with a strong team mindset: you take ownership of your searches but naturally share information, help colleagues and contribute to collective recruitment goals. You are curious and eager to keep developing your recruitment expertise. You already have strong foundations, but you are still keen to learn new approaches, tools and practices. You have strong interpersonal and communication skills and care about building high-quality relationships with both candidates and hiring managers. Ability to build, manage and improve recruitment dashboards would be a strong plus for this role. You are fluent in French and English, both written and spoken. Spanish would be a strong plus, as would experience recruiting across several European or international markets. What's in it for you A structured onboarding program to discover our product, technology, teams and culture. The opportunity to work on challenging searches across Software Engineering, AI, Infrastructure, Product, business and leadership roles. Exposure to an international environment and stakeholders across multiple countries. A Talent Acquisition team where you can operate autonomously while continuing to learn and develop your expertise. description: <div class="content-intro"><div class="p-rich_text_section">Bloomreach is building the world’s premier <strong data-stringify-type="bold">agentic platform for personalization</strong>.We’re revolutionizing how businesses connect with their customers, building and deploying AI agents to personalize the <strong data-stringify-type="bold"><em data-stringify-type="italic">entire</em></strong> customer journey.</div> <ul class="p-rich_text_list p-rich_text_list__bullet p-rich_text_list--nested" data-stringify-type="unordered-list" data-list-tree="true" data-indent="0" data-border="0"> <li data-stringify-indent="0" data-stringify-border="0">We're taking <strong data-stringify-type="bold">autonomous search</strong> mainstream, making product discovery more intuitive and conversational for customers, and more profitable for businesses.</li> <li data-stringify-indent="0" data-stringify-border="0">We’re making <strong data-stringify-type="bold">conversational shopping</strong> a reality, connecting every shopper with tailored guidance and product expertise — available on demand, at every touchpoint in their journey.</li> <li data-stringify-indent="0" data-stringify-border="0">We're designing the future of <strong data-stringify-type="bold">autonomous marketing</strong>, taking the work out of workflows, and reclaiming the creative, strategic, and customer-first work marketers were always meant to do.</li> </ul> <div class="p-rich_text_section">And we're building all of that on the intelligence of a single AI engine — <strong data-stringify-type="bold">Loomi </strong>— so that personalization isn't only autonomous…it's also consistent.From retail to financial services, hospitality to gaming, businesses use Bloomreach to drive higher growth and lasting loyalty. We power personalization for more than 1,400 global brands, including American Eagle, Sonepar, and Pandora.</div></div><div class="section global-width"> <div class="block"> <div class="block-wrapper in our London/Amsterdam office 3-4 times per week. </p> <p>We’ve asked our <strong>current sales people to tell us what they like about their job with Bloomreach,</strong> and this is what they told title: Senior Planning Manager
description: <p><strong><span style="text-decoration: underline;">About The Team:</span></strong></p> <p>The Planning team is the most data-driven team at HelloFresh: we plan, schedule and analyse the production of every box, and start the process of feeding the UK. With hundreds of thousands of customers relying on us to get the plan right, this is a role with real ownership and real impact.</p> <p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>What You Will Be Doing:</strong></span></p> <p>Reporting into the site leadership, you'll own the production plan for the UK in its entirety, and lead the planning team. This is a role for someone who wants to build and elevate: to take a team through a step change in maturity, drive it to operate at its full potential, and make the plan as efficient and optimised as it can be. In your first year you will:</p> <ul> <li>Own the UK production plan end to end, working daily with the site director to balance efficiency, plan attainment, minimised downtime and flexibility.</li> <li>Own the planning structure for the site, and take full responsibility for scale hiring of our operational workforce, assessing labour requirements continuously.</li> <li>Own the ramp and the seasonal calendar, planning ahead rather than reacting to it.</li> <li>Lead, coach and elevate the planning team, the CS4 Planning Manager and the planning executives, holding them to the level their roles are set at and developing them towards it.</li> <li>Continuously improve the planning strategy, using data and feedback to adapt to changing business needs.</li> <li>Work closely with BI, Operations and wider stakeholders to automate processes, refine planning tools, and move work that shouldn't sit with the team away from it.</li> <li>Generate and analyse weekly and monthly KPIs across operational planning, identify trends and issues, and drive cost-saving initiatives.</li> <li>Own compliance for the team across Food Safety, Health & Safety and applicable standards (e.g. BRCGS, ISO).</li> </ul> <p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>Who You Are:</strong></span></p> <ul> <li>A strong background in production or labour planning, with proven experience forecasting labour and production needs.</li> <li>Real people-leadership experience: you've managed a team and coached individuals through their development, and you know how to raise a team's performance.</li> <li>A strong technical skillset, advanced in Excel and Google Sheets, with an understanding of AI and how to apply it to planning.</li> <li>Long-term orientation above all: you plan and build for the future rather than firefight, and hold a clear view of where the team and the plan need to be.</li> <li>Data-driven, with the analytical depth to base decisions on fact rather than instinct.</li> <li>A strong advocate for your team, able to protect and develop them while raising the bar.</li> <li>A degree in supply chain management or a related field is preferable.</li> </ul> <p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>What you will get in return:</strong></span></p> <p>● 70% off HelloFresh or Green Chef boxes<br>● Company pension scheme<br>● Gym membership<br>● Bupa private medical insurance (including dental & family cover options)<br>● Mental health first aiders and an employee assistance programme<br>● Nursery support scheme<br>● Cycle to work scheme<br>● Group Life Assurance</p> <p><strong>Location</strong>: The Windmill, Unit 2 SmartParc, Derby, DE21 7HW</p> <p><strong>To be considered for this role, you’ll need to have the independent right to work in the UK, as we're unfortunately unable to provide sponsorship at this time.</strong></p> <p><strong data-stringify-type="bold">Hybrid Working Policy</strong><br>We offer a hybrid working policy for eligible roles, allowing flexibility to work from home and in the office. For more details on eligibility and how this applies to the role you're applying for, please consult with your recruiter.</p> <p><strong>Next steps</strong>: Your application will be reviewed and if successful, a member of the Talent Acquisition Team will be in touch within 2 weeks.</p> <p>You are required to cooperate with HelloFresh in all health and safety matters. You are responsible for ensuring you take reasonable care of your own health, and safety as well as others who may be affected by the work activities you undertake. You must report incidents immediately and actively raise health and safety-related concerns to your Line Manager. As part of our commitment to maintaining a safe and secure environment, we will process Disclosure and Barring Service (<span class="il">DBS</span>) checks to the successful individual. Failure to disclose relevant information at application or throughout the process could affect your employment with the company. </p> <p>If you are currently a HelloFresh employee, please make sure you have discussed your application with your Line Manager.</p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>Welcome to Planet. We believe in using space to help life on Earth.</strong></p> <p>Planet designs, builds, and operates the largest constellation of imaging satellites in history. This constellation delivers an unprecedented dataset of empirical information via a revolutionary cloud-based platform to authoritative figures in commercial, environmental, and humanitarian sectors. We are both a space company and data company all rolled into one.</p> <p>Customers and users across the globe use Planet's data to develop new technologies, drive revenue, power research, and solve our world’s toughest obstacles.</p> <p>As we control every component of hardware design, manufacturing, data processing, and software engineering, our office is a truly inspiring mix of experts from a variety of domains.</p> <p>We have a people-centric approach toward culture and community and we strive to iterate in a way that puts our team members first and prepares our company for growth. Join Planet and be a part of our mission to change the way people see the world.</p> <p>Planet is a global company with employees working remotely world wide and joining us from offices in San Francisco, Washington DC, Germany, Austria, Slovenia, and The Netherlands.</p></div><p><strong>About the Role:  </strong></p> <p>We are looking for a Senior Reliability Engineer with focus on Identity and Access Management (IAM) to join the Corporate Engineering team. As an SRE together with other engineers you will be responsible for the continuous operation, further development and enhancement of Planet’s corporate infrastructure and applications, acting as the technical authority for our enterprise identity ecosystem. </p> <p>This is a full-time, hybrid role which will require you to work from our Berlin, Haarlem or Ljubljana office 3 days per week.</p> <p><strong>Impact You’ll Own:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Help to ensure the operation of Planet’s internal IT systems, specifically architecting and maintaining our identity providers (Okta, Auth0, Keycloak).</li> <li>Improve existing and create new solutions by engineering automated zero-day Joiner, Mover, and Leaver (JML) workflows directly from our HRIS (e.g., HiBob).</li> <li>Scripting & Tooling: Use Python or Go to automate repetitive tasks, build custom provisioning connectors for legacy applications, and enforce identity data minimization.</li> <li>Identify and reduce operational toil through automation, making our systems self-healing and predictable.</li> <li>Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Leverage APIs, Terraform, Ansible, or SaltStack to manage configurations as code, moving away from manual UI/CLI changes across our identity platforms.</li> <li>Participate in an on-call rotation and drive the continuous improvement of incident response, root cause analysis (RCA), and post-mortem processes for complex authentication failures.</li> <li>Collaborate closely with Security and other IT teams to embed reliability, scalability, and security best practices from the ground up, ensuring our identity architecture complies with GDPR and Zero Trust principles.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What You Bring:</strong></p> <ul> <li>6+ years experience in infrastructure development and/or operations, with a dedicated focus on Identity and Access Management.</li> <li data-path-to-node="2,1,0">Bachelor’s degree in a related field or equivalent professional experience.</li> <li data-path-to-node="2,1,0">Expertise with a scripting language like Python.</li> <li>Track record of working with large web applications or computer clusters and managing complex identity architectures (Okta, Auth0, Keycloak).</li> <li>Experience integrating HR Information Systems with identity directories and handling complex edge cases (re-hires, cross-border transfers).</li> <li>Solid understanding of Network principles and operations alongside modern identity protocols (OAuth 2.0, OIDC, SAML, SCIM).</li> <li>Practical understanding of PKI, certificate lifecycles (S/MIME, X.509), and managing legacy directories like Active Directory.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What Makes You Stand Out:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Operational experience in deploying and maintaining databases.</li> <li>Experience using Docker, ECS or Linux Containers in a production environment.</li> <li>Awareness of best practices about systems security and defensive programming</li> <li>Experience with version control e.g. Git.</li> <li>Experience in deploying and maintaining virtual machines e.g. KVM, ProxMox.</li> <li>Experience in software development using CI/CD processes and tools e.g. Jenkins, GitLab.</li> <li>Experience with Access Control systems, e. g. Avigilon, Verkada or dormakaba.</li> <li>Experience with  Public Key Infrastructure (PKI) and deployment automation, renewal, and revocation of personal S/MIME certificates.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Application Deadline:</strong></p> <p>11:45p / 23:45 CET on the date stated below. Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis. This posting may be removed earlier than projected if a suitable pool of applications has been received. For this reason, we recommend applying as soon as you are able to.</p> <p><strong>Export Control Requirements:</strong></p> <p><em>Planet Labs Germany GmbH is authorized to receive U.S. export-controlled information at Planet under an export license issued by the Bureau of Industry and Security. This position requires access to export-controlled information, and as such, employment (or hiring of a contractor) is contingent upon the candidate’s ability to access all applicable export-controlled information without additional export licensing being required by the Bureau of Industry and Security and/or the Directorate of Defense Trade Controls.</em></p> <p><strong>Benefits While Working at Planet:</strong></p> <p><em>These offerings are dependent on employment type and geographical location, based upon applicable law or company policy.</em></p> <ul> <li>Paid time off including vacation, holidays and company-wide days off </li> <li>Employee Wellness Program </li> <li>Home Office Reimbursement</li> <li>Monthly Phone and Internet Reimbursement</li> <li>Tuition Reimbursement and access to LinkedIn Learning</li> <li>Equity </li> <li>Volunteering Paid Time Off</li> </ul> <p><strong>Compensation:</strong></p> <p>The expected starting gross salary range for this role is listed below. Individual placement within this range is determined objectively based on gender-neutral criteria such as your skills, qualifications, and professional experience. This position may also be eligible for discretionary bonuses and/or equity.</p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="title">Netherlands Salary Range</div><div class="pay-range"><span>€75.000</span><span class="divider">—</span><span>€93.700 EUR</span></div></div></div><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance<br></strong>Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.<strong><br></strong></p> <p><strong>Why we care so much about Belonging. <br></strong>We’re dedicated to helping the whole Planet, and to do that we must strive to represent all of it within each of our offices and on all of our teams. That’s why Planet is guided by an ultimate north star of Belonging—dreaming big as we approach our ongoing work.  If this job intrigues you, but you’re thinking you might not have all the qualifications, please... do apply!  At Planet, we are looking for well-rounded people from around the world who can contribute to more ways than just what is listed in this job description.  We don’t just fill positions, we aspire to fulfill people’s careers, most excited about folks who are motivated by our underlying humanitarian efforts.  We are a few orbits around the sun before we get to where we want to be, so we hope you’re excited to come along for the ride. </p> <p><strong>EEO statement: <br></strong>Planet is committed to building a community where everyone belongs and we invite people from all backgrounds to apply. title: Senior Solutions Architect | Netherlands | Remote
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at <u><span><a href="http://grafana.com" target="_blank">grafana.com</a></span></u> and follow us on <u><span><a href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/grafana-labs/" target="_blank">LinkedIn</a></span></u> and <u><span><a href="https://twitter.com/grafana" target="_blank">X</a></span></u><u>.</u></p> <p>We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.</p> <p>You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.</p></div><div> <div> <div> <p data-start="239" data-end="573"><strong>The Opportunity:</strong></p> <p data-start="239" data-end="573">We’re looking for a <strong>Senior </strong><strong data-start="259" data-end="306">Solutions Architect (Professional Services)</strong> to join Grafana Labs’ world-class Customer Experience team. This is a highly hands-on role for technically skilled professionals who thrive on helping customers solve complex problems, accelerate adoption, and drive real business outcomes with Grafana at the center.</p> <p data-start="575" data-end="930">As a Solutions Architect, you’ll be a <strong data-start="613" data-end="642">trusted technical partner</strong>—not a quota-carrying seller, but a customer-first advocate who leads with authenticity and insight. You’ll guide organizations through onboarding, implementation, and expansion by offering white-glove support, best practices, and proven strategies gathered from across our customer base.</p> <p data-start="932" data-end="1337">You’ll operate with one foot in the code and the other in the customer’s world. Whether it’s understanding container orchestration in Kubernetes, fine-tuning Prometheus queries, or clarifying the nuances between logs, metrics, and traces—you’ll bring clarity and confidence to complex technical landscapes. You know the difference between "pets and cattle" and why that matters for scalable observability.</p> <p data-start="1339" data-end="1823">You’ll deliver high-impact training, jumpstart engagements, and offer tailored technical consulting to help customers succeed. As an embedded partner during critical phases, you’ll provide roadmap assurance, guide project execution, and ensure Grafana's capabilities align with the customer’s architecture, goals, and constraints. Along the way, you’ll identify recurring issues, monitor support needs, and advocate for product improvements in close collaboration with internal teams.</p> <p data-start="1825" data-end="2086">Success in this role means being a strategic thinker <strong data-start="1878" data-end="1885">and</strong> a command-line problem solver. title: Praktikant Operations & Growth (m/w/d)
description: Über uns Über 5 Millionen Menschen in Deutschland sind pflegebedürftig, und jedes Jahr werden es mehr. Ihnen stehen Leistungen zu, die oft nie ankommen, weil Formulare, Zuständigkeiten und Behördensprache dazwischenstehen. Jeden Fall einzeln zu prüfen und bis zur Entscheidung zu begleiten, war bisher zu aufwendig. Mit KI geht das zum ersten Mal für viele Familien gleichzeitig. Genau das macht Decari: Wir prüfen, welche Leistungen infrage kommen, etwa ein höherer Pflegegrad, Hilfe zur Pflege oder Eingliederungshilfe, und begleiten die Anträge bis zur Entscheidung. Pflegedienste in mehreren Bundesländern arbeiten bereits mit uns. Unser Ziel: Jede Familie in Deutschland bekommt die Pflegeleistungen, die ihr zusteht. Wir sind ein kleines, AI-natives Team mit Erfahrung aus der Versicherungs- und Pflegebranche. Wir waren frühe Mitarbeiter in Startups, die von Sequoia, Accel, Index Ventures und Y Combinator finanziert wurden und zusammen über 100 Mio. Euro eingesammelt haben. Neue Ideen testen wir erst einfach und von Hand, was funktioniert, automatisieren wir, und unsere Abläufe ändern wir jede Woche, manchmal täglich. Wir übernehmen Ownership und haben wenig Ego. Deine Rolle In deiner Operations & Growth Rolle baust du Decari mit uns auf. Du arbeitest direkt mit Julien (Operations) und den Gründern und bist operativ und taktisch mittendrin: Du sprichst jeden Tag mit Familien und Pflegediensten, siehst, wo es hakt, und gestaltest den Prozess aktiv mit. Was du machst Du bist der erste Kontakt der Familien zu Decari und verbringst den größten Teil deines Tages am Telefon. Im Gespräch findest du heraus, ob und wie wir helfen können. Du bringst Fälle ins Ziel. Aus einem guten Gespräch machst du einen vollständigen Fall und bleibst dran, bis alles da ist, was wir für den Antrag brauchen. Du betreust unsere Pflegedienste mit. Für sie bist du die erste Ansprechperson zu ihren Familien. Du verbesserst den Funnel. Du kennst die Zahlen von der Anfrage bis zum Antrag, bringst Ideen ein und testest sie direkt. Du baust mit uns Automatisierungen. Was wir oft genug von Hand gemacht haben, übernimmt danach die KI. Du passt gut zu uns, wenn Du gern telefonierst, auch 50 Mal am Tag, und dich eine Mailbox oder ein Nein nicht aus dem Takt bringt Du gut zuhörst, empathisch bist und schnell und fehlerfrei schreibst Du anpackst und dir für unglamouröse Arbeit nicht zu schade bist Du Ownership übernimmst: Dinge jetzt erledigst, die einfachste Lösung suchst und selbst einen Weg findest, wenn du feststeckst Du KI im Alltag nutzt und neue Tools schnell lernst Du Deutsch auf Muttersprachniveau sprichst, eine weitere Sprache wie Polnisch, Türkisch, Russisch oder Arabisch ist ein Plus Du studierst und deine Studienordnung ein Praktikum vorschreibt, zum Beispiel in BWL oder Gesundheitsmanagement Du schon Kundenkontakt hattest, etwa im Nebenjob, in einem Praktikum oder in einem eigenen Projekt Eher nichts für dich, wenn Du nicht gern telefonierst Du noch nie mit KI- oder Automatisierungstools gearbeitet hast oder dir technisches Grundverständnis fehlt Du nur „strategisch“ arbeiten willst Du dich unwohl fühlst, wenn du mehrere Aufgaben gleichzeitig jonglierst Du nicht gern direkt mit Kunden arbeitest oder ein dynamisches Umfeld nicht magst Du nur ein klassisches 9-to-5-Praktikum suchest So bewirbst du dich Sende uns dein CV über Join Kennenlernen & CV Screening Case Interview Team kennenlernen Angebot Kein Pflichtpraktikum? Als Werkstudentin oder Werkstudent mit bis zu 20 Stunden pro Woche tagsüber kannst du dich auch bewerben. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Founding Customer Value Manager (m/w/d)
description: Intro Die Bauindustrie verliert jährlich 1,6 Billionen USD durch Ineffizienzen. Einer der Hauptgründe: Dieselben Fehler wiederholen sich immer wieder , weil entscheidende Informationen noch immer in Papierdokumenten und unstrukturierten Dateien verborgen sind. Genau hier setzt alago an. Wir sind ein Team von elf Personen und entwickeln KI-gestütztes Projektmanagement für die Baubranche . Bereits heute vertrauen uns mehr als 15 Kunden . Unsere Vision ist es, Risiken in Bauprojekten frühzeitig sichtbar zu machen – damit Großprojekte nicht mehr Jahrzehnte dauern oder scheitern. Wir haben letztes Jahr eine Pre-Seed-Finanzierung von über 1 Mio. € von führenden VCs der Baubranche sowie einem der größten Projektentwickler Deutschlands abgeschlossen. 75 % der Infrastruktur, die im Jahr 2050 existieren wird, ist heute noch nicht gebaut. Lasst uns sie von Anfang an richtig bauen. Tasks Customer Experience ist bei uns kein Support-Ticket-Job. Du besitzt den kompletten Kundenlebenszyklus nach dem Vertragsabschluss — kommerziell, operativ und im Produkt . Damit sitzt du an der Stelle im Unternehmen, an der beide Seiten gleichzeitig sichtbar sind : Du weißt, was Kunden wirklich brauchen und wofür sie zahlen — und du weißt, was das Produkt kann und was es kosten würde, es zu können. Genau daraus entstehen die besten Produktentscheidungen und die besten Deals. Du bist die erste Person in dieser Rolle und baust den Bereich so, wie er in zwei Jahren für dreißig Leute funktionieren muss. 💰 Revenue Ownership Du besitzt einen Kundenstamm mit klarer Umsatzverantwortung: Retention, Expansion, Renewals. Du erkennst, wo ein Kunde mehr Wert ziehen könnte, und machst den Upsell selbst – weitere Nutzer, weitere Projekte, weitere Produkte. Du verhandelst Verlängerungen und Erweiterungen und führst sie bis zur Unterschrift. 🚀 Value Creation über den gesamten Kundenlebenszyklus Du übernimmst den Kunden ab dem ersten Onboarding-Kontakt : Setup, Projektdaten, Konfiguration, Schulung der Teams. Du führst den Rollout vom Pilotprojekt in die Fläche – und sorgst dafür, dass die Nutzung nicht nach vier Wochen einschläft. Du machst Value Reviews mit messbaren Zahlen statt Höflichkeitsterminen und machst sichtbar, was alago dem Kunden konkret gebracht hat. 🛟 Customer Support Du verantwortest unseren Support: Anfragen beantworten, priorisieren, Muster erkennen. Du debuggst Customer Flows in der Software selbst – du reichst ein Problem nicht weiter, du reproduzierst es, grenzt es ein und beschreibst es so, dass es lösbar ist. Du baust Doku, Self-Service und KI-gestützte Antworten so auf, dass dieselbe Frage nicht zehnmal auf deinem Tisch landet. ⚙️ Product Engine – du baust mit Du löst selbst, was sich ohne Engineering lösen lässt : Konfiguration, Datenbereinigung, kleine Automatisierungen und Skripte – mit KI-Tools wie Claude Code oder n8n. Was Code im Kernprodukt braucht, übergibst du so präzise an unser Engineering-Team, dass es schnell gelöst ist. Du verantwortest Integrationen und Datenimporte : Du scopst die Anbindung an Kundensysteme, prüfst, was machbar ist, und bringst Migrationen gemeinsam mit unserem Engineering-Team ins Ziel – damit ein Onboarding Stunden statt Tage dauert. Du übersetzt, was Nutzer, Projektleitungen, IT und QM wirklich brauchen, in klare, priorisierte Produkt-Inputs – mit Belegen, nicht mit Bauchgefühl. Was du selbst lösen kannst, löst du selbst. Du testest neue Releases aus Kundensicht, bevor sie live gehen, und bist die Stimme des Kunden im Produktprozess. 🏗️ Den Bereich aufbauen Du schreibst die Playbooks für Onboarding, Rollout, Support und Upsell – und automatisierst sie, wo immer es geht. Du entwickelst und betreibst die KI-Agents und Automatisierungen , die Customer Experience bei uns skalierbar machen, statt den Bereich mit Köpfen zu vergrößern. Requirements Muss-Kriterien Du hattest bereits direkten Kundenkontakt in einer verantwortlichen Rolle – du hast Kunden selbst geführt, nicht nur zugearbeitet Du hast Umsatzverantwortung getragen oder Umsatz ausgebaut (Renewals, Upsells, Expansion, Abschlüsse) und kannst das mit Zahlen belegen Deutsch auf Muttersprach-Niveau und sicheres Englisch Standort München oder Bereitschaft, dauerhaft von hier aus zu arbeiten Wie du arbeitest AI-native: Du nutzt KI nicht gelegentlich, sondern reflexhaft. Du hast dir selbst Agents, Automatisierungen oder kleine Tools gebaut (n8n, Claude Code, Lovable o. Ä.), probierst neue Modelle aus, sobald sie rauskommen, und hast eine fundierte Meinung dazu, was taugt. Systems Thinker: Du siehst nicht den einzelnen Kunden, sondern das System dahinter. Statt zehnmal dasselbe manuell zu lösen, baust du beim zweiten Mal den Prozess, der es überflüssig macht – und dokumentierst ihn so, dass ihn die nächste Person versteht. Technische Tiefe: Du gehst ins Produkt hinein: Daten prüfen, Flows nachvollziehen, Logs lesen, ein Problem sauber eingrenzen – und wo es geht, mit KI-Tools selbst beheben , sonst so beschreiben, dass es lösbar ist. Du fühlst dich in einer Software wohl, nicht nur in einer Präsentation darüber. Umsetzung & Ownership: Du bringst Dinge zu Ende, ohne dass jemand nachfassen muss. Was du übernimmst, landet nicht im Nirgendwo. Kommerzieller Instinkt: Du erkennst den Moment, in dem aus einem zufriedenen Kunden ein größerer Kunde wird – und sprichst ihn an, statt zu warten. Persönlicher Hintergrund DISC-Profil: Du bist extrovertiert und findest eine gute Balance zwischen People- und Task-Fokus Persönliche Eigenschaften: Du bist leidenschaftlich, neugierig, wettbewerbsorientiert und lernbereit / gut coachbar Du bist deiner Leidenschaft gefolgt und hast dir in einem kompetitiven Umfeld (z. B. Projekte, Sport, Musik, Kunst o. Ä.) messbare Erfolge erarbeitet Idealerweise bist du über eine persönliche Empfehlung aus unserem AAA-Netzwerk (Founders, Team, Partner, VCs etc.) auf uns aufmerksam geworden Pluspunkte Du hast selbst schon aktiv entwickelt – eigene Projekte, Skripte, Integrationen, ein Side Project, das tatsächlich läuft Du hast schon mit Claude Code (oder vergleichbaren Coding-Agents) echte Sachen gebaut und weißt, wie weit man damit ohne Engineering-Team kommt Du kennst Teile unseres Stacks ( TypeScript, React, Supabase ) schon aus eigenen Projekten Du hast schon in der Baubranche gearbeitet oder hast einen engen Bezug zu ihr Du hast bereits in einem schnell wachsenden Early-Stage-Startup gearbeitet und weißt, wie es sich anfühlt, wenn es noch kein Playbook gibt Du hast schon einmal einen Bereich oder Prozess von null aufgebaut Wenn du dich nicht in jedem Punkt wiederfindest, aber überzeugt bist, dass du gut zu alago passt, bewirb dich trotzdem. Entscheidend sind dein Potenzial und deine Lernkurve. Warum alago? Du bist die erste Person für Customer Experience bei alago. Es gibt keinen bestehenden Bereich, in den du dich einfügst – du entscheidest, wie er aussieht: welche Prozesse, welche Tools, welche Standards, welche Kennzahlen. Was du baust, bleibt. Du wirst einer der tragenden Pfeiler dieser Firma alago wird von sechs, sieben Bereichen getragen. Customer Experience ist einer davon – und du besitzt ihn. Du sitzt bei den Entscheidungen am Tisch, die die Firma prägen, nicht nur bei denen über deine Kunden. Der Weg von hier führt zum Head of Customer Experience mit eigenem Team. Du entwickelst dich in eines der gefragtesten Profile überhaupt Die stärksten KI-Unternehmen der Welt suchen gerade händeringend Leute, die Kunde und Produkt gleichzeitig beherrschen — bei Palantir heißt dieses Profil Forward Deployed Engineer , und es ist deshalb so wertvoll, weil es so selten ist. Bei uns wächst du genau in diese Richtung: Du lernst an echten Kunden, wie man Vertrauen aufbaut und schwierige Gespräche führt , und wie man einen Kunden über Monate zu messbarem Wert begleitet , statt ihn nach dem Onboarding sich selbst zu überlassen. Dazu kommt die technische Seite: Du arbeitest so nah am Produkt, dass du selbst Hand anlegen kannst — je tiefer du da einsteigst, desto größer wird dein Hebel. Du hast ab Tag eins Zugriff auf unsere Codebasis, pairst mit unserem Engineering-Team und bekommst echte Code-Reviews – dein technisches Level wächst messbar mit, nicht nebenbei. Wer beides kann, hat danach jede Tür offen. Du baust deine eigene Marke – und vervielfachst deinen Marktwert Du schärfst deine Persönlichkeit und deine Prinzipien kontinuierlich weiter. Du steigerst deine Glaubwürdigkeit: Du begleitest unser Wachstum von 11 auf 30 Mitarbeitende in zwei Jahren , du knackst den Code, wie man Onboarding, Rollout, Support und Upsell vorhersehbar und wiederholbar macht, und du baust dir dein eigenes Playbook – eines, das du überallhin mitnimmst. Du beschleunigst deine persönliche & berufliche Entwicklung Egal ob du hier die Fähigkeiten für die eigene Gründung sammeln oder Richtung Head of Customer Experience wachsen willst: Durch halbjährliche Performance-Reviews kannst du mit konkreten Entwicklungsschritten alle ~9 Monate rechnen. Zugang zu erfahrenen Coaches, Trainern und Mentor:innen. Wöchentliche Trainings- und Coaching-Sessions. Eine umfangreiche Bibliothek, aus der du dir von den glaubwürdigsten Menschen der Welt etwas abschauen kannst. Arbeite direkt mit den Foundern – Du bist Tag für Tag Seite an Seite mit Janick (Go-to-Market & Strategy) und Ann-Christin (Product & Domain) . Bewerbungsprozess Bewerbung – Lebenslauf plus ein kurzes Beispiel, in dem du Verantwortung übernommen und Wirkung erzielt hast Erstgespräch (45 Minuten) Deep-Dive mit einem Founder (50 Minuten) Case Study (halber Tag vor Ort in München) – z. B. ein hängendes Rollout retten, einen Upsell-Case rechnen oder einen Customer Flow im Produkt debuggen Entscheidung – Rückmeldung innerhalb von 24 Stunden . Wenn es für beide Seiten passt – freuen wir uns sehr auf die Zusammenarbeit! 🎉 Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Quality Officer

title: Product Manager Operations
description: Zit het in je aard om te ontrafelen hoe een proces nóg efficiënter kan? Als Product Manager Operations ben je de drijvende kracht achter de uitvoering van procesverbeteringen in onze operatie. Je duikt diep in de data, spoort knelpunten op en ondersteunt de Product Manager Operations bij het vertalen en opleveren van concrete oplossingen samen met ons development team. Wat je gaat doen Je bent verantwoordelijk voor het identificeren, prioriteren en realiseren van aanpassingen aan onze operations tooling. Dit doe je om de groei van Crisp op een slimme en efficiënte manier te faciliteren. Je werkt samen met onze Lead Product Manager Operations, Analytics en de operationele teams om groeikansen en verbeteringen in hun werkprocessen te identificeren. Je gebruikt data uit de operatie om de impact van deze procesverbeteringen in te schatten. Je trekt je veiligheidsschoenen aan om input op de halen op de werkvloer. Samen met de developers bespreek je in welke technische aanpassingen aan onze tooling benodigd zijn om een procesverbetering te realiseren. Tijdens de implementatie van een verbetering zorg jij voor de borging van het proces. Zodra je een verbetering hebt doorgevoerd meet je de effecten. Je gebruikt deze data weer als input om een volgende verbetering te verkennen. Dit ben jij Als ideale kandidaat heb je enige ervaring opgedaan binnen het Product Management vakgebied. title: Project & Account Manager B2B
description: Bij DeWarmte maken we slimme en betaalbare warmtepompen waarmee we woningen van het gas af helpen. We ontwerpen onze producten zelf, assembleren ze in Utrecht en zorgen samen met onze installatiepartners dat ze bij steeds meer mensen thuis komen te staan. We groeien hard. En naast individuele woningeigenaren werken we ook steeds meer samen met woningcorporaties, vastgoedeigenaren en vastgoedbeheerders die grotere aantallen woningen willen verduurzamen. Daarom zoeken we een B2B Account & Project Manager die deze projecten van begin tot eind in goede banen leidt. Iemand die overzicht houdt, afspraken nakomt en ervoor zorgt dat klanten, bewoners, installateurs en interne teams weten waar ze aan toe zijn. Je bent de verbindende schakel tussen onze zakelijke klanten en de mensen die de projecten uitvoeren. Je zorgt dat plannen niet alleen op papier kloppen, maar ook in de praktijk werken. Wat ga je doen? Je bent verantwoordelijk voor het succesvol realiseren van grotere warmtepompprojecten. Denk bijvoorbeeld aan de installatie van warmtepompen in 50 woningen binnen één wijk, waarbij meerdere installatieteams, bewoners en externe partners betrokken zijn. Je zorgt dat projecten soepel verlopen Je vertaalt afspraken met zakelijke klanten naar een concreet projectplan met duidelijke deadlines, verantwoordelijkheden en deliverables. Je bewaakt de planning, voortgang, kwaliteit en afgesproken KPI's van projecten. Je werkt nauw samen met onze Installation Quality Specialist aan de voorbereiding en uitvoering van projecten. Jij houdt de regie over het totale project, terwijl de Installation Quality Specialist de technische kwaliteit bewaakt. Je stemt de voorbereiding en uitvoering af met onze interne teams, installateurs en externe partners. Je signaleert risico's en knelpunten vroegtijdig en zorgt dat ze worden opgelost voordat ze de voortgang in gevaar brengen. Je houdt overzicht over meerdere projecten tegelijk en stelt prioriteiten waar nodig. Je bent het aanspreekpunt voor onze zakelijke klanten Je onderhoudt relaties met woningcorporaties, vastgoedeigenaren en vastgoedbeheerders. Je zorgt dat klanten weten wat ze kunnen verwachten, hoe projecten ervoor staan en welke beslissingen nodig zijn. Je organiseert de afstemming tussen alle betrokken partijen, van de opdrachtgever tot de bewoners en installatieteams. Je rapporteert over de voortgang, resultaten en kwaliteit van projecten en bespreekt verbeterpunten met klanten. Je bouwt aan langdurige klantrelaties door afspraken waar te maken en problemen goed op te lossen. Je helpt ons steeds slimmer te werken Je kijkt kritisch naar hoe we grotere installatieprojecten organiseren en uitvoeren. Je gebruikt projectdata en KPI's om te begrijpen wat goed gaat en waar we kunnen verbeteren. Je helpt processen te ontwikkelen waarmee we steeds grotere aantallen woningen efficiënt en met hoge kwaliteit kunnen verduurzamen. Wat breng je mee? We zoeken iemand die structuur kan aanbrengen in complexe projecten, maar ook pragmatisch is wanneer de werkelijkheid anders loopt dan gepland. Je kunt schakelen tussen een gesprek met een vastgoedmanager en het oplossen van een praktisch probleem met een installatieteam. Dit vinden we belangrijk: Je hebt aantoonbare ervaring met projectmanagement, waarbij je zelf verantwoordelijk was voor planning, voortgang, kwaliteit en resultaten. Je bent sterk in stakeholdermanagement en communiceert makkelijk met verschillende partijen, zowel intern als extern. Je weet hoe je meerdere projecten, deadlines en belangen tegelijkertijd managet zonder het overzicht te verliezen. Je bent gewend om met KPI's te werken en hierover helder te rapporteren. Je neemt eigenaarschap. Als iets niet volgens plan loopt, wacht je niet af maar kom je met een oplossing. Je bent organisatorisch sterk, communicatief vaardig en werkt graag in een omgeving waar nog niet alles vastligt. Je spreekt en schrijft vloeiend Nederlands en kunt je goed redden in het Engels. Mooi meegenomen, maar geen vereiste: Ervaring met woningcorporaties, vastgoedbeheerders of andere zakelijke partijen in de vastgoedsector. Ervaring met de uitrol van grotere verduurzamings-, installatie- of renovatieprojecten. Affiniteit met warmtepompen, installatietechniek of de energietransitie. Je hoeft dus geen warmtepompexpert te zijn. Belangrijker is dat je weet hoe je een complex project succesvol organiseert, mensen meekrijgt en resultaten behaalt. Waarom DeWarmte? Bij DeWarmte krijg je de kans om direct bij te dragen aan de energietransitie. Je werkt niet aan abstracte plannen, maar aan projecten die ervoor zorgen dat steeds meer woningen daadwerkelijk van het gas af kunnen. We zijn een groeiende scale-up met korte lijnen, veel verantwoordelijkheid en weinig bureaucratie. Je krijgt de ruimte om je eigen werk vorm te geven, verbeteringen door te voeren en mee te bouwen aan hoe we onze B2B-projecten in de toekomst organiseren. Je werkt samen met collega's uit verschillende teams die allemaal hetzelfde doel hebben: slimme, betaalbare warmtepompen toegankelijk maken voor zoveel mogelijk huishoudens. Wat krijg je van ons? Een rol met veel verantwoordelijkheid en directe impact op de groei van DeWarmte. De kans om mee te bouwen aan onze B2B-activiteiten en de manier waarop we grotere projecten uitvoeren. Veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief, ontwikkeling en het verbeteren van processen. Een bruto maandsalaris tussen de €3500 en €5000 per maand op basis van fulltime. Via ons SAR-programma (Stock Appreciation Rights) deel je mee in het financiële succes van DeWarmte en profiteer je van de waarde die we samen opbouwen. Een fijne werkplek in Den Haag, met de mogelijkheid om ook op projectlocaties te werken. Laptop en telefoon van de zaak. Gezamenlijke lunch op kantoor. Regelmatige teamuitjes en borrels, waaronder onze jaarlijkse stranddag en wintersport. Interesse? Lijkt het je leuk om grotere verduurzamingsprojecten van plan naar praktijk te brengen? En krijg je energie van het organiseren, verbinden en oplossen van problemen? Dan maken we graag kennis met je! We are looking for a Lead Controls & Data Engineer to take ownership of two foundations of our products: the control software that operates our heat pumps and the data platform that helps us monitor, understand and improve them. This is a hands-on leadership role. Initially, most of your time will be spent writing code, diagnosing real-world behaviour, improving reliability and delivering new functionality. At the same time, you are in the lead for collaborating with external partners, ensuring data reliability and scalability. Additionally, you will build the technical foundations, documentation and team that move us away from dependence on any one engineer. Your mission Build reliable, scalable controls and data capability that is owned by a team—not an individual. You will inherit working systems and products already operating in the field. Your job is to understand them deeply, keep them running, improve their performance and evolve their architecture. You will then recruit and develop the engineers needed to create durable, shared ownership. What you'll do Own and improve our control software Work directly in the production code that controls our heat pumps. Design, build, test and deploy new control functionality. Improve product performance, stability, safety and energy efficiency. Diagnose and understand complex behaviour across software, electronics, sensors, hydraulics and the physical installation. Manage controlled software rollouts across both new products and the installed fleet. Establish appropriate automated testing, simulation, observability and release practices. Current stack includes Bash/Shell, Python, Kafka, Telegraf and Influx. You will own the evolution of the stack together with our Hardware R&D team. Build our product data platform Take technical ownership of the systems that collect, process and expose data from our connected smart heat pumps. Make product behaviour and fleet trends observable for engineering, service and product teams. Improve the quality, reliability and accessibility of operational data. Ensure pipeline and server capabilities are able to handle rapid scaling. Create the foundations for performance analysis, remote diagnostics and continuous product improvement. Define clear interfaces between device software, cloud systems, the customer app and internal tools. Build a team and eliminate key-person dependency Turn implicit knowledge into clear documentation, tooling and repeatable engineering practices. Design systems that other engineers can intuitively understand, easily test and safely change. Define the roles and capabilities the team will need as DeWarmte scales. Recruit, onboard and mentor controls, embedded-software and data engineers. Introduce effective code reviews, technical decision-making and shared operational ownership. Gradually move from being the primary implementer to leading a capable team—without losing touch with the code. Work across the product You will collaborate closely with colleagues in hardware, software, data, product development, assembly, installation and service. You will help resolve immediate customer and operational issues while protecting the long-term quality of the platform. What success looks like In your first months You understand the existing controls, data flows and operational risks. You can independently maintain, debug and release the current systems. The most important technical risks and knowledge gaps are visible and prioritised. Monitoring, documentation and development practices begin to improve. As the role develops New control functionality can be delivered predictably and safely. You work closely together with Hardware colleagues, developing the next generation of products Product data supports faster diagnosis and better engineering decisions. Critical systems are understood and maintained by more than one person. A small, strong controls and data team is in place, with clear ownership and effective ways of working. DeWarmte is no longer dependent on a single engineer to operate or evolve this part of the product. What we are looking for Strong hands-on software engineering experience, including ownership of production systems. Experience developing control or embedded software for physical products, machines or connected devices. A track record of taking functionality through design, implementation, testing, deployment and real-world operation. The ability to reason across software, hardware and physical-system behaviour. Experience working with telemetry, time-series data, data pipelines or connected-device platforms. Strong engineering fundamentals, including version control, automated testing, CI/CD, observability and structured incident resolution. The ability to create clarity in an environment where systems and processes are still developing. Experience mentoring engineers and improving how a team works. The ambition and ability to recruit and lead a team while remaining highly hands-on. Experience with heat pumps, HVAC systems, safety-critical design, fleet-management systems or optimisation is valuable, but we care more about your ability to learn a complex physical product and take genuine end-to-end ownership. How you work You solve urgent problems without allowing permanent workarounds to become the architecture. You explain complex technical matters clearly to people with different backgrounds. You balance reliability today with the investments needed to scale tomorrow. You share knowledge by default and measure success by what the team can own without you. You are comfortable switching between debugging a specific installation, reviewing architecture and interviewing a future teammate. You are able to maintain alignment between your own team’s development roadmap and the roadmap of other product teams. What you will get Direct influence on technology that contributes to the energy transition. Ownership of software and data that sit at the heart of a real physical product. The opportunity to shape both the technical platform and the team around it. A role that starts deeply hands-on and grows into broader engineering leadership. Close collaboration with colleagues across the complete product lifecycle. What we offer A monthly gross salary between €4.500 and €6.000, based on full-time. 27 vacation days plus 8% holiday allowance Participation in our SAR (Stock Appreciation Rights) programme Plenty of ownership and responsibility from day one The opportunity to shape products that directly contribute to the energy transition A talented, ambitious, and highly collaborative team A healthy daily lunch at the office Laptop and everything you need to do your best work Regular team events, company drinks, our annual beach day, and winter trip Lots of room to grow, develop yourself, and make a lasting impact Interested? Do you want to build the software, data platform and engineering team behind the next generation of DeWarmte heat pumps? We would like to meet you. description: Onze missie Heel Nederland helpen om van het gas af te gaan. Dat is waar we iedere dag aan werken. Bij DeWarmte ontwikkelen én installeren we onze eigen warmtepompen. Daarmee maken we duurzaam verwarmen slimmer, betaalbaarder en toegankelijk voor steeds meer huishoudens. Maar een goed product alleen is niet genoeg. Mensen hebben behoefte aan eerlijk advies en een vast aanspreekpunt. Daar kom jij in beeld. Wij maken warmte zonder gas Je agenda zit 's ochtends al vol met mensen die zelf hebben gebeld.
