Met een club van ruim zestig mensen bedenken we ze, assembleren we ze in Utrecht en installeren we ze zelf. Voor huiseigenaren door heel Nederland en sinds dit jaar ook in Duitsland. Vorig jaar won onze Pomp MP als enige warmtepomp ooit zowel de iF Design Award Gold als de Red Dot. Elke week gaan er tientallen huizen van het gas af. Het doel is 10% van alle Nederlandse woningen, ongeveer 800.000 huizen. De vraag is er en het product staat. De rem zit op hoe snel we kunnen leveren. Dat lukt niet zonder jou als sales adviseur. title: Staff Software Engineer, Infrastructure
description: Staff Software Engineer, Platform & Infrastructure The role We are hiring a Staff Software Engineer for our Infrastructure team. Stream runs behind apps that more than a billion people use: billions of API requests a month, a 99.999% uptime promise, and a small team keeping it all running. Infrastructure here decides how fast our products feel, how well they scale, and how quickly we can launch new ones. This year we're wrapping up a big move. We're simplifying where and how we host, and rebuilding our data layer on self-hosted, open-source systems that are faster and cheaper to run. That's the groundwork, not the job. Next comes building the infrastructure every Stream product runs on, including the ones we haven't built yet. That means real SLOs, clear costs, calmer on-call, and a platform that helps teams ship faster. What you build will shape how much Stream spends and how fast it grows, and we'll trust you with big decisions from your first few weeks. This is a Software Engineering role first. Attitude, ambition and a willingness to experiment across the stack matter more to us than years of Kubernetes or database operations. We expect AI to cover a good share of the DevOps-heavy work, and we expect you to use it that way. What a tool can't give us is system design judgement , strong fundamentals and good code , so that is what we look for. Platform & Infrastructure is a small, senior team without the support structures of a large organisation. It moves fast and it gets hectic. We would rather say that now than have you find out in month two. What team is focusing on: Runs Stream's global platform. Keeps the edge and backend that serve customers worldwide fast and up, at single-digit millisecond latency on a 99.999% uptime SLA. Shapes Stream's margins. Our hosting and infrastructure decisions directly drive the company's profitability. You will decide where and how we run, and what we stop paying for. Builds tools people actually want to use. Internal tools that change how engineers deploy and debug, and external ones that give customers a clear view of their own traffic and health. Makes on-call boring. Builds a rotation people can sustain, and cuts alert noise until a page means something real is broken. Makes cost visible. Gives every team a clear view of what it spends on infrastructure and why, so cost becomes part of every engineering decision. What you will do: Define what "good" looks like for the platform. Set latency and uptime SLOs for every product team, and decide what we measure, from error rates and delivery times to how healthy our customers' apps really are. Make the big infrastructure calls. Lead the design reviews and decisions on where and how we run, working with backend, video and moderation engineers on tradeoffs that cross service boundaries. Build the platform tooling. Write the internal tools and services that help engineers ship, deploy and debug faster, plus the docs and AI skills that make launching a new product repeatable. Turn incidents into fixes that stick. Take part in on-call, and make sure every root cause ends in a durable fix, not a workaround. Make cost part of every design. Weigh cost alongside reliability in every decision, and give teams the numbers to do the same. What we are looking for: A software engineer who has built systems, not only configured them. You write production code in Go, Python or a similar language. Scripting-only backgrounds are not a fit. Strong system design . You can reason about failure modes, capacity and cost in distributed systems, and explain why you chose what you chose. Solid fundamentals in networking , storage and concurrency , and the habit of asking why a system behaves the way it does instead of accepting the default. You have owned high-scale production systems and set technical direction beyond your own work, through design reviews, RFCs and decisions other engineers build on. You experiment. When you hit Kubernetes, a database or a cloud service you have not run before, you dig in, use AI to close the gap, and ship. You already use AI tools every day in your engineering work. You treat cost and reliability as engineering problems, and you can put a number on an outcome you drove. You write clearly. Much of this role is docs and standards that other teams will follow. You are comfortable in a small team, setting direction and reviewing a PR in the same week. Nice to have experience: Kubernetes in production: cluster architecture, workload design or a migration you led. PostgreSQL at scale, ideally self-hosted or with CloudNativePG: sharding, replication, partitioning tradeoffs. Valkey or Redis at scale, ideally on Kubernetes. Hands-on AWS and GCP, including multi-cloud setups or migrations between providers. Cloud commitment and reservation strategy (committed use discounts, savings plans), or formal FinOps practice. SLO design, alert hygiene and a Prometheus and Grafana based observability stack. Real-time systems: WebSockets, WebRTC, streaming or other persistent-connection workloads. Open source contributions, or writing and talks on cloud, platform or distributed systems. Our stack Go, gRPC, RocksDB, Python PostgreSQL, RabbitMQ GCP Grafana, Prometheus, ELK (Elasticsearch and Kibana) Jaeger and Tempo for distributed tracing, Datadog Redis, Memcached Claude Code, Cursor You will thrive here if You want platform and infrastructure problems at a scale most engineers never touch, and the autonomy to set the direction yourself. You would rather try something, measure it and change course than wait for a perfect plan. You ship fast and learn fast, including when it is hectic. You are self-directed and comfortable working with a globally distributed team across time zones. You probably will not if You want to stay a specialist in one layer of the stack. You want tightly scoped tickets and step-by-step direction. You need a calm, highly predictable environment. Compensation and benefits For employees based in the Netherlands: 28 days paid time off plus Dutch public holidays Pension plan Commute covered: an NS Business Card or a company Swapfiets Fitness contribution of up to €60 a month toward a gym or sports club membership Learning and development budget Work from anywhere: up to four weeks a year Full Dutch statutory leave, with Stream topping up paternity leave to 100% pay Catered team lunches in the office, and snacks MacBook Pro and peripherals Relocation support, visa sponsorship and 30% ruling support An office in the centre of Amsterdam Conferences and meetups, as an attendee or a speaker The chance to work on our open source SDKs Why join Stream? We're a Series B company with global presence and a team of around 145 people from more than 35 countries. We're backed by Felicis Ventures, GGV Capital, 01 Advisors, Techstars, and Arthur Ventures, with angels including Dick Costolo (ex-CEO of Twitter), Olivier Pomel (CEO of Datadog), Tom Preston-Werner (co-founder of GitHub), and Nicolas Dessaigne (co-founder of Algolia). We'll be straight with you: a startup is more demanding than a large company. There's no fixed playbook, you'll own things end to end, and you'll sometimes pick up work outside your title. That's also what makes it a fast place to grow. If you want real ownership and high scale more than structure and a set career ladder, you'll feel at home here. This is a practical, bench-first role (80% practical lab execution & quality control, 20% data analysis, reporting & process improvement) that sits at the center of our commercial validation pipeline. Because CarbonX materials physically behave differently from standard graphite during dispersion and calendering, you will play a crucial role in diagnosing processability, optimising slurry formulations, and ensuring defect-free electrode production. Key Responsibilities • Slurry Preparation & Electrode Manufacturing: Formulate, mix, coat, and calender slurries containing active materials, binders, and conductive additives strictly in line with experimental and customer protocols. • Physical & Diagnostic Characterisation: Perform hands-on bench tests including rheology and viscosity profiling, slurry density, moisture, particle fineness analysis, adhesion and peel-strength testing (90°/180°), and Scanning Electron Microscopy (SEM). • Processability Optimisation: Observe how novel carbon structures interact during mixing and calendering; identify physical bottlenecks to ensure process repeatability. • Operational Troubleshooting & QC: Enforce strict quality control standards. Ready to take proven deep-tech to industrial scale? The technology is no longer just an idea—it has been produced at scale, integrated into commercial processes, tested in cells, and validated by major customers. You will build the financial infrastructure, governance, and discipline that this next chapter of growth demands, across a business spanning technology, regulated healthcare services, and multiple jurisdictions. The Challenges As CFO, you will step into the trenches to tackle four defining challenges: Leading buy-side M&A execution: You will be the primary financial architect behind our inorganic growth. Architecting for multi-jurisdiction complexity: You will own the financial structure connecting our operations across the Netherlands, the US, and India. This means building robust transfer pricing policies, intercompany arrangements, and multi-party revenue recognition frameworks that hold up to investor and regulatory scrutiny as the business scales across borders. Being a credible investor partner: You will serve as the finance function's primary interface to our Supervisory Board. You will bring investor-grade reporting rhythms, board governance discipline, and the judgment to translate operational reality into the language our sponsor and Board expect. Preparing for future fundraising and exit: You will help set the company up for its next capital event, whether that is a follow-on raise, a strategic sale, or another form of exit. This means building the financial track record, audit readiness, and data room discipline that institutional buyers and investors expect, well ahead of any process actually starting. What You Bring to the Table Experience & Technical Depth Proven CFO or strong CFO-1 experience in a high-growth, investor-backed business, ideally in healthtech, healthcare services, life sciences, or another complex international platform environment. Buy-side M&A execution is a firm requirement . You have led acquisitions from the buyer's side, not only sell-side or advisory M&A, and can speak credibly to deal structuring, diligence, and post-deal integration. Multi-jurisdiction financial complexity : hands-on experience with transfer pricing, intercompany structures, and multi-party revenue recognition across at least two of the following: Europe, the US, and Asia. Institutional governance familiarity : direct experience with board reporting rhythms, supervisory board obligations, and the accountability that comes with a private equity or growth equity sponsor. Regulated sector navigation : exposure to compliance-intensive environments, ideally in healthcare, life sciences, or another highly regulated domain. Leading a lean senior team : you have led finance at this scale and know how to raise the ceiling of a small team rather than solving it with headcount. Fundraising and exit experience: you have run or closely supported a capital raise, whether equity, debt, or both, and ideally have direct exposure to a sale process, IPO, or other exit event. You know what "diligence-ready" actually means in practice. Leadership Style & Cultural Fit A Builder at Heart: You are energized by creating and scaling finance infrastructure, and you are comfortable reviewing a deal model, writing a Board memo, or rolling up your sleeves with the team when needed. Commercially Astute: You connect mission to economics, balancing patient-first principles with the discipline an investor-backed business requires, and you can challenge constructively. Low Ego, High Accountability: You establish clear standards, hold yourself and others to them, and proactively remove roadblocks rather than waiting for structure to be handed to you. Reporting: FP&A and performance reporting capability already in place; the priority now is professionalizing controls, governance, and investor-grade reporting infrastructure around it. Ownership: A Supervisory Board and a committed institutional sponsor, Avego Healthcare Capital, with clear expectations on growth economics, capital allocation, and value creation. Growth model: Organic growth complemented by inorganic opportunities, with M&A and strategic partnerships expected to play an increasing role in the company's next phase. Established a robust multi-jurisdiction financial architecture, including transfer pricing policy and intercompany structures that hold up under scrutiny. Built investor-grade financial governance and greater confidence in data quality across the business. Strengthened the finance team and its standing with business leaders, while building on the FP&A foundation already in place. Become a trusted partner to the CEO and Supervisory Board, with a reporting rhythm that meets institutional ownership expectations. Helped shape a clear financial roadmap for international scale and long-term value creation. What we Offer A Seat at the Table: Autonomy to shape the financial architecture of a category-defining company with deep strategic relevance. AI & Automation: Du identifizierst Automatisierungspotenziale in internen Prozessen und Geschäftsmodellen, testest KI-Tools und -Workflows und trägst aktiv dazu bei, wie Galvany künstliche Intelligenz operativ einsetzt – zur Effizienzsteigerung, Produktentwicklung und Entscheidungsfindung. Du denkst strukturiert, analytisch und zahlenaffin und kannst komplexe Sachverhalte schnell durchdringen, sauber aufbereiten und klar kommunizieren. Du trittst sicher auf und überzeugst unterschiedliche Stakeholder, intern wie extern, durch präzise, verständliche Kommunikation, auch in anspruchsvollen Situationen. Du bist neugierig auf KI-Tools und Automatisierung und hast idealerweise bereits erste Erfahrungen damit gesammelt oder den Willen, dich schnell einzuarbeiten. title: General Manager (m/w/d) - Fitness & Lifestyle Brand
description: Managing Director (m/w/d) - Fitness & Lifestyle Brand Location: Köln Start: Ab sofort Setup: Vollzeit (on-site) THE BRAND & THE OPPORTUNITY Du baust gemeinsam mit uns eine neue Fitness-Marke im Segment Mid Cost - High Value auf. Die Vision: „ Der neue Hotspot in der City für Workout, Recovery, Co-Working und Socializing.“ Kraft, Cardio und Functional, Live-Kurse, Sauna und Recovery, Bar und Lounge sowie eine ruhige Co-Working Zone, alles unter einem Dach - zu einem erschwinglichen Preis deutlich unter Premium-Clubs. Unsere Clubs sollen auf ehemaligen Retail-Flächen entstehen, in 1A-Innenstadtlagen mit langfristig gesicherten Mietverträgen. Wir starten in Westdeutschland in der Region Köln, Essen, Frankfurt und expandieren dann. Wir arbeiten mit unternehmerischem Anspruch: kleines Team, kurze Wege, jeder Standort muss sich selbst tragen. Der erste Club ist der Beweis für das Konzept, und jeder weitere wird durch den Erfolg des vorherigen verdient. Für dich heißt das: Du bist ab Sekunde 1 dabei und gestaltest vom Namen über das Konzept bis hin zur Location alles von Grund auf mit. Kein Einstieg in einen bestehenden Betrieb, sondern die Chance, eine Marke von Null an aufzubauen , das Modell in allen Details zu gestalten und volle Verantwortung für das Ergebnis zu übernehmen. THE ROLE & YOUR ROADMAP Als Managing Director verantwortest du den kompletten Aufbau der Marke - von den ersten Entwürfen auf dem Reißbrett bis hin zur Multi-Site-Skalierung. Phase 1 - Konzept schärfen: Du bringst das Angebot, das Flächenprogramm, die Pricing-Strategie und den Brand-Auftritt gemeinsam mit den Gesellschaftern zur Marktreife. Phase 2 - Ersten Club eröffnen: Du steuerst den Ausbau vor Ort, baust dein Kernteam auf, drehst den Pre-Opening-Sales auf Anschlag und bringst den ersten Flagship-Standort ans Netz. Phase 3 - Proof of Concept: Du erreichst mit dem Club die geplanten Mitglieder- und Ergebniszahlen (P&L) und machst aus dem Piloten ein hocheffizientes, wiederholbares Modell. Phase 4 - Skalieren: Du eröffnest weitere Standorte in Deutschland und baust die Organisation auf, die dieses Wachstum trägt. YOUR IMPACT (DIE ERSTEN 12 MONATE) Du bist von Tag 1 an am Start und bringst den ersten Standort ans Netz: Konzept zur Marktreife bringen: Zusammen mit der Projektleitung feilst du an Angebot, Flächenaufteilung, Preisen und Marke. Ausbau steuern: Du betreust den Aus- und Umbau des ersten Standorts und behältst Zeit- und Kostenrahmen fest im Griff. Kernteam aufbauen: Du rekrutierst Club-Leitung, Trainer sowie Servicepersonal und prägst von Anfang an Kultur und Standards. Pre-Sales & Markteintritt verantworten: Du treibst die Mitgliedergewinnung vor der Eröffnung, machst lokales Marketing und schließt Deals mit Firmenkunden sowie Aggregatoren (z. B. Urban Sports Club, EGYM Wellpass). Prozesse & Tech aufsetzen: Du richtest Mitgliederverwaltung, Zugangssysteme, App und Reporting ein. Ersten Club eröffnen: Du begleitest das Grand Opening und führst den Standort erfolgreich in den Live-Betrieb. YOUR PROFILE Du brennst selbst für Fitness und Lifestyle, denkst wie ein Unternehmer und hast den Biss, etwas Eigenes aufzubauen? Dann bist du genau die richtige Person! Track Record: Du hast Führungserfahrung in der Fitnessbranche (z. B. als Area Manager, Cluster Manager oder Regional Director), idealerweise mit P&L Verantwortung. Neueröffnungs-Erfahrung: Du hast schon eine Neueröffnung von A bis Z selbst verantwortet oder mitgestaltet (Ausbau, Teamaufbau, Pre-Sales). Business Mindset: Du hast Kaufmännisches Denken, Data-Drive und souveränes Auftreten gegenüber Gesellschaftern, Vermietern und Partnern. Hands-on & Drive: Du packst überall mit an, bis du zufrieden bist. Danach führst du ein wachsendes Team. Setup: Vollzeit, Wohnsitz oder Relocation in die Startregion Köln, Essen oder Frankfurt. Reisebereitschaft zu den Standorten und Deutsch C2. Das wäre ein Plus: Vorerfahrung aus Hospitality, Wellness oder Gastronomie, Erfahrung im Markenaufbau sowie ein starkes Netzwerk in der Fitnessbranche. WHY US Maximale Gestaltungsfreiheit: Die seltene Chance, eine komplett neue Marke von der ersten Skizze an zu ownen. High-Speed & Support: Kurze Entscheidungswege und direkter Austausch mit den Gesellschaftern. Du entscheidest alles mit! Executive Package: Attraktive Vergütung bestehend aus Fixgehalt, transparentem Bonus und einem Firmenwagen. Contact: Alex Berwanger Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h3><strong>About the Role</strong></h3><p>We are looking for a Systems Engineer to help build and manage tools that help engineers deploy and operate the services that make Cloudflare work. title: Senior Software Engineer - Platform & Infrastructure (f/m/d)
description: The product you will work on The HOLOPLOT Matrix Array is a new type of sound system built around precise, software-defined control of sound in three dimensions - grounded in physics and implemented through a combination of custom hardware and purpose-built software. HOLOPLOT deployed Matrix Arrays in various venues, including the Sphere in Las Vegas - the world’s most advanced entertainment venue and, notably, home to the world’s largest audio installation in entertainment. Audio processing in HOLOPLOT systems is distributed: every loudspeaker runs embedded Linux, and hundreds of them have to be configured, coordinated, monitored, and updated as one system. This is enabled by multiple open source and in-house developed services running on an on-premises Kubernetes cluster. AWS-hosted services connect venues to remote monitoring, telemetry, and configuration. Many venues are air-gapped or only intermittently connected for remote servicing, and that constraint shapes most of the design decisions in the platform. The ideal candidate is We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer who builds the platform our sound systems run on, and who takes responsibility for how it behaves in production. This is a software engineering role first. You will spend your time writing software, either with your own team or embedded with one of the other HOLOPLOT teams: services, controllers, agents, and tooling that provision, configure, observe, and update our systems. Our infrastructure is defined as code and evolves through the same review and release process as the rest of our software. You design the operational side, you build it, and you are on call when it misbehaves in the field. Your role and responsibilities You will join the team that owns the platform underneath our installations and connected services, working alongside backend, embedded, and frontend engineers who are organized in cross-functional product teams. Build the platform Architect and implement services to provision, configure, and manage server fleets across AWS and local clusters. Create control-plane logic for venue systems to ensure consistency, health monitoring, rollout management, and recovery, even during uplink disruptions. Establish end-to-end provisioning workflows for embedded Linux hardware, spanning from initial manufacturing to customer deployment. Enhance update processes to streamline software deployments for active customer installations. Develop APIs and developer tooling that empower engineering teams to independently deploy, observe, and troubleshoot their services. Embed telemetry capabilities into the platform to facilitate remote diagnosis of venue system behavior . Run what you build Own the AWS infrastructure behind our connected services: remote access, access control, telemetry ingestion, remote backup, secret management, and monitoring. All of it is infrastructure as code. Operate and evolve the on-premises Kubernetes footprint at venues, including air-gapped and intermittently connected installations. Monitor large environments, investigate problems across the software/hardware boundary, and turn each incident into a fix in the code. Be part of a compensated on-call rotation Set the technical direction Advise and collaborate with product teams on building distributed systems that are scalable, secure, and observable, and review their designs with production reality in mind. Research and introduce tools and technologies where they measurably improve how we build and operate. Contribute back to the open-source projects we depend on, through issues and fixes. What you need to succeed in this role Several years of professional software engineering experience, most of it spent designing and shipping production systems. Fluency in software engineering as a craft: concurrency, error handling, testing, and designing APIs that other teams build on. Working knowledge of the Kubernetes control plane and the operator/controller pattern, including how clusters behave when they are unhealthy. Hands-on experience with AWS, and a firm belief in infrastructure as code. Terraform and Ansible are what we use today. Comfort across several languages, and the ability to pick up a new one when the problem calls for it. Our platform work is mostly Go and Python, with Rust and C++ elsewhere in the stack. Experience building distributed systems, and a clear understanding of how they fail: partitions, partial rollouts, clock skew, retries, and reconciliation. A good sense for software architecture and maintainability, and the habit of writing code that colleagues can pick up and change. A strong command of Linux, scripting, and automation. Experience instrumenting software for telemetry and using it to answer real questions about running systems. Good judgment about what to automate and what to leave alone. Strong communication skills in English. You can explain a design or a failure clearly to engineers, product stakeholders, and non-specialists. Willingness to take part in compensated on-call and weekend work when installations need it. A can-do mentality, an eye for detail, and the courage to take on problems outside your comfort zone. Experience in using AI for engineering. Nice to haves Experience with NATS, Prometheus/Thanos, or PostgreSQL in production. Experience with air-gapped or intermittently connected installations. Experience running Kubernetes in production, not only deploying to it. Experience with embedded Linux, device fleet management, or IoT security. Networking depth: multicast at scale, WireGuard, BGP, IPv6. Experience in the audio, broadcast, or live events industry. Contributions to open-source infrastructure projects We offer you At HOLOPLOT we work in a flexible hybrid setup with trust-based working hours, giving you the freedom to organise your day in a way that supports focus, deep work and balance. Pay is competitive and fair, and we offer perks and benefits such as subsidised public transport, lunch allowances, Urban Sports and a company pension scheme. You’ll join an international, open-minded team across software, hardware, product and research, in an environment with plenty of autonomy and ownership. You’ll work on cutting-edge audio technology, turn complex requirements into working solutions and contribute to global projects, with support for your growth through individual development plans, mentoring and coaching. description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an AI Trainers Network – Arabic based in Germany. Join a global network of language professionals and culturally aware contributors helping shape the future of artificial intelligence. In this flexible, remote opportunity, you can contribute to projects that improve the accuracy, relevance, and inclusivity of AI systems. Depending on your skills and availability, you may work on text, image, or audio annotation, content evaluation, and prompt creation. Your Arabic language expertise and cultural understanding will help make AI-generated content more natural, reliable, and representative of diverse communities. Projects vary in scope and duration, offering opportunities to gain experience with emerging AI technologies while working on your own terms. This is a talent network opportunity rather than an active job opening, meaning you will be contacted when a suitable project becomes available. Before each project begins, you will receive clear information about the tasks, timeline, and compensation so you can decide whether it fits your interests and availability. Accountabilities As a contributor to the AI Trainers Network, you will support projects designed to improve AI performance, language understanding, and content quality. Depending on the project requirements and your areas of expertise, your responsibilities may include: Annotating and labeling text, images, or audio to help train and improve AI models. Evaluating search results, advertisements, and chatbot responses for accuracy, relevance, quality, and usefulness. Creating, testing, and refining prompts to improve the performance of large language models (LLMs). Reviewing AI-generated content to ensure linguistic accuracy, natural Arabic expression, and cultural appropriateness. Identifying errors, inconsistencies, and potentially misleading or unsuitable content in AI outputs. Applying project-specific guidelines and quality standards while maintaining consistency and attention to detail. Contributing feedback that helps develop safer, more inclusive, and human-centered AI systems. Managing assigned tasks independently and meeting project deadlines according to agreed requirements and availability. Requirements We are looking for detail-oriented, curious, and adaptable contributors who are interested in language, technology, and the development of AI systems. The ideal candidate combines strong Arabic language skills with the ability to evaluate information critically and work independently in a digital environment. Native or near-native fluency in Arabic, with a strong understanding of grammar, vocabulary, and linguistic nuances. Current residence in Poland for this opportunity. Good English proficiency to understand project instructions and communicate effectively. Comfort using digital tools, online platforms, and web-based applications. Strong attention to detail and the ability to identify linguistic, factual, and contextual inconsistencies. Good analytical and critical-thinking skills, particularly when evaluating content for accuracy and relevance. Cultural awareness and an understanding of Arabic-speaking communities, communication styles, and regional language variations. Ability to follow detailed guidelines, work independently, and deliver consistent, high-quality results. Curiosity about artificial intelligence, language technologies, and how human feedback can improve AI systems. Flexibility to participate in projects of varying durations and complexity, depending on your availability. Previous experience in data annotation, content evaluation, translation, linguistics, prompt engineering, or AI training may be helpful, but project-specific requirements will vary. Benefits Flexible, remote work: Contribute to suitable projects from your preferred working environment, subject to individual project requirements. Control over your availability: Choose whether to participate when a project matches your schedule and interests. Project-based opportunities: Access assignments that may last from a few days to several weeks, depending on scope and demand. Transparent compensation: Receive project-specific details about payment, tasks, and timelines before deciding whether to participate. Practical AI experience: Develop your understanding of AI training, data annotation, language evaluation, and large language models. Meaningful contribution: Help build more accurate, inclusive, and culturally aware AI technologies. Global contributor community: Become part of an international network of people contributing their linguistic and cultural expertise. title: Account Executive
description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Account Executive based in Germany. As an Account Executive, you will drive business growth across Europe by selling cutting-edge cloud infrastructure technology to enterprise customers, cloud providers, and fast-growing AI and developer platforms. You will own the entire sales cycle, from prospecting and discovery to technical evaluations, pilot programs, commercial negotiations, and closing deals. Working closely with the founding team and technical experts, you will help customers understand how next-generation microvirtualization can improve workload isolation, security, and infrastructure efficiency. You will build a qualified pipeline through strategic outbound campaigns, industry networking, and targeted account development. As an early sales hire, you will have a direct influence on the go-to-market strategy, sales processes, and future growth of the commercial organization. This fully remote opportunity combines entrepreneurial ownership, technical learning, and uncapped earning potential in a rapidly evolving AI and cloud infrastructure market. Accountabilities Build, manage, and grow a European sales pipeline targeting enterprise infrastructure teams, cloud and hosting providers, and high-growth AI and developer technology companies. Own the full sales cycle, from identifying and qualifying prospects to conducting discovery calls, coordinating technical evaluations, negotiating commercial terms, and securing signed contracts. Develop and execute targeted outbound strategies in collaboration with go-to-market engineers, identifying priority accounts, key decision-makers, and effective messaging to generate qualified opportunities. Lead customer conversations and engage economic buyers early, building relationships with CTOs, platform engineering leaders, security teams, procurement professionals, and other stakeholders involved in complex purchasing decisions. Coordinate product demonstrations, technical deep dives, and proof-of-concept or pilot programs alongside founders and field engineers to demonstrate product value and accelerate customer adoption. Translate technical capabilities into clear business outcomes, showing customers how lightweight microvirtual machines can improve workload isolation, infrastructure utilization, security, and deployment speed. Apply structured qualification methodologies, including MEDDPICC, to assess deal quality, understand decision-making processes, identify risks, and convert successful pilots into long-term production commitments. Develop commercial proposals tailored to customer requirements, including usage-based pricing, minimum commitments, dedicated deployments, and bring-your-own-cloud arrangements. Identify opportunities for account expansion by working closely with field engineers and existing customers to understand evolving infrastructure needs and increase adoption. Represent the business at industry conferences, cloud-native events, AI infrastructure gatherings, and regional meetups, building relationships and converting networking opportunities into qualified pipeline. Collaborate with go-to-market engineers to develop creative prospecting campaigns, improve sales automation, and refine outreach strategies based on market feedback and campaign performance. Contribute to the development and continuous improvement of the sales playbook, sharing insights on customer needs, competitive positioning, objections, and emerging market trends with the founding team and product organization. Maintain accurate records in HubSpot, manage pipeline reporting, and provide reliable forecasts to support business planning and sales execution. Support opportunities across the United States when needed, coordinating with the wider team and accommodating regular calls during European evening hours. Help shape the future sales organization by establishing repeatable processes, sharing best practices, and contributing to the onboarding and development of future sales hires. Requirements: At least 4 years of experience in quota-carrying sales or closing roles, selling technical products to engineering-oriented buyers. Proven experience selling technical solutions, ideally within cloud infrastructure, DevOps, developer tooling, virtualization, serverless computing, or related technology markets. Demonstrated ability to build a sales pipeline from scratch through outbound prospecting, account research, networking, and targeted engagement strategies. Strong understanding of effective outbound sales practices, with the ability to develop compelling messaging, prioritize accounts, and guide others in improving prospecting performance. Experience managing complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles involving technical evaluations, proof-of-concept programs, and extended decision-making processes. Ability to engage confidently with technical and economic buyers, including CTOs, platform engineering leaders, security stakeholders, procurement teams, and legal departments. Sufficient technical knowledge to discuss virtualization, containers, Kubernetes, cloud infrastructure, and related technologies credibly with engineering teams, combined with the curiosity and motivation to deepen your expertise. Experience converting pilots, proofs of concept, or technical evaluations into signed commercial agreements. Familiarity with usage-based pricing, consumption-based business models, minimum commitments, or other flexible commercial structures. Strong prospecting, negotiation, presentation, and relationship-building skills, with the ability to make customers feel comfortable while maintaining a rigorous, analytical approach to sales. Excellent spoken and written English, with additional languages considered an advantage. A high degree of ownership, initiative, adaptability, and learning agility, with the ability to identify problems, take action independently, and continuously improve how work gets done. Strong analytical skills and a data-driven approach to pipeline management, deal qualification, forecasting, and sales performance. Willingness to attend industry events, travel regularly to customers across Europe, and occasionally travel to the United States. Availability to work remotely from a European location within approximately two hours of Central European Time (CET), with flexibility to accommodate regular calls during US business hours. Nice to have: Experience using AI tools to research accounts, personalize outreach, generate pipeline, automate sales workflows, and improve deal execution. Familiarity with HubSpot or comparable CRM and sales pipeline management platforms. A degree in computer science, engineering, or another technical discipline. Previous experience selling compute infrastructure, serverless platforms, sandboxing technologies, databases, Kubernetes tooling, or related developer infrastructure products. Knowledge of the competitive landscape across cloud infrastructure and developer platforms, including solutions such as Modal, E2B, Daytona, Fly.io, Northflank, Vercel, and Firecracker-based platforms. An established network among European platform engineering teams, cloud providers, systems integrators, or infrastructure decision-makers. Experience working with channel partners, resellers, cloud providers, or systems integrators to develop and close opportunities. Previous experience as an early sales hire at a startup, with an appreciation for the ownership, pace, and adaptability required to build a sales function from an early stage. Benefits: Competitive base salary with uncapped commission, providing significant earning potential tied to sales performance. Meaningful equity participation, allowing you to share in the long-term growth of the business. Fully remote working environment within Europe, with a preferred time zone of CET ±2 hours. Direct access to the founding team, including hands-on coaching, technical support during sales conversations, and guidance on complex deals. Opportunity to join an early-stage sales team and help shape the commercial strategy, sales playbook, and future structure of the organization. The chance to sell an established technology already used in production by enterprise customers, with additional opportunities progressing through the pipeline. Exposure to fast-growing markets spanning AI infrastructure, cloud computing, serverless workloads, secure sandboxing, and developer platforms. Close collaboration with technical experts and go-to-market engineers, providing opportunities to deepen your technical knowledge and improve sales effectiveness. Regular opportunities to attend leading industry conferences, cloud-native events, AI infrastructure gatherings, and customer meetings across Europe, with occasional travel to the United States. title: Equipment Engineer - Automation
description: <div class="content-intro"><h2><strong>Brief info about Vinted </strong></h2> <p data-renderer-start-pos="1"><span data-sheets-root="1">Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life – or even a third. <br>The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:<br><br><strong><a href="https://careers.vinted.com/marketplace" target="_blank">Vinted Marketplace</a></strong> is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.<br><br><a href="https://careers.vinted.com/vintedgo" target="_blank"><strong>Vinted Go</strong></a> enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.<br><br><a href="https://careers.vinted.com/vintedpay" target="_blank"><strong>Vinted Pay</strong></a> is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.<br><br>Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people. </span></p></div><h2><strong>Missions and activities of the position</strong></h2> <p><strong>1. Project phase – owner's engineer for Maintenance</strong></p> <ul> <li>Represent Maintenance in every phase of new equipment projects (starting with the MRS1 cross-belt sorter), from design reviews to FAT, SAT, commissioning and ramp-up. For the sorter, whose design is already set, take over the installed system and optimise it after go-live.</li> <li>Work side by side with the OEM / integrator engineers: collect technical knowledge, challenge design choices, maintainability, access, spare-part strategy and the proposed maintenance plan before they are frozen.</li> <li>Define and verify the Maintenance acceptance criteria (documentation, training, spare parts, safety, availability targets). The Maintenance sign-off is mandatory: no handover to operations without it.</li> <li>Track and drive to closure the technical punch list and warranty issues raised during commissioning and the warranty period.<br><br></li> </ul> <p><strong>2. Technical file & spare parts</strong></p> <ul> <li>Build and own the equipment technical file: as-built electrical and mechanical drawings, PLC and software versions, parameter backups, network architecture, safety documentation, OEM manuals.</li> <li>Create the asset hierarchy and criticality analysis in the CMMS.</li> <li>Define the critical spare-parts list (references, min/max stock, lead times) and keep it up to date.</li> <li>Reduce dependency on the OEM: identify and qualify second-source suppliers for critical parts, run compatibility tests and document equivalences.</li> <li>Propose spare-parts and supplier decisions to the Maintenance Manager; after an initial period, take these decisions autonomously within agreed limits, with the Maintenance Manager's validation.<br><br></li> </ul> <p><strong>3. Maintenance strategy & procedures</strong></p> <ul> <li>Write and maintain preventive maintenance plans, corrective procedures and troubleshooting guides for the equipment family, based on OEM data, FMEA and field experience.</li> <li>Monitor equipment performance (availability, MTBF, MTTR, top failure modes), lead root-cause analysis on recurring or major failures and implement permanent corrective actions.</li> <li>Challenge the original design when needed and drive engineering changes: retrofits, drive and firmware updates, software or parameter optimisation, with the OEM and internal stakeholders.<br><br></li> </ul> <p><strong>4. Training & technical support</strong></p> <ul> <li>Train the operational maintenance team (technicians and operatives) on the equipment, its software/HMI and the troubleshooting procedures; validate their autonomy level.</li> <li>Act as the level-2 / level-3 technical expert for the equipment family on site and remotely, across sites.<br><br></li> </ul> <p><strong>5. Escalation, vendor & SLA management</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own technical escalations through to resolution: with the Tetris team (Vinted's internal tools and sorting logic) when the issue is on the software or data side, and with OEM / integrator support (SAV) when it is on the equipment side.</li> <li>Lead the diagnosis that tells which side an issue comes from (equipment, controls, Vinted software), with facts and data.</li> <li>Work within the after-sales and maintenance agreements already in place with OEMs: make the most of them day to day, monitor performance against SLAs and warranty terms, feed lessons learned into future renewals, and provide the technical evidence to the program managers, who own the contractual relationship.</li> <li>Prepare and lead technical review meetings with OEMs and integrators.<br><br></li> </ul> <p><strong>6. Safety & compliance</strong></p> <ul> <li>Ensure the equipment and its maintenance comply with machine safety requirements (CE marking, safety functions, lock-out/tag-out) and site H&S standards.</li> <li>Support safety audits and regulatory inspections, and drive the resulting corrective actions to completion.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Occasional responsibilities</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Take ownership of additional equipment families (e.g. conveyors, AMR fleets, Monk lines) once the cross-belt is stable.</li> <li>Support pre-project technical due diligence on new equipment (specifications, vendor benchmarks, maintainability review).</li> <li>Participate in the hiring and onboarding of maintenance technicians and future engineers.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Interests, constraints, difficulties of the position</strong></h4> <ul> <li>High-visibility role on new strategic automation investments.</li> <li>Site-based in an operational warehouse, with regular presence on the shop floor.</li> <li>Regular travel to MRS1, OEM premises (FAT) and other Vinted Go sites, especially during commissioning.</li> <li>Day-based role, no on-call. Flexibility needed during commissioning, ramp-up and major incidents (possible early, late or weekend work).</li> <li>Needs to influence without authority: OEMs, integrators, IT and program management teams.</li> </ul> <h2><strong> </strong></h2> <h2><strong>Your profile</strong></h2> <p><strong>Knowledge & experience</strong></p> <ul> <li>Engineering degree (Master's / Bac+5) in automation, electrical, mechatronics or industrial engineering, or Bac+2/3 with equivalent proven experience.</li> <li>At least 3 years' experience, ideally 5 or more, as Equipment Engineer, Automation Engineer, Tool Owner or Maintenance/Reliability Engineer in a highly automated environment: parcel sortation and intralogistics, airport baggage handling, logistics or other automated industries.</li> <li>Automation background required.</li> <li>Proven involvement in at least one industrial equipment project from FAT/SAT to ramp-up, working with OEMs or integrators.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Technical skills</strong></p> <ul> <li>Able to read and diagnose complete PLC and HMI programs (Siemens TIA Portal and/or Rockwell, Beckhoff) and to make controlled modifications; industrial networks (Profinet, Profibus, EtherCAT, Ethernet/IP).</li> <li>Drives (parameters, firmware), servo motors, sensors, scanners / DWS, pneumatics; reading electrical and mechanical schematics.</li> <li>Retrofit experience and component qualification (equivalence, compatibility testing)</li> <li>Safety PLCs and machine safety functions.</li> <li>Understanding of the interfaces between equipment controls, SCADA/WCS and IT systems.</li> <li>Reliability methods: FMEA, RCA (5 Why, Ishikawa, 8D), criticality analysis; CMMS and PM planning.</li> <li>Sortation equipment experience (cross-belt, tilt-tray, shoe sorters) is a strong plus.</li> <li>French electrical certification (habilitation électrique BR / B2V / BC) or ability to obtain it.</li> <li>Fluent French and professional English (OEMs and the Vinted Go network work in English).</li> </ul> <p><strong>Behavioural skills</strong></p> <ul> <li>Strong ownership: treats the equipment as their own, from design to end of life.</li> <li>Able to challenge OEM and integrator engineers constructively, with facts and data.</li> <li>Structured and disciplined in documentation.</li> <li>Good teacher: enjoys transferring knowledge to technicians.</li> <li>Calm and solution-oriented under production pressure; strong safety mindset.</li> </ul> <p><em><br>Please note: the main tasks and skills identified and noted in the function described above may need to evolve depending on the constraints and organisation specific to the company and its environment. They are, therefore, indicative and not contractual.</em></p> <h2><strong><br>Working at Vinted </strong></h2> <p><strong>Individual learning budget</strong></p> <p>Each year, you’ll be given a learning budget (starting at €3,000), and a total of up to 10 working days over a 2-year period to support your personal and professional development.</p> <p><strong>Equal opportunity</strong></p> <p>We welcome applications from everybody, regardless of your background, identity, or life experiences. Job openings come with guides, not checklists. If you’re excited about a role, but don’t identify with every point in the ‘About you’ section, apply anyway – you might still be the perfect match!</p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="title">The annual gross salary range for this position is:</div><div class="pay-range"><span>€45.000</span><span class="divider">—</span><span>€60.000 EUR</span></div></div></div> Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Solutions Architect - EMEA
description: <h3><strong>About Us</strong></h3> <p>AI coding is the largest use case of enterprise AI adoption today, as is evident from the success of Anthropic on Claude Code, Cursor’s $60B exit to SpaceX, and Cognition’s $48B valuation.<br><br>The bottleneck now has moved from code generation to security and safety - AI agents write code faster than any team can review it, and over 65% of the lines of code produced by them are insecure. Vulnerabilities are piling up 16x faster than companies can fix them, and adversaries are able to exploit these new vulnerabilities within hours.<br><br>AURI by Endor Labs closes that gap. It runs inside the harness where coding agents work, through hooks, skills and MCP, so the controls sit outside the model and every agent action is visible. Underneath is our patented code context graph, which maps code, open source, containers and infrastructure. It shows which vulnerabilities can actually be reached and exploited, then delivers fixes that won’t break the application. Security teams get evidence instead of noise, and developers get fixes instead of tickets.<br><br>The companies building AI trust us to secure it - our customers include OpenAI, SpaceX, DoorDash, Dropbox, Atlassian, MongoDB, Snowflake, Robinhood and Peloton to name a few.<br><br>Endor Labs is the third company from Founder & CEO Varun Badhwar, who built Prisma Cloud, the platform that helped define cloud security, from $0 to $300M ARR at Palo Alto Networks. We’ve raised $163M from Lightspeed, Coatue, DFJ Growth, Salesforce Ventures and Dell Technologies Capital.<br><br>Software runs everything around our lives today - banking, hospitals, airports and power grids. AI now writes more of it every day, and our mission is to make sure the world can trust that software. Come build that future with us.</p> <h2 id="How-You’ll-Make-an-Impact" data-renderer-start-pos="876"><strong data-renderer-mark="true"><u data-renderer-mark="true">How You’ll Make an Impact</u></strong></h2> <p>As a Solutions Architect at Endor Labs, you're at the heart of connecting our innovative team with our diverse and dynamic customers. Every day presents a new set of exciting challenges and opportunities to make a significant impact:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Educate with Enthusiasm:</strong> Elevate awareness about Application Security and Software Supply Chain Security. It's about making security engaging and accessible to developers everywhere.</li> <li><strong>Master Our Tech:</strong> Deep dive into our supply chain security product suite and emerge as the go-to expert and evangelist.</li> <li><strong>Deliver Tailored Demos:</strong> Showcase our solutions in a way that speaks directly to the needs and challenges of our customers. Be the architect of captivating, solution-oriented presentations.</li> <li><strong>Shape Customer Outcomes:</strong> Collaborate with our engineering and product teams to design solutions that genuinely address customer challenges. Your insights from the field will directly influence our product development, ensuring we always meet our customers' evolving needs.</li> <li><strong>Facilitate Customer Success:</strong> Guide customers through onboarding, ensuring a smooth transition and adoption of the Endor Labs solution. Your goal is to empower customers to leverage our technology fully and ensure they achieve their security and development objectives.</li> </ul> <h2><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>What You Bring to the Table</strong></span></h2> <p>We're on the hunt for someone who is not just looking for a job but likes a bit of adventure, too! You'll fit right in if you have:</p> <ul> <li data-section-id="poqw43" data-start="297" data-end="491"><strong data-start="299" data-end="319">Rich Experience:</strong> You have experience in pre-sales or a similar customer-facing, technical role. You're no stranger to technical deep dives, product demonstrations, and leading evaluations.</li> <li data-section-id="hrgdhb" data-start="493" data-end="841"><strong data-start="495" data-end="527">Strong Technical Foundation:</strong> A solid understanding of modern software development practices, including backend or full-stack development experience, CI/CD pipelines, Git-based development workflows, and DevOps tooling. You’re comfortable engaging deeply with engineering teams and understanding how modern applications are built and deployed.</li> <li data-section-id="44alsd" data-start="843" data-end="1108"><strong data-start="845" data-end="880">Application Security Awareness:</strong> Familiarity with application security concepts, software supply chain security, and/or identity & access management principles. You understand the importance of securing developer workflows and modern cloud-native environments.</li> <li data-section-id="xiq5d5" data-start="1110" data-end="1310"><strong data-start="1112" data-end="1127">Tech Savvy:</strong> A robust understanding of the Developer, DevOps, Application Security, and open-source ecosystems. Hopefully, you can meet developers where they are and flex some programming skills.</li> <li data-section-id="otuo74" data-start="1312" data-end="1493"><strong data-start="1314" data-end="1342">Customer & Sales Skills:</strong> You've successfully engaged with technical customers at an Enterprise level and know how to articulate complex solutions and operate in a sales cycle.</li> <li data-section-id="roopa0" data-start="1495" data-end="1625"><strong data-start="1497" data-end="1528">Curious and Eager to Learn:</strong> Always on the lookout for new technologies and understanding the intricacies of how things work.</li> <li data-section-id="12ecp9k" data-start="1627" data-end="1739"><strong data-start="1629" data-end="1654">Collaborative Spirit:</strong> You thrive in a team setting and value diversity and inclusion in every interaction.</li> <li data-section-id="25v10y" data-start="1741" data-end="1840"><strong data-start="1743" data-end="1763">Action-oriented:</strong> You prefer actively solving customer problems and asking for help as needed.</li> </ul> <h2><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>What Makes Us... Us</strong></span></h2> <ul> <li>Go to extraordinary lengths to distinguish ourselves through world-class work.</li> <li>Prioritize quality over speed, and speed over scope.</li> <li>Desire to work with deeply kind, mission-driven people.</li> <li>Strive to make the complex simple.</li> <li>Use first principles to debate ideas, test assumptions, and make decisions.</li> <li>Seek the truth by putting data above opinions.</li> <li>Assume good intent and give tactical feedback to help each other get better.</li> <li>Hold no ego—when our customers win, we all win.</li> </ul> <h2><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>What We Offer You</strong></span></h2> <ul> <li>Competitive salary and comprehensive benefits package including Health, Dental, Vision and Mental Health plans. </li> <li>401(k) plan to support your longterm financial goals.</li> <li>Flexible PTO to maintain a healthy work-life balance (we want you here for the long-haul!)</li> <li>Opportunities for co-working and team meetups to foster collaboration.</li> <li>A dog-friendly office environment for those who love to bring their fur babies along.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Endor Labs is an Equal Opportunity Employer.</strong> We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Even if you don't fit every requirement above, we believe in the power of diverse perspectives and experiences, so we encourage all talented individuals to apply—there's no one-size-fits-all here.</p> <p data-renderer-start-pos="4857"><strong data-renderer-mark="true">Compensation: </strong>For candidates who receive an offer for this position, the compensation range is expected to be between $190,000 - $250,000. This may include additional incentives such as commission targets, restricted stock units, and/or bonuses, depending on the role.</p> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Conseiller(ère) commercial(e) terrain expérimenté(e) Freelance
description: Conseiller(ère) commercial(e) terrain expérimenté(e) Indépendant | Rémunération à la commission uniquement | Territoire de vente local | Commissions déplafonnées À propos de l'opportunité Nous recherchons des commerciaux terrain expérimentés, à l'aise pour se rendre dans une entreprise, engager la conversation avec le propriétaire et convaincre de nouveaux commerçants. En tant que conseiller commercial itinérant indépendant, vous vendrez les solutions de paiement, de point de vente et logicielles de SumUp aux petites et moyennes entreprises de votre région. Vous identifierez vous-même vos prospects, gérerez votre portefeuille d'opportunités et accompagnerez les clients lors de leur mise en route. Vous devrez justifier d'une expérience en prospection à froid et apprécier la vente en face à face sur le terrain. Vous gérerez votre propre activité et organiserez vos démarches commerciales de manière autonome, tout en bénéficiant de la formation et du soutien de SumUp. Vos missions Trouver de nouveaux clients grâce à des visites en face à face, de la prospection en porte-à-porte et des démarches directes. Cibler les entreprises locales générant d'importants volumes de paiement et susceptibles de tirer parti des produits SumUp. Poser des questions sur le fonctionnement de chaque entreprise et recommander des solutions adaptées en matière de paiement, de matériel, de caisse et de logiciels. Gérer le processus de vente depuis le premier échange, en passant par les démonstrations de produits, la gestion des objections et la conclusion, dans le cadre du partenariat. Aider les clients à mettre en place et à commencer à utiliser leurs produits SumUp. Établir des relations avec les chefs d'entreprise et demander des recommandations aux clients satisfaits. Planifier vos visites et vos suivis afin d'optimiser votre temps sur le terrain. Suivre votre activité, vos opportunités et vos résultats de vente, et transmettre les informations nécessaires au traitement des ventes. Échanger avec votre interlocuteur SumUp pour bénéficier de son expertise produit et de conseils commerciaux. Ce que nous recherchons Indispensable Au moins un an d'expérience dans la vente sur le terrain dans des secteurs tels que les télécommunications, l'énergie, les technologies d'entreprise, la gestion des déchets, les systèmes de sécurité ou l'approvisionnement en produits alimentaires et boissons. Une expérience de la prospection à froid, notamment en démarchant des entreprises en face à face et en trouvant vos propres prospects. Une expérience de la vente auprès de petites et moyennes entreprises et des relations directes avec les propriétaires ou les décideurs. Des résultats démontrables en matière d'acquisition de nouveaux clients et d'atteinte d'objectifs commerciaux. Nous vous demanderons des exemples de vos réalisations et de la manière dont vous y êtes parvenu. La capacité à gérer un processus de vente de la première prise de contact à la conclusion, y compris la gestion des questions et des objections. Un bon sens de l'organisation et un suivi rigoureux. La capacité à gérer les refus, à tirer les leçons des retours d'expérience et à persévérer. Une bonne compréhension du statut d'indépendant et la volonté de développer votre portefeuille de clients. La capacité à vous déplacer sur votre territoire de vente afin de rencontrer régulièrement vos prospects et clients. Atouts Un réseau existant de chefs d'entreprise locaux susceptibles de bénéficier des produits SumUp. Une expérience dans le domaine des paiements, des services aux commerçants ou des systèmes de point de vente. Une expérience de la vente par téléphone est un atout, mais vous devez également avoir vendu en face à face sur le terrain. Rémunération Il s'agit d'une activité indépendante, rémunérée exclusivement à la commission, sans salaire de base ni revenu minimum garanti. Les commissions sont déplafonnées et dépendent de vos résultats commerciaux et de l'activité des commerçants apportés. Le système de commissions comprend, dans le cadre des conditions Partner : Paiements : 50 % du revenu net annualisé lié aux transactions. Matériel : 50 % du prix de vente retenu dans le barème. Logiciels et abonnements : 50 % du montant annuel retenu dans le barème. Revenu résiduel : 20 % du revenu net mensuel généré par les commerçants apportés, pendant une durée maximale de trois ans. Avantage de bienvenue : trois fois le montant habituel des commissions résiduelles pendant les trois premiers mois. Primes supplémentaires liées à certains produits ou opérations commerciales. Les nouveaux partenaires bénéficient des conditions Partner pendant la période de lancement. Leur maintien est ensuite soumis aux critères d'activité du programme ; un barème Agent de 40 %, sans commissions résiduelles, peut s'appliquer. Les conditions d'éligibilité, les bases de calcul et les modalités de versement sont précisées dans le contrat et présentées avant tout engagement. Les commissions s'entendent avant déduction de vos frais professionnels, cotisations sociales et impôts applicables. Formation et accompagnement Nous vous aiderons à vous familiariser avec les produits et leur commercialisation grâce à un parcours initial et à un accompagnement continu couvrant la prospection, les entretiens de vente, les démonstrations, la gestion des objections et l'accompagnement des clients. Les modalités du parcours initial et les prérequis à la commercialisation vous seront communiqués avant le démarrage. Votre interlocuteur SumUp vous apportera également son soutien en matière de développement territorial, d'analyse de vos opportunités et de conseils commerciaux, dans le respect de votre autonomie d'organisation. Job Application Tip We recognise that candidates feel they need to meet 100% of the job criteria in order to apply for a job. Please note that this is only a guide. If you don't tick every box, it's ok too because it means you have room to learn and develop your career at SumUp. Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Deal Desk Manager, APAC
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h4><strong>About the Deal Desk Team</strong></h4> <p>The Deal Desk team is a critical component of the Finance function, serving as a trusted advisor to critical internal stakeholders as deal architect working on structuring, negotiating, approving and closing large complex commitment deals while balancing margin preservation, compliance, and velocity. We are committed to building a data-centric and AI-augmented Deal Desk that leverages predictive analytics and automated workflows to optimize pricing in real-time and automate routine approvals, allowing for deeper strategic focus.</p> <p><strong>Available Location: Singapore</strong></p> <p><strong>Role Summary</strong></p> <p>As a Deal Desk Manager, you will be the architect of our AI-driven deal desk, transitioning our sales process from manual workflows to an intelligent, automated engine that spans from initial scoping to final execution. By leveraging agentic workflows and automated data layers, the focus shifts to high-judgment architecture for non-standard enterprise deals. The objective is to serve as a high-influence "Sales Co-pilot," using AI-driven insights to maximize deal velocity and Long-Term Value (LTV) while relentlessly reducing friction through iterative process automation.</p> <p><strong>What you’ll do</strong></p> <ul> <li>Orchestrate Strategic Deal Architecture: Lead the structuring and execution of non-standard, high-value enterprise deals, providing high-judgment guidance that balances competitive differentiation with long-term business health. Build creative financial models and custom discount strategies that align customer usage patterns with corporate revenue goals.</li> <li>Sales Co-pilot & Strategic Influence: Serve as a strategic partner to Sales leadership, utilizing data driven insights and workflows to maximize deal velocity, improve LTV, and ensure discovery reflects true customer needs. Perform analysis on pricing and deal terms, leveraging AI insights to recommend "next best action" for deal structuring and margin optimization. Drive consensus across internal stakeholders (Legal, Finance, Revenue Recognition, Compliance and Product) to negotiate viable compromises on non-standard commercial, financial, and legal terms while safeguarding corporate margin thresholds and risk tolerance.</li> <li>Champion AI, Curate and Tune AI Agents for Automation Integration: Manage the enterprise deal approval ecosystem by tuning automated agents and models to ensure compliance and accuracy at scale. Champion the integration of LLMs and generative AI tools to automate deal desk workflows, significantly reducing deal cycle times. Identify bottlenecks and implement AI-powered productivity solutions.</li> <li>Drive Process Iteration: Partner with cross-functional teams (Legal, Finance, Product) to build, streamline, and automate deal desk processes, architecting autonomous approval workflows and focusing on reducing field friction through relentless automation.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Role Specifications & Qualifications</strong></p> <ul> <li>Minimum 8+ years of Deal Desk, FP&A, Revenue Operations, or similar experience with a proven track record supporting large-scale enterprise sales motions; 3+ years of direct deal desk experience (deal analysis, deal governance and customer negotiation) preferred</li> <li><strong>Financial & Sales Acumen: </strong>Solid understanding of SaaS metrics, pricing models, and financial concepts like ARR, Gross Margin, churn, and profitability. Experience with revenue recognition principles (e.g., ASC 606) is highly desirable. Experience selling software is a bonus</li> <li><strong>Contract & Pricing Knowledge: </strong>Experience drafting and interpreting commercial contracts, with a focus on terms that impact revenue recognition and financial risk. Ability to analyze and recommend the best course of action for complex pricing and licensing situations</li> <li><strong>Data & AI Literacy: </strong>Proficiency in leveraging agentic workflows and prompt engineering to scale influence, extract insights from large datasets, and automate repetitive operational tasks and internal documentation. Ability to understand and audit automated pricing models to ensure alignment with long-term company goals.Relentless focus on iterative automation and translating complex business policies into streamlined, automated logic</li> <li><strong>Strategic Influence & Negotiation: </strong>Demonstrated ability to navigate complex, internal cross-functional negotiations and make high-judgment decisions in fast-paced environments. Partner directly with Sales Management and Account Executives  during external customer negotiations, equipping them with counter-proposal options or directly engaging in client commercial discussions to structure win-win enterprise agreements</li> <li><strong>Communication: </strong>Serve as the single point of contact between Sales, Finance, Revenue Recognition (ASC 606), Legal, and Product Management on advising deal constructing and managing deal escalation. Skilled in commercial negotiation strategy, advising Sales on customer-facing concessions, and directly engaging in external negotiations with customer procurement/legal teams to drive deal closure. Exceptional written and oral communication skills, capable of explaining complex deal structures and financial data to both technical and executive stakeholders</li> <li>Language Preference: Additional proficiency in Mandarin or Japanese would be beneficial for engaging with customers and stakeholders in relevant APJC markets.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of?
