title: Product Designer (temporary)
description: We’re looking for an experienced Product Designer, to temporarily support our team (+/- 6 months). In this role you are responsible for ensuring that Assai products solve meaningful customer problems while delivering intuitive, efficient and engaging user experiences. You combine customer research, product discovery, UX design and UI design to shape products from concept through delivery and continuous improvement. Working closely with Product Managers, customers and engineers, you translate customer needs and business objectives into coherent product experiences and measurable outcomes. You contribute to developing, shaping and articulating product vision, strategy, objectives and goals. Through customer interviews, contextual inquiry, workflow analysis, usability testing and product data, you identify unmet needs, validate assumptions and provide evidence that informs product priorities and decisions. You create and validate user journeys, information architectures, interaction models, prototypes, design systems and visual interfaces. You champion customer-centered thinking and help establish consistent research, discovery and design practices across Assai. What you'll do As a Product Designer, you’ll help shape complex enterprise products from early discovery through to production. You’ll work closely with customers, Product Management and Engineering to understand real-world needs, turn insights into clear product experiences, and make sure those experiences are both useful and practical to build. You’ll lead and contribute to customer research, product discovery and design activities, using interviews, usability testing, prototypes and other methods to uncover opportunities and test ideas before significant development investment. You’ll translate what you learn into user flows, information architectures, wireframes, interfaces and prototypes, continuously refining your designs based on evidence and feedback. Together with Product Managers, you’ll help shape product vision, strategy and priorities, bringing the customer perspective into roadmap and investment decisions. You’ll facilitate workshops and discovery sessions and help define meaningful user outcomes and measures of success. You’ll also help maintain and evolve Assai’s design system, ensuring a consistent, accessible and high-quality experience across the product. Working closely with Engineering, you’ll provide clear design guidance and help ensure the final implementation matches the intended experience. Key responsibilities include: Designing coherent end-to-end experiences for complex enterprise workflows, from concept to production. Planning and conducting customer research, synthesizing insights into actionable product opportunities. Collaborating with Product and Engineering to shape product direction, priorities and outcomes. Evolving the design system, interaction patterns and visual language while maintaining accessibility and usability. Advocating for customer-centered, evidence-based design and sharing knowledge across the organization. What you bring You’re an experienced Product Designer who enjoys getting to the heart of complex problems. You combine strong design craft with curiosity about customers, products and technology, and you’re comfortable moving between research, discovery, strategy and hands-on design. You have at least five years of experience in Product Design, UX Design or a similar role, ideally working on complex enterprise or SaaS products. A degree in Product Design, Interaction Design, UX, HCI, Psychology or a related field is helpful, but equivalent practical experience is equally valuable. You understand how to turn customer needs and evidence into meaningful product opportunities. You’re comfortable planning and conducting research, facilitating workshops, exploring ideas through prototypes and testing concepts with users. You can translate these insights into clear, intuitive experiences and work with Product Managers to connect design decisions to product strategy and outcomes. You’re also a strong hands-on designer. You have solid skills in interaction and visual design, information architecture and prototyping, and you know how to create and maintain design systems and reusable components. You’re highly proficient in Figma and familiar with modern product design and research tools. An understanding of front-end development, responsive design and component-based frameworks such as Material UI is a plus. Just as important, you enjoy working with people. You communicate clearly, tell compelling stories and can bring customers, stakeholders, Product and Engineering together around a shared understanding. You’re curious, pragmatic and comfortable taking ownership, while knowing when to collaborate and ask for input. In particular, we’re looking for someone who can: Combine customer insight with strong design craft to create thoughtful, effective product experiences. Work strategically and hands-on , from product discovery and research through to detailed interface design and implementation. Collaborate confidently with Product, Engineering, customers and stakeholders in an agile, international environment. Champion evidence-based design , using research and experimentation to help teams make better product decisions. Communicate and influence , sharing your thinking clearly and helping others grow their understanding of customer-centered design. Why join Assai? At Assai, you'll become part of an ambitious international software company where your ideas matter. We’re looking for someone to temporarily support our team. This role is open to both employment and freelance arrangements and we are happy to discuss the option that best fits your experience, preferences and the needs of the role. We offer: A meaningful role with real business impact. An international, collaborative working environment. Possibility to work partly from home (40%), we expect 3 days in the office in Culemborg (or Amsterdam); 32-40 hours per week Plenty of room for personal and professional development. Relocation and/or Visa are not supported for this role Please note that a Certificate of Conduct (VOG) is required for his role. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: AI Governance Specialist
description: Als AI Governance Specialist maak je samen met twee Data Governance Specialisten deel van het Data & AI Office binnen de Digital Strategy, Architecture & Innovation afdeling. Wat je over ons moet weten? Wij zijn Athora Netherlands, een verzekeringsbedrijf met de bekende merken Zwitserleven en Reaal. Wij houden ons voornamelijk bezig met pensioenen en levensverzekeringen op de Nederlandse markt. Dat doen wij als onderdeel van een Europese groep met vestigingen in Ierland, het Verenigd Koninkrijk, België, Duitsland en Italië. Wij zijn een sterk bedrijf met ruim één miljoen klanten en wij willen de komende jaren doorgroeien tot een van de belangrijkste spelers in de snel veranderende pensioenmarkt. Daarom zoeken wij mensen die niet terugdeinzen voor verandering, die van aanpakken weten, die de ambitie hebben om resultaten neer te zetten en die daarom het beste uit zichzelf en hun team weten te halen. Slimmer samen, noemen wij dat. Wat ga je doen? De Digitale Strategie, Architectuur & Innovatie afdeling bestaat uit ongeveer 20 leergierige en ervaren professionals en is naast data management verantwoordelijk voor enterprise en domeinarchitectuur, AI en innovatie. Je werkt op de scheidslijn van data, business en IT aan de toekomst van Athora en haar grote ambities om dè data driven digitale pensioenverzekeraar van Nederland te worden. AI Governance is op dit moment sterk in beweging in de markt en ook binnen Athora. Het bestaande AI Governance raamwerk staat, maar wordt de komende jaren verder ontwikkeld en geprofessionaliseerd. Als AI Governance Specialist speel jij een sleutelrol in deze ontwikkeling binnen een van de meest dynamische vakgebieden van dit moment. De AI Governance Specialist zorgt ervoor dat Athora AI verantwoord, waardevol, beheerst, en in lijn met wet- en regelgeving toepast. Je bent de spil tussen business, innovatie, risk, compliance, security, architectuur en technologie en draagt bij aan werkbare kaders, richtlijnen en beheersmaatregelen die teams direct ondersteunen bij het ontwikkelen en toepassen van AI. Belangrijkste werkzaamheden: - Adviseren van business- en IT-teams over de verantwoorde inzet van AI en passende AI-governance. - Faciliteren en coördineren van AI-governance processen en besluitvorming. - Beheren en verder ontwikkelen van het AI-register. - Ontwikkelen van praktische richtlijnen, standaarden en governance patronen die teams ondersteunen bij de toepassing van AI. - Uitvoeren en begeleiden van AI Impact Assessments en risicobeoordelingen. - Monitoren van AI-initiatieven op waardecreatie en naleving van beleid, risico's en beheersmaatregelen. - Rapporteren over de status van AI-governance, risico's en verbeteracties. - Bijdragen aan bewustwording, training en adoptie van verantwoord AI-gebruik binnen de organisatie. - Regie voeren op de verdere ontwikkeling en implementatie van het AI Governance Framework binnen Athora. #LI_DNI Wat vragen we van jou? - WO-werk- en denkniveau. - Minimaal 3 jaar relevante werkervaring op het gebied van AI, AI-governance, data governance, IT-governance, IT-audit of een vergelijkbaar vakgebied. - Kennis van en interesse in moderne AI-toepassingen, waaronder generatieve AI en AI-agents die zelfstandig acties uitvoeren binnen bedrijfsprocessen. Je begrijpt de specifieke governance-uitdagingen rondom transparantie, monitoring, beheersing en menselijk toezicht. - Kennis van relevante wet- en regelgeving, zoals de EU AI Act, AVG/GDPR en governance- en risicomanagementprincipes. - Uitstekende communicatieve vaardigheden en het vermogen om stakeholders vanuit verschillende disciplines mee te nemen. - Een proactieve en pragmatische instelling: je weet governance te vertalen naar werkbare oplossingen die innovaties ondersteunen zonder onnodige complexiteit toe te voegen. - Kennis van informatiebeveiliging en privacy is een pré. - Sterke analytische vaardigheden en het vermogen om risico's, impact en afhankelijkheden inzichtelijk te maken. - Overtuigingskracht en verandervermogen om governance effectief in de organisatie te verankeren. Wat krijg je van ons? Je krijgt pakweg 900 collega's die allemaal vinden dat ze bij een bijzonder bedrijf werken. Je krijgt de mogelijkheid om een belangrijke bijdrage te leveren aan het maatschappelijk relevante thema van pensioenen. Wij zorgen ervoor dat je pensioen goed geregeld is, zodat je zorgeloos kan genieten van je oude dag. Jij krijgt de kans om echt het verschil te maken als het gaat om duurzaamheid, omdat we in onze bedrijfsvoering en onze beleggingen al jaren de toon aangeven. Uiteraard krijg je een (flexibele) werkplek op ons kantoor in Amsterdam dat behoort tot de beste 7% van de wereld, echt waar. En omdat je ook regelmatig thuis zult werken, ontvang je een budget om je thuiswerkplek goed in te richten. In ruil voor jouw inzet, talent en vaardigheden krijg je naast je salaris plus een vakantietoeslag en een dertiende maand, 27 vakantiedagen (bij een contract van 36 uur) en een OV-kaart of reiskostenvergoeding voor de dagen dat je naar kantoor komt. En, niet onbelangrijk vinden wij, krijg je een goed opleidingsbudget, zodat je jezelf kunt blijven ontwikkelen. Zo krijg je de kans om door te groeien, binnen ons bedrijf of daarbuiten. Salaris per maand: Op basis van cao schaal 16 HAY is de range € 5.082,02 tot € 6.776,03 op basis van 36 uur. Enthousiast? Reageer dan snel via de sollicitatie button! title: Quereinsteiger Qualitätssicherung & Passformprüfung (m/w/d)
description: Mode ist unsere Leidenschaft - und das bereits seit über 55 Jahren. Saison für Saison entwickeln wir als familiengeführte Unternehmensgruppe erfolgreiche Kollektionen, die inzwischen in über 70 Ländern und 15.000 Schuhgeschäften zu finden sind. Unsere Maxime lautet: Immer ein bisschen mehr tun als der Wettbewerb, Dinge ausprobieren, ausgetretene Pfade vermeiden und die Bodenhaftung nicht verlieren. Du übernimmst die Verantwortung für die Sicherheitsarchitektur unserer providerseitigen Infrastrukturschicht und bist Fachexperte (m/w/d) für die intern betriebenen KI-Plattformen und -Agenten. Dabei stellst Du sicher, dass diese in einem sicheren, verwalteten und auditierbaren Zustand laufen, anstatt sich schleichend als neue Klasse von privilegierten Zugriffen anzuhäufen. Dies ist eine praxisnahe Expertenrolle. Du setzt Standards, prüfst Designs auf Herz und Nieren und arbeitest direkt mit Plattform- und Engineering-Teams über all unsere Marken hinweg zusammen, um diese umzusetzen. Aufgabenbereich Infrastruktursicherheit Definieren und Pflegen von Sicherheitsarchitektur-Standards und Härtungs-Baselines für providerseitige Infrastruktur: Virtualisierungs- und Container-Plattformen, Control Planes und Bereitstellungssysteme, DNS, Mail-Infrastruktur sowie Backup- und Wiederherstellungssysteme. Bewerten und Stärken der Mandantenisolierung über Shared-Hosting-, Virtualisierungs- und Container-Schichten hinweg sowie Treiben von Behebungsmaßnahmen mit den verantwortlichen Plattform-Teams. Überprüfen von Infrastruktur-Designs und wesentlichen Änderungen auf Sicherheitsauswirkungen sowie Agieren als Eskalationsinstanz für Fragen zur Infrastruktursicherheit aus Plattform-, Cloud- und Marken-Engineering-Teams. Reduzieren des Blast Radius auf den wichtigsten Pfaden: privilegierter Zugriff auf kundenorientierte Infrastruktur, administrative Segmentierung, Umgang mit Secrets und Wiederherstellungsintegrität — übersetzt in umsetzbare markenspezifische Implementierungspläne für unsere heterogenen Plattformen. Unterstützen von Cyber Defense, Vulnerability Management und IT-Notfallmanagement mit Infrastruktur-Expertise bei Vorfällen und der Nachbereitung/Härtung. Interne KI-Plattform- und Agentensicherheit Verantwortung für die Sicherheitsarchitektur und Baseline-Standards für die intern betriebenen KI-Plattformen: Modell-Gateways und self-hosted Modelle, Agenten-Frameworks, Assistenten-Integrationen, Konnektoren und Retrieval-Pipelines über interne Daten. Definieren und Durchsetzen, wie Agenten identifiziert, authentifiziert und autorisiert werden: Umgang mit nicht-menschlichen Identitäten, Credential- und Token-Management, Least-Privilege-Zugriff auf Tools und Systeme sowie Festlegung, wo autonomes Handeln ein Human-in-the-Loop erfordert. Festlegen, welche Daten interne KI-Systeme aufrufen und indexieren dürfen, sowie Sicherstellen, dass Agentenaktivitäten protokolliert, zuordenbar und überprüfbar sind — entsprechend den Anforderungen unserer regulatorischen Verpflichtungen und Zertifizierungen. Durchführen von Pre-Deployment-Sicherheitsprüfungen für neue interne KI-Plattformen und Agenten-Anwendungsfälle im Einklang mit dem schnellen Tempo der Adaption sowie Überblicken von ungesicherter/unsanktionierter KI-Nutzung (Shadow AI). Beraten der Sicherheitsfunktionen und internen Engineering-Teams bei der sicheren Einführung von KI, einschließlich der Schutzplanken (Guardrails), die eine vertretbare Einführung ermöglichen. Qualifikationen Mehrjährige praktische Erfahrung in der Infrastruktur- oder Plattform-Sicherheit, idealerweise bei einem Hosting-Anbieter, Cloud-Anbieter, Telekommunikationsunternehmen oder in einer vergleichbar großen Mandantenumgebung. Tiefes praktisches Wissen über Linux, Virtualisierungs- und Container-Plattformen, Netzwerke und die Sicherheitseigenschaften von Mandanten-Infrastrukturen. Starker Hintergrund im Bereich Identity & Access: Privileged Access, Maschinen- und Workload-Identitäten, Secrets Management, Autorisierungsmodelle und Infrastructure-as-Code-Sicherheit. Erfahrung in der Entwicklung und Durchsetzung von Sicherheitsstandards in einer heterogenen, teils historisch gewachsenen Landschaft sowie bei der Akzeptanzgewinnung in Teams außerhalb der eigenen Führungslinie. Praktische Kenntnisse im Aufbau und Betrieb von LLM- und Agenten-Systemen sowie der spezifischen Risiken: Prompt Injection durch unvertraute Daten, zu weit gefasste Tool-Zugriffe, Datenexposition durch Retrieval, unprotokolliertes autonomes Handeln, Modell- und Anbieterabhängigkeiten. Fähigkeit, risikobasierte Entscheidungen zu treffen und zu verteidigen — einschließlich des Blockierens von Deployments mit klarer Begründung — sowie technisches Risiko gegenüber nicht-technischen Stakeholdern verständlich zu erklären. Fließende Englischkenntnisse; Deutschkenntnisse sind aufgrund unseres regulatorischen Umfelds und des öffentlichen Sektors von starkem Vorteil. Wünschenswert / Von Vorteil Praktische Erfahrung beim Deployment oder der Absicherung interner KI-Plattformen, Agenten-Frameworks oder Tool-Calling-Integrationen in einer Produktionsumgebung. Vertrautheit mit NIS2 / BSIG oder ISO 27001. Hintergrund in DNS, E-Mail-Infrastruktur oder plattformnaher Missbrauchsbekämpfung (Abuse). Erfahrung in einem Multimarken- oder Post-Acquisition-Umfeld, in dem dieselbe Control in verschiedenen Implementierungen umgesetzt werden muss. Hintergrund in Security Engineering oder Softwareentwicklung (Automatisierung, Tooling, Scripting). Wer zu uns passt Jemand, der sich wohl damit fühlt, bei bestimmten Fragestellungen die/der einzige Expert*in im Raum zu sein, der lieber Ursachen behebt als nur Befunde zu dokumentieren, und der über Sicherheitsfunktionen und Plattform-Teams hinweg agieren kann. Du solltest echtes Interesse an KI-Systemen als Engineering-Artefakte mitbringen, nicht nur als Richtlinienthema — ein Großteil dieser Praxis entsteht gerade erst, und Du wirst unsere mitgestalten. Benefits Hybrides Arbeitsmodell. Flexible Arbeitszeiten durch Vertrauensarbeitszeit. An einigen Standorten eine bezuschusste Kantine und verschiedene kostenfreie Getränke. Moderne Büroflächen mit sehr guter Verkehrsanbindung. Diverse Mitarbeiterrabatte für Aktivitäten und Produkte. Mitarbeiterevents wie Sommer- und Winterfeiern, sowie Workshops. Zahlreiche Weiterbildungs- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten. Verschiedene Gesundheitsangebote, wie Sport- und Gesundheitskurse. description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About IonQ: </strong><strong><br></strong></p> <p><u><a href="https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fionq.com%2F&esheet=54451094&newsitemid=20260316477473&lan=en-US&anchor=IonQ%2C+Inc&index=7&md5=0818ffbedc6dbad8c4d1611ac94c2a0f" target="_blank">IonQ, Inc</a></u>. [NYSE: IONQ] is the world’s leading quantum platform and merchant supplier - delivering integrated quantum solutions across computing, networking, sensing, and security. IonQ’s newest generation of quantum computers, the IonQ Tempo, is the latest in a line of cutting-edge systems that have been helping customers and partners including <u><a href="https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fionq.com%2Fnews%2Fionq-speeds-quantum-accelerated-drug-development-application-with&esheet=54451094&newsitemid=20260316477473&lan=en-US&anchor=Amazon+Web+Services%2C&index=8&md5=a7f94ee9b71a392dca3cd6c413722e51" target="_blank">Amazon Web Services, </a></u><u><a href="https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fionq.com%2Fnews%2Fionq-speeds-quantum-accelerated-drug-development-application-with&esheet=54451094&newsitemid=20260316477473&lan=en-US&anchor=and&index=9&md5=2bed627b388878763f41ffe0e4edb16c" target="_blank">and </a></u><u><a href="https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fionq.com%2Fnews%2Fionq-speeds-quantum-accelerated-drug-development-application-with&esheet=54451094&newsitemid=20260316477473&lan=en-US&anchor=AstraZeneca&index=10&md5=757c1f2c2ec94cf3982700106122164f" target="_blank">AstraZeneca</a></u> achieve 20x performance results and accelerate innovation in drug discovery, materials science, financial modeling, logistics, cybersecurity, and defense. In 2025, the company achieved 99.99% two-qubit gate fidelity, <u><a href="https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fionq.com%2Fnews%2Fionq-achieves-landmark-result-setting-new-world-record-in-quantum-computing&esheet=54451094&newsitemid=20260316477473&lan=en-US&anchor=setting+a+world+record+in+quantum+computing+performance&index=11&md5=32e9cb88afbd439026a352666cc72c91" target="_blank">setting a world record in quantum computing performance</a></u>.<br><br>Headquartered in College Park, Maryland, IonQ has operations in California, Colorado, Massachusetts, Tennessee, Washington, Italy, South Korea, Sweden, Switzerland, Canada, and the United Kingdom. Our quantum computing services are available through all major cloud providers, while we also meet the needs of networking and sensing customers across land, sea, air, and space. IonQ is making quantum platforms more accessible and impactful than ever before.  </p></div><p><strong>Location:</strong> This role is based onsite in Geneva, Switzerland.<br><strong>Travel:</strong> <strong><br>Job ID:</strong> 1917 </p> <p><strong>The Role: <br></strong></p> <p>We are looking for a Staff QA Engineer to join our team building post-quantum cryptography (PQC) hardware acceleration for HSM and network-appliance products. You will own product-level quality assurance: the system test plans, automation and compliance test execution that stand between an engineering release and a product customers can trust. In a security product, QA is not an afterthought; it is part of the evidence.</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities</strong>:</p> <p></p> <p>You will define and execute system-level test plans for FPGA-based cryptographic products: functional, performance, stress, stability and negative testing across the full stack, from hardware through firmware and drivers to cryptographic APIs. You will build and maintain the automated QA infrastructure (regression suites, hardware-in-the-loop test benches, CI integration, results dashboards), execute standards-based compliance test campaigns (NIST ACVP/CAVP test vectors, FIPS 140-3 evidence runs, CNSA 2.0 checklists and standard FPGA compliance tests) together with our verification and security engineers, run interoperability testing against protocol stacks and customer-representative configurations, own defect tracking and triage, and define the release-qualification criteria for every product release.</p> <ul> <li>Own system-level QA of cryptographic hardware products: test plans, automation, execution and release qualification</li> <li>Execute standards and compliance test campaigns (ACVP/CAVP vectors, FIPS 140-3 evidence, CNSA 2.0 and FPGA compliance tests) as part of the certification effort</li> </ul> <p></p> <p><strong>Requirements:</strong></p> <p></p> <p>We are looking for a candidate with a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering or a related field (or equivalent experience) and at least five years in quality assurance or system test of embedded, hardware or networking products. You have built test automation in Python or similar, integrated it into CI, and worked hands-on with lab equipment and hardware-in-the-loop setups.</p> <p>Exposure to security or compliance testing (FIPS, Common Criteria, or telecom/industrial certification regimes) is a strong plus, as is experience testing cryptographic or networking functionality. You are rigorous, methodical and precise in documentation, because in this product your test reports become certification evidence. Fluency in English is required; French or German is an advantage.</p> <ul> <li>Experienced system-test/QA engineer for embedded or hardware products with strong automation skills</li> <li>Compliance or security test experience and meticulous documentation habits are strong advantages</li> </ul> <p><strong>Preferred Qualifications:</strong></p> <p>You take professional pride in being the last line of defence before a release, you like breaking things methodically so customers never do, and you enjoy the extra weight QA carries when the product is a security device.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p>Compensation will vary based on individual factors such as education, qualifications, and experience of the final candidate(s), specific office location, and calibration against relevant market data and internal team equity. Posted base salary figures are subject to change as new market data becomes available. Our benefits include comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans, matching 401(k), unlimited PTO and paid holidays, parental/adoption leave, legal insurance, and a home technology stipend. Details of participation in these benefit plans will be provided when a candidate receives an offer of employment. </p> <p>At IonQ, we believe in fair treatment, access, opportunity, and advancement for all while striving to identify and eliminate barriers. We empower employees to thrive by fostering a culture of autonomy, productivity, and respect. We are dedicated to creating an environment where individuals can feel welcomed, respected, supported, and valued.<br> <br>We are committed to equity and justice. We are proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>US Technical Jobs. </strong>The position you are applying for will require access to technology that is subject to U.S. export control and government contract restrictions.  Employment with IonQ is contingent on either verifying “U.S. Person” (e.g., U.S. citizen, U.S. national, U.S. permanent resident, or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum) status for export controls and government contracts work, obtaining any necessary license, and/or confirming the availability of a license exception under U.S. export controls.  Please note that in the absence of confirming you are a U.S. Person for export control and government contracts work purposes, IonQ may choose not to apply for a license or decline to use a license exception (if available) for you to access export-controlled technology that may require authorization, and similarly, you may not qualify for government contracts work that requires U.S. Persons, and IonQ may decline to proceed with your application on those bases alone.  Accordingly, we will have some additional questions regarding your immigration status that will be used for export control and compliance purposes, and the answers will be reviewed by compliance personnel to ensure compliance with federal law.  </p> <p><strong>US Non-Technical Jobs. </strong>Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum. title: Senior Product Marketing Manager
description: RevenueCat gives app businesses the infrastructure and tools to build, run, and improve their monetization. Since graduating from YC's S18 batch, we've grown into the default monetization platform for mobile. We're in 50%+ of newly shipped subscription apps, we process $16B+ in annual purchase volume, and we help everyone from a solo developer to the OpenAI mobile team understand and grow their revenue. We're a remote-first team of 150+ people across 25+ countries, guided by values we actually practice: Customer Obsession, Always Be Shipping, Own It, and Balance. This isn't the right fit for everyone. The systems you’ll build here manage billions of dollars and touch hundreds of millions of end users, and we don’t take that lightly. You'll be expected to work hard and hold a high bar for what you ship, alongside some of the sharpest, most driven people you've worked with. If that sounds energizing rather than exhausting, keep reading. The Role RevenueCat helps apps of all shapes and sizes make more money across mobile, the web, and a growing list of other platforms like Roku, Amazon, and even AR through support for Vision Pro. As a result, many different types of users log in and use RevenueCat on a day-to-day basis. Product managers, support reps, lifecycle marketers, user acquisition specialists, data analysts, executives: the list goes on. Communicating the growing breadth of use cases supported by RevenueCat in a way that makes sense for all those different types of businesses, apps, and users is a challenge. And that’s where product marketing comes in. We’re looking for a Senior Product Marketing Manager to join our growing Product Marketing team led by Francie . Each Senior PMM owns a product area end-to-end, partnering with that area's product managers on positioning, messaging, and go-to-market. This is not a segment-specific role: RevenueCat serves everyone from solo indie developers to top-tier enterprise apps, often through the very same product surface, so you'll craft messaging and channels that flex across that full spectrum. This role is perfect for someone who: Knows APIs and SDKs like their ABCs. Code may not be your craft, but you know how to talk the talk. Software developers are one of our core audiences, and they can smell BS a mile away. You can debug marketing messaging so it resonates with technical audiences, and craft narratives around the 1’s and 0’s that still land with business stakeholders. Captains their own ship. You have a strong bias toward action and you’re not afraid to get your hands dirty on execution. Whether it’s juggling strategic and tactical work or navigating shifting priorities, you thrive on autonomy and love making things happen. Distills collaborative chaos. You’re comfortable raising your hand and getting what you need from a dynamic and technical organization. Whether it’s nudging engineers for product updates or rallying Sales for customer stories, you can navigate the chaos and advocate for what the GTM org needs. Gets excited about the unexpected. At RevenueCat we take shipping seriously, and are constantly adapting our product and strategies to meet the needs of developers. You see changes in direction and shifts in strategy as an opportunity to flex your creative muscles and learn on the fly. Is a little quirky. You love a whimsical side quest and you can see the soft side of software. We pride ourselves in keeping our community on their toes with unique swag, challenges and events. You can play as big a role as you’d like in helping to brainstorm and bring these quirky concepts to life. What You’ll Be Responsible For GTM and adoption campaigns: Own key product areas to deeply understand the features we’re launching and the use cases and needs behind them. Craft compelling communication plans both within the organization, and to existing and prospective customers. Lifecycle campaign building: Working with our marketing operations team to execute insight-based lifecycle campaigns to drive adoption, retention and community. Web page design and optimization: Translate product messaging and customer understanding into visually compelling and highly converting web experiences with the help of our external web development agency. You’ll chart the vision for the story our website tells and the illustrations, animations and tools we create to convey it. Case studies and testimonials: Organizing, facilitating, and translating customer interviews into compelling case studies and testimonials that showcase the value of RevenueCat. Internal enablement: As an expert in your areas of product focus, you’ll empower developer-facing teams with the resources and training they need to support developers and ensure their success. Market insights: Keeping your finger on the pulse of the mobile app industry and competitors to inform go-to-market strategies and uncover new opportunities for growth. Whimsical side quests: Taking on unique projects with minimal instruction, coordinating the collection of 1000 screenshots to launch Paywalls.com , designing, printing and shipping a calendar of cat photos, hosting the World Paywall Speed Building Championships , or crafting a keynote speech for leadership. You’ll get to work on projects that stretch your creative muscles. What You’ll Need to Be Successful 5+ years of experience in Product Marketing within a B2B or B2D SaaS environment, preferably targeting developers or software companies. RevenueCat runs a hybrid motion - self-serve/PLG for indie developers alongside a sales-assisted motion for larger accounts - so experience with either end of that spectrum is valuable; you won't need to have done both to succeed here. Previous experience as a solo-marketer is preferred. While you’ll have the broader marketing and product marketing teams to lean on, our async, entrepreneurial culture is best suited to someone who is comfortable independently driving projects forward, making progress amid changing processes, and actively enlisting cross-functional support when needed. Experience owning end-to-end go-to-market efforts, including tier 1 product launches. Strong project management skills to prioritize multiple initiatives and execute effectively across teams. Strong creative instincts and direction. You’ve led the charge on web design work and aren’t afraid to sketch, prototype in Figma, or use AI tools to get to an ugly starting point. Comfortable collaborating with external creative agencies and freelancers to deliver high-quality assets. Excellent editorial judgment: you understand audience, tone, and communication objectives, and you can elevate copy through clear direction and feedback. You will not need to write everything yourself, but you’re comfortable jumping in to draft a narrative outline or even a blog post when necessary, and you know when to pass work forward to the content team or a technical writer Exceptional communication skills to collaborate across technical and non-technical teams, ensuring alignment and buy-in from key stakeholders. A proven ability to translate complex technical concepts into compelling messaging that resonates with different audiences, both internally and externally. The resourcefulness to take on unique, sometimes ambiguous projects that require initiative and problem-solving. Ideally you: Have experience in the mobile app ecosystem or working with subscription-based software products. Have worked in an early-stage tech company or led new initiatives independently in a larger organization. Have experience working as a solo marketer or solo PMM within an organization. Are comfortable with tools like Notion, Slack, Zoom, and Linear for remote collaboration. What Success Looks Like Within the first month, you’ll: Gain hands-on experience with the RevenueCat platform, supported by our engineers and advocates. Build a foundational understanding of the app ecosystem, particularly around monetization. Establish relationships with key collaborators across Product, Sales, and Marketing. Deliver your “first ship,” a project that demonstrates your insights and adds real value to the team. Within the first 3 months, you’ll: Step into the role as the go-to-market owner for your specific product areas, becoming an expert on relevant features, their roadmap and related market segments. Own the go-to-market efforts for product areas, leading cross-functional teams to ensure successful execution of awareness and adoption efforts. Craft and distribute internal enablement materials and training related to your product areas. Publish a new landing page, leading the concept, briefing, design and written copy process, with execution by our web agency. Conduct customer research to deepen your understanding of our audience’s challenges and goals, and publish a customer case study. Within the first 6 months, you’ll: Own and optimize the self-serve adoption funnel for your product areas, partnering with Growth and Product and leveraging lifecycle marketing to turn feature interest into activation and long-term retention. Level up your product area’s sales motion by revamping core pitch materials, competitive positioning, and objection handling. Partner with Product to translate customer and market insights into clear roadmap recommendations. Contribute to a whimsical side quest that adds to our brand and community. After 12 months, you’ll: Be a trusted partner across Product, Sales, and Marketing, contributing strategically to RevenueCat’s growth. Have led multiple successful product launches, including a tier 1 launch, and owned key marketing initiatives. Represent RevenueCat at industry events and conferences Deepen your knowledge of app development and monetization, becoming an expert in the space. What we offer: Competitive equity in a fast-growing, Series C startup backed by top-tier investors, including Y Combinator 10-year window to exercise vested equity options A fully remote environment designed around autonomy and flexibility 4-5 weeks of flexible time off annually Paid desk at a co-working space Workspace budget and continuous learning stipend Interviewing at RevenueCat Our interview process is rigorous on purpose. We want to be sure that everyone we bring on is genuinely excited about this work, aligned with how we operate, and ready to meet our high bar for performance. Curious what that actually looks like? Read more in our blog post on how we hire at RevenueCat , including tips to help you succeed. title: Sales Development Representative - CDI
description: Qui sommes-nous ? Notre mission Avec Solteo, nous voulons donner toutes ses chances à l'électrification des bâtiments en soutenant ceux qui sont en première ligne : les entreprises d’installation. ⚡ Produire son électricité en solaire, se chauffer avec une pompe à chaleur, recharger son véhicule, stocker : l'électrification des bâtiments est le premier levier de décarbonation . Le photovoltaïque ouvre la marche — selon Xavier Piechaczyk de RTE : “le photovoltaïque a un grand potentiel, mais il faut accélérer rapidement” 👷‍♂️ La disponibilité des installateurs freine cette accélération. Ces professionnels limités en nombre perdent souvent du temps sur l'organisation et la gestion de projets de plus en plus techniques. Rien qu'en solaire, ils ont 4M de foyers à équiper d'ici 2030 ! 💻 Solteo est la plateforme d'organisation de projets d’électrification qui aide les installateurs à gérer leur temps et leurs projets, quel que soit l'équipement posé. Nos premières métriques : 75% de temps gagné, +30% de conversion, et des utilisateurs heureux ! Le mot de la CEO “Entreprendre est le moyen le plus efficace d’avoir un impact ! C'est pour cela que nous avons choisi le secteur de l'énergie, et plus particulièrement celui de l’électrification. Nous façonnons le monde de demain, celui de la décentralisation des énergies renouvelables : pas à pas, projet par projet. Nous accélérons cette transition et surtout, nous la rendons possible. Ce qui est sûr, c'est que nous nous sentons utiles, notre produit plaît et devient rapidement indispensable chez nos utilisateurs. Rejoindre Solteo, c’est savoir écouter et rester attentif aux retours de nos clients et de notre marché, car ce sont eux qui façonnent la trajectoire de Solteo ! Ce produit, c’est avant tout le leur !” — Manon Et ce poste alors ? Le rôle En première ligne de notre développement commercial , tu travailleras main dans la main avec le Sales Manager et les Account Executives au sein d'une équipe outillée et ambitieuse, sur un cycle de vente court. Missions et responsabilités Prospection intensive et ciblée (Outbound) : Identifier et qualifier des comptes clés dans le secteur de l'installation solaire. Tu contacteras les prospects via une approche multicanale avec une majorité de Cold Calling (notre cible d'artisans est très réceptive au téléphone), du Cold Emailing et LinkedIn. Qualification des leads (Inbound & Outbound) : Traiter rapidement les demandes entrantes générées par le marketing. Tu devras qualifier les besoins lors des premiers appels de découverte et transformer l'intérêt en rendez-vous de démonstration qualifié pour l'équipe de closing. Rigueur opérationnelle et Data : Assurer une tenue irréprochable de notre CRM (HubSpot) via la mise à jour des statuts, la prise de notes et le log des appels. Tu utiliseras notre stack et suivras tes KPIs quotidiens et hebdomadaires. Amélioration continue : Remonter les objections fréquentes et les retours du terrain au VP Sales et au Marketing pour affiner le discours. Tu participeras activement aux sessions de coaching et de partage de bonnes pratiques de l'équipe. Tes objectifs: ⭐ 0 à 1 mois : L'onboarding et les premiers pas Acquérir une compréhension parfaite du produit Solteo, de la proposition de valeur et du marché cible. Prendre en main la stack technique (HubSpot, Aircall, Apollo) et lancer tes premières séquences de prospection et appels à froid pour générer tes premiers SQL. 🎯 Objectif : Maîtrise du pitch commercial, des outils de prospection et autonomie dans la génération de rendez-vous. ⭐ 1 à 8 mois : L'exécution et la machine à leads Exécuter les séquences avec régularité et intensité. Atteindre et dépasser tes quotas de rendez-vous bookés. Devenir une machine de qualification tout en encaissant les refus sans perdre ta motivation. 🎯 Objectif : Alimenter continuellement les agendas des Account Executives avec des leads ultra-qualifiés. ⭐ À partir de 8 mois : Les premières démos (Closing) C'est la concrétisation de ta montée en compétences ! Tu ne fais plus que prospecter : tu commences à prendre le relais sur la suite du cycle de vente en réalisant tes premières démonstrations produit auprès des prospects que tu as qualifiés. 🎯 Objectif : Maîtriser l'exercice de la démo et initier ta transition vers le closing. ⭐ >1 an : L'évolution Participer à l'amélioration des process de prospection et transmettre ton savoir aux nouveaux arrivants. 🎯 Objectif : Évoluer officiellement vers un poste d'Account Executive (Closer) à temps plein ou prendre des responsabilités managériales au sein de l'équipe SDR. Les compétences qu’on recherche Formation : Tu as une expérience dans la vente SaaS B2B ! Mindset : Tu as un mindset d'entrepreneur, tu aimes relever des challenges et mettre la main à la pâte. Humilité et capacité à se remettre en question : Forte envie de progresser et de prendre des responsabilités. Langues : Français et Anglais parfaitement bilingues/fluents. Ce qui serait un plus Une expérience dans la Construction Tech ou l' Energy Tech , ou auprès des artisans et du bâtiment. Une réelle motivation pour les projets à impact et la transition énergétique. Mais Solteo c’est aussi… Un cadre professionnel vivant et énergique, où la prise d’initiatives est non seulement appréciée mais également récompensée. La chance de parfaire et d'enrichir tes connaissances dans un secteur en pleine croissance et qui a du sens. Des bureaux situés en plein centre de Paris, avec plusieurs autres start-ups du solaire Une diversité de projets captivants, offrant l'opportunité de collaborer avec des clients diverses et variés. Pas possible de s’ennuyer ! Nous te promettons aussi une ambiance d’équipe bienveillante, accueillante et stimulante . Et bien sûr, plein d’évènements d’équipe ! Processus de recrutement 📞 Entretien de cadrage avec une recruteuse (30 min) : pour discuter de ton CV et des attentes sur le poste. 🤝 Entretien de fit en visio (45 min) : pour faire connaissance, discuter de ton parcours et de tes motivations avec Manon (CEO). 🎯 Entretien technique avec l’équipe commerciale (1h00) : mise en situation pratique sur un business case . 🕵️‍♂️ Prise de références (Réf call). 🍽️ Déjeuner d’équipe : rencontre conviviale avec les fondateurs et toute l'équipe Solteo. title: Applied Research Engineer, Evaluation
description: About Black Forest Labs We're the team behind Latent Diffusion, Stable Diffusion, and FLUX — foundational technologies that changed how the world creates images and videos. Our FLUX models are among the most advanced in the world, and we're just getting started. Headquartered in Freiburg, Germany with a growing presence in San Francisco, we're scaling fast while staying true to what makes us different: research excellence, open science, and building technology that expands human creativity. Why This Role Frontier image and video models are now good enough that the hard question is no longer whether they work, but whether a new one is actually better, and how you'd know. Aesthetics, prompt following, editing fidelity, text rendering, character consistency: none of these collapse into a single number, and public benchmarks have fallen well behind the models they're meant to measure. You'll work on the system BFL uses to answer that question. Every FLUX checkpoint, every finetuning and RL run, and every competitor release goes through our evaluation stack, and you'll help build and sharpen it. Product Research relies on what it shows to decide what to fix next, and to confirm the fix worked. It gets harder from here. FLUX 3 is our first multimodal model, spanning image, video, audio and action, and each new modality needs its own way of being measured. What You'll Work On What you focus on will depend on where you're strongest and what the team needs most when you join. In scope: Building and maintaining the evaluation stack that every model checkpoint has to pass through and prove itself on, from automated benchmarking and LLM-as-judge pipelines, to human evaluation through panels (Prolific and otherwise). Designing the breadth of evaluation across the taxonomy, from prompt adherence, editing fidelity, aesthetics, text rendering, subject and character consistency, to safety. Evaluating the evaluation stack itself: checking that human and automated evals agree, that results stay stable over time, and improving them when they don't. Benchmarking FLUX against the frontier models continuously, while obtaining a meaningful perspective on where we are better or worse than competitors and what such differences really mean. Finding the ways in which the quality of the model's output falls short that are not captured by aggregate numbers. Closing the loop, ideally, with the RL and finetuning researchers, by defining target metrics for them to aim for, and verifying that a new checkpoint improved the weakness without introducing new ones. Designing how best to exploit the signals we already capture through the API and MCP, and what new signals we should capture, with help from research, data engineering and legal. Maintaining the usefulness of existing metrics as their natural lifecycle brings up concerns of gaming and overfitting, and anticipating this for new metrics. What We're Looking For You have made meaningful contributions to the evaluation of generative models already. You understand that a benchmark figure without careful consideration of sample size and judge agreement with humans is at best uninformed optimism and at worst dangerously misleading, and you have been the person that found that inconvenient regression that nobody wanted to talk about. You likely have: Advanced degree (MS/PhD) in a relevant field or demonstrated equivalent practical experience Practical experience with evaluating generative models, in a hands-on way. You may have worked with diffusion or flow-matching based image or video models already, but the capability to evaluate them in earnest transfers to other modalities too Very strong Python and software engineering skills, with pipelines that run reliably and that other people can read if needed Working knowledge of PyTorch and modern ML infrastructure and practices; you are not a pure Python developer, you know what the modern ML code looks like Strong grasp of statistics and its shortcomings in practice, and how to work with those; sample sizes, inter-annotator agreement, confidence levels, etc., and a healthy skepticism about what those numbers say about the world Practical experience with building and operating LLM-as-judge systems, and understanding their limitations Working knowledge of modern benchmarking practices and of standard datasets and benchmarks in the field already; you have an idea of which to trust and which to disregard The inclination to look at the actual outputs your system is judging, and to care about what is there beyond an aggregate score We'd be especially excited if you: Have practical experience with human evaluation, including study design and execution via panels, and analysis of disagreements and annotator performance Have worked where evaluation meets training (reward models, preference data, RLHF, DPO or similar) and know that whatever you optimize for is what the model learns Have evaluated agentic or multi-step systems and know how hard it is to attribute success or failure to a single step Have built tools that people actually want to use internally Have made public contributions to the field: papers, open source, or otherwise How We Work Together We're a distributed team with real offices that people actually use. This role is based in Freiburg, where you'll join us at least 2 days a week (or one full week every other week). We'll cover reasonable travel costs to make this possible. We think in-person time matters, and we've structured things to make it accessible to all. We'll discuss what this will look like during our interview process. Everything we do is grounded in four values: Obsessed. We are a frontier research lab. The science has to be right, the understanding deep, the product beautiful. Low Ego. The work speaks. The best idea wins, no matter who said it. Credit is shared. Nobody is above any task. Bold. We take the ambitious bet. We ship, we do not wait for conditions to be perfect. Kind. People over politics. We treat each other with genuine warmth. Agency without empathy creates chaos. If this sounds like work you'd enjoy, we'd love to hear from you. title: Operations Lead (m/w/d)
description: The opportunity Tax advisory is an operational business. Every booking, every payroll run, every set of financial statements follows a process, and hardly any of them has ever been systematically questioned. They work because experienced people know their workarounds. That is the lever, and in this industry nobody has claimed it yet. The model is no longer the scarce part. Expert knowledge from real cases is, and AI labs pay a premium for exactly this. Vogel holds what no AI-native player has: decades of experience with several thousand mid-sized companies. You turn that knowledge into the standard every location works by. Vogel acquires independent advisory firms and builds them into the strongest name in their region. Every acquisition broadens that base. Operations means carrying this model: the same processes at every location, technology people actually use day to day, and an integration that runs faster the fifth time than the first. You own Operations end to end: harmonizing and automating processes, internal tools, IT infrastructure and the integration of every new unit. You build the function from the ground up. You work directly with Moritz Vogel. What you'll do Harmonizing and automating Work through bookkeeping, payroll and financial statements on site, on real cases, with the advisors who handle them daily. Harmonize processes across locations and automate what can be automated. Decide the tool stack and its standards: what we buy, how we set it up, what we switch off. You make that call, not a committee. Your benchmark: every process must hold at twice the client volume without twice the people. Integrating acquired units Own the integration of every new location: connectivity, data migration, moving onto our processes, readiness from day one. Turn it into a repeatable routine rather than a project. What takes months at the first location takes weeks at the fourth. Spot, with the advisors on site, where an acquired firm does it better, and adopt it. Team and operations Grow the Operations team to five or six people within twelve months. You choose the people and shape their focus areas. Own the leading metrics: digitization rate, adoption, turnaround times per location. Trace their root causes yourself. Stay close to the system. Anyone who only delegates and follows up loses their judgment within a year. Questions you'll answer In a process that grew over the years, where does substance end and habit begin, and how do you decide without turning the practitioners against you? What belongs in the standard that applies at every location, and what may an acquired firm keep? Four initiatives, time for two: how do you decide the order? What success looks like After 6 months: All processes across the locations are mapped, with numbers instead of impressions. Two core-business processes run automated in daily operations, and your first hire is selected. After 12 months: A team of five to six people with clear focus areas. Operational metrics are measured, not estimated. The integration path is a documented routine, and the tool stack is decided. After 24 months: Operations runs without daily involvement from management. Every further acquisition follows the same pattern, and the effort per location falls instead of growing with it. Where it leads: from Operations to overall responsibility for running the business. This is the management career at its most consistent, decided by contribution, not years served. What you bring You come from McKinsey, BCG or Bain as a senior consultant, project leader or engagement manager. Building operational systems in a growing company also qualifies: as head of operations or chief of staff in a B2B scale-up past Series B, as an operator at a company builder, as a forward deployed engineer or as a founder. You implement things yourself: processes, automations, new tools. You don't need to be a software engineer, but what you decide, you must be able to implement. You have pushed something through at several locations at once and know why that is different from doing it at one. AI is your everyday tool for process analysis, research and multiplying your own output. You explain decisions so a tax advisor with twenty years of experience sees the consequence and can act on it. And you bring the humility to learn from her. You can stand being out front alone, still bring the others along, and set the highest standard in everything you deliver. Not because someone checks, but because mediocrity is not an option for you. A plus, not a requirement An engineering degree (mechanical, industrial or computer science) and projects in operations, post-merger integration or process design where you owned implementation yourself. Knowledge of tax advisory, DATEV or a similarly regulated business. No conventional CV required: a tax advisor with their own automation track record, an information systems graduate after a corporate start, an industrial engineer with multi-site experience, a founder after an exit. We assess contribution, not labels. The salary range shown refers to the primary profile; a different background starts at a different market price and converges on the role's level after twelve months of proven performance. What this role is and what it isn't Implementing, not advising. You are accountable for what you decide. Process consulting that delivers a diagnosis and leaves is something else. An existing business, not a greenfield. DATEV is running, the locations are working, clients don't wait. What you build has to work alongside daily operations. On the ground, not at 30,000 feet. You work at the locations, on the real process. If you only want to work in concepts, this is not the place. Why join us A lever nobody owns yet. Processes that were never thought through, and nobody in the market who has solved it. Every acquisition multiplies. What you build once applies at the next firm from day one. The effort per location falls while the volume grows. Yours to decide: stack, standards and the shape of the team. No committee overrules you. Vogel is hierarchical in decisions, flat in communication, autonomous in execution. Performance is celebrated, not hidden, without politics and without consensus theater. Substance behind you. A profitable, growing business. No funding round decides whether your team still exists next year. The FAQ below is in German, as is our working day. FAQ 1. Was ist Vogel – und wo arbeitet ihr? Vogel ist eine der führenden Mittelstandsberatungen Deutschlands – seit 1959, inhabergeführt in zweiter Generation, mit eigenem Kapital – und baut daraus die führende Beratungsplattform für den Mittelstand. Wir arbeiten an drei Standorten: Aalen als gewachsenem Stammsitz, Bopfingen im Kerngeschäft und München als neuem Hub. An allen dreien suchen wir quer durch die Funktionen – von Steuerberatung über Beratung bis zu den Teams, die das Fundament darunter bauen. 2. Wie sind die Gehaltsbänder zu verstehen? Bewusst breit – und an jeder Stelle ausgewiesen, bevor du dich bewirbst. Wir differenzieren nach Track Record und Marktwert, nicht nach Abschluss: knappe, stark gefragte Profile am oberen Ende, weniger knappe am unteren. Die ausgewiesene Spanne ist kein Verhandlungsspielraum, sondern eine Profil-Skala – zwei Menschen mit ähnlicher Erfahrung können bei uns unterschiedlich verdienen. Was das obere Ende bestimmt, ist der Reifegrad, nicht die Zahl der Berufsjahre und nicht das Verhandlungsgeschick. 3. Wie viel – und wie – wird bei Vogel gearbeitet? Gemessen wird an dem, was du bewegst, nicht an Stunden. Ehrlich ist aber auch: Wer 9-to-5 sucht, ist bei uns nicht die erste Adresse. Wir suchen Menschen, die aus eigenem Antrieb intensiv arbeiten, weil die Aufgaben es wert sind. Wie du deine Zeit verteilst, ist weitgehend deine Sache. Was wir teilen: Wir arbeiten präsent zusammen und sehen uns im Normalfall täglich im Büro – Kultur, Sparring und die besten Ideen entstehen in der täglichen Nähe. Wir sind keine Remote-Company und haben keine großen Home-Office-Policies; einzelne Remote-Tage sind kein Problem. 4. Wie läuft die Bewerbung? Schlank, schnell, transparent – und nach Profil gestaffelt. In der Regel sind es vier Schritte: eine schriftliche Aufgabe, in der du zu acht Fragen Position beziehst – KI ist ausdrücklich erlaubt, wir bitten nur um eine kurze Selbstauskunft dazu; ein Gespräch von einer halben Stunde; eine gemeinsame Arbeitssitzung an einem echten Problem aus unserem Alltag; und ein Termin vor Ort mit dem Team und gemeinsamem Essen. Wie viele Schritte es tatsächlich werden, hängt von der Rolle ab: Bei Praktikum und Werkstudium fällt der Vor-Ort-Termin weg, für Schülerjobs genügt ein Gespräch, bei Senior-Rollen kommt ein gemeinsamer Arbeitsnachmittag dazu. Vorab kannst du einen Zehn-Minuten-Call buchen, in dem nur du fragst. In der Regel hörst du nach jedem Schritt innerhalb von 48 Stunden von uns. 5. Wie funktioniert die variable Vergütung? Quartalsweise an Leistung gekoppelt, qualitativ bewertet. Die Skala steigt mit dem Level: bis 20 % Associate, 27,5 % Manager, 35 % Senior Manager, 42,5 % Director, 50 % VP. Erwartungswert bei guter Leistung – du erfüllst die Anforderungen, setzt eigene Akzente, bestehst den Keeper Test – liegt bei rund 50 % des Maximums; der Maximalbonus ist nicht der Normalfall. Im Fokus steht eine ganzheitliche Beurteilung durch deine Führungskraft anhand von sechs Kriterien: Impact, Judgement, Communication, Execution, Growth und Values. 6. Wie entwickle ich mich – welche Karrierewege gibt es? Zwei aktive Wege: die IC-Karriere (fachliche Tiefe, Expertenlaufbahn) über die Stufen Expert, Senior, Lead und Principal – und die Management-Karriere (Führung, Personalverantwortung) über Manager, Senior Manager, Director und VP. Beide werden gleich vergütet, und beide müssen nicht nach oben führen: Wer auf einer Stufe bleibt und dort weiter in die Tiefe geht, ist bei uns genauso richtig. Die Richtung wählst du nach dem Onboarding, meist in Jahr 1–3. Berufseinstieg ist kein Sonderweg, sondern der frühe Teil derselben Strecke – vom Werkstudenten oder Praktikanten zum Associate, für die Besten ohne erneutes Bewerbungsverfahren. 7. Team, Kultur, Urlaub? Das gemeinsame Mittagessen ist der tägliche Ankerpunkt – wer im Büro ist, isst mit; erwartet, nicht kontrolliert. Das Abendessen ist dasselbe Angebot ohne jede Erwartung. Beides ohne Eigenanteil. Dazu Social Events und Offsites in regelmäßigem Rhythmus – nicht als Pflichtprogramm, sondern weil ein gutes Team auch abseits der Arbeit Zeit teilt. Benefits sind bei uns nicht das Sahnehäubchen, sondern das, was Intensität über Jahre tragbar macht: Examensförderung mit 25.000 EUR Qualifizierungsbudget und drei Monaten Freistellung, 100-prozentige Übernahme der Kinderbetreuung, EGYM Wellpass, betriebliche Altersvorsorge, Job-Ticket mit 90 % Zuschuss, Homeoffice-Ausstattung und ein Gerät deiner Wahl aus unserem Katalog, ein Buch im Monat aus dem Vogel-Kanon – und KI-Tools ohne Token-Limit und ohne Budgetdeckel. Wir arbeiten an drei Standorten: Aalen als gewachsenem Stammsitz, Bopfingen im Kerngeschäft und München als neuem Hub. An allen dreien suchen wir quer durch die Funktionen – von Steuerberatung über Beratung bis zu den Teams, die das Fundament darunter bauen. 2. Wie sind die Gehaltsbänder zu verstehen? Bewusst breit – und an jeder Stelle ausgewiesen, bevor du dich bewirbst. Wir differenzieren nach Track Record und Marktwert, nicht nach Abschluss: knappe, stark gefragte Profile am oberen Ende, weniger knappe am unteren. Die ausgewiesene Spanne ist kein Verhandlungsspielraum, sondern eine Profil-Skala – zwei Menschen mit ähnlicher Erfahrung können bei uns unterschiedlich verdienen. Was das obere Ende bestimmt, ist der Reifegrad, nicht die Zahl der Berufsjahre und nicht das Verhandlungsgeschick. 3. Wie viel – und wie – wird bei Vogel gearbeitet? Gemessen wird an dem, was du bewegst, nicht an Stunden. Ehrlich ist aber auch: Wer 9-to-5 sucht, ist bei uns nicht die erste Adresse. Wir suchen Menschen, die aus eigenem Antrieb intensiv arbeiten, weil die Aufgaben es wert sind. Wie du deine Zeit verteilst, ist weitgehend deine Sache. Was wir teilen: Wir arbeiten präsent zusammen und sehen uns im Normalfall täglich im Büro – Kultur, Sparring und die besten Ideen entstehen in der täglichen Nähe. Wir sind keine Remote-Company und haben keine großen Home-Office-Policies; einzelne Remote-Tage sind kein Problem. 4. Wie läuft die Bewerbung? Schlank, schnell, transparent – und nach Profil gestaffelt. In der Regel sind es vier Schritte: eine schriftliche Aufgabe, in der du zu acht Fragen Position beziehst – KI ist ausdrücklich erlaubt, wir bitten nur um eine kurze Selbstauskunft dazu; ein Gespräch von einer halben Stunde; eine gemeinsame Arbeitssitzung an einem echten Problem aus unserem Alltag; und ein Termin vor Ort mit dem Team und gemeinsamem Essen. Wie viele Schritte es tatsächlich werden, hängt von der Rolle ab: Bei Praktikum und Werkstudium fällt der Vor-Ort-Termin weg, für Schülerjobs genügt ein Gespräch, bei Senior-Rollen kommt ein gemeinsamer Arbeitsnachmittag dazu. Vorab kannst du einen Zehn-Minuten-Call buchen, in dem nur du fragst. In der Regel hörst du nach jedem Schritt innerhalb von 48 Stunden von uns. 5. Wie funktioniert die variable Vergütung? Quartalsweise an Leistung gekoppelt, qualitativ bewertet. Die Skala steigt mit dem Level: bis 20 % Associate, 27,5 % Manager, 35 % Senior Manager, 42,5 % Director, 50 % VP. Erwartungswert bei guter Leistung – du erfüllst die Anforderungen, setzt eigene Akzente, bestehst den Keeper Test – liegt bei rund 50 % des Maximums; der Maximalbonus ist nicht der Normalfall. Im Fokus steht eine ganzheitliche Beurteilung durch deine Führungskraft anhand von sechs Kriterien: Impact, Judgement, Communication, Execution, Growth und Values. 6. Wie entwickle ich mich – welche Karrierewege gibt es? Zwei aktive Wege: die IC-Karriere (fachliche Tiefe, Expertenlaufbahn) über die Stufen Expert, Senior, Lead und Principal – und die Management-Karriere (Führung, Personalverantwortung) über Manager, Senior Manager, Director und VP. Beide werden gleich vergütet, und beide müssen nicht nach oben führen: Wer auf einer Stufe bleibt und dort weiter in die Tiefe geht, ist bei uns genauso richtig. Die Richtung wählst du nach dem Onboarding, meist in Jahr 1–3. Berufseinstieg ist kein Sonderweg, sondern der frühe Teil derselben Strecke – vom Werkstudenten oder Praktikanten zum Associate, für die Besten ohne erneutes Bewerbungsverfahren. 7. Team, Kultur, Urlaub? Das gemeinsame Mittagessen ist der tägliche Ankerpunkt – wer im Büro ist, isst mit; erwartet, nicht kontrolliert. Das Abendessen ist dasselbe Angebot ohne jede Erwartung. Beides ohne Eigenanteil. Dazu Social Events und Offsites in regelmäßigem Rhythmus – nicht als Pflichtprogramm, sondern weil ein gutes Team auch abseits der Arbeit Zeit teilt. Benefits sind bei uns nicht das Sahnehäubchen, sondern das, was Intensität über Jahre tragbar macht: Examensförderung mit 25.000 EUR Qualifizierungsbudget und drei Monaten Freistellung, 100-prozentige Übernahme der Kinderbetreuung, EGYM Wellpass, betriebliche Altersvorsorge, Job-Ticket mit 90 % Zuschuss, Homeoffice-Ausstattung und ein Gerät deiner Wahl aus unserem Katalog, ein Buch im Monat aus dem Vogel-Kanon – und KI-Tools ohne Token-Limit und ohne Budgetdeckel. title: Senior Specialist Solutions Engineer, Cloudflare One
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h3><strong>Available Location: London, Munich, Amsterdam, Paris, Lisbon</strong></h3> <h3><strong>About the Department</strong></h3> <p>The Specialist Solutions Engineering team at Cloudflare is a group of trusted technical advisors who partner with our customers to solve their most complex security and performance challenges. We work hand-in-hand with the sales organization to navigate the entire customer journey, from initial discovery and solution design to proof-of-concept and implementation. We are passionate about technology and dedicated to helping our customers understand and leverage the full power of Cloudflare's global network to achieve their business critical objectives.</p> <h3><strong>About the Role</strong></h3> <p>As a Senior Solutions Engineer Specialist, you will be a pivotal technical expert and strategic advisor, focusing on the Cloudflare One product suite. You will partner with our sales team and engage directly with our customers to architect and demonstrate how our SASE platform can solve their unique security, performance, and reliability needs. Your expertise will be crucial in guiding prospects through complex technical evaluations, ensuring they have the confidence to adopt Cloudflare as a core component of their IT and security infrastructure.</p> <p>This role requires a blend of deep technical curiosity, strong communication skills, and a genuine passion for helping customers transform their network and security architecture. Candidates are expected to actively use AI tools in their day-to-day life for research, preparation, automation, or customer engagement.</p> <h3><strong>Responsibilities</strong></h3> <ul> <li><strong>Serve as a trusted technical advisor</strong> to our customers, helping them architect the optimal solution for their business needs using the Cloudflare One product suite.</li> <li><strong>Stay at the forefront of AI-era security challenges</strong> by developing expertise in how enterprises govern and secure AI tool adoption, including Shadow AI visibility, data loss prevention for AI applications, MCP server access controls and Agentic AI Governance.</li> <li><strong>Guide qualified prospects</strong> through the solution design and proof-of-value stages, effectively demonstrating the key capabilities and value of the Cloudflare One portfolio.</li> <li><strong>Collaborate with sales partners</strong> to consistently achieve pipeline generation and revenue goals.</li> <li><strong>Analyze customer IT landscapes</strong> and security requirements to develop robust architectures that support their strategic objectives.</li> <li><strong>Clearly articulate the benefits</strong> and technical differentiators of the Cloudflare One product portfolio against competing solutions.</li> <li><strong>Enhance customer retention</strong> by identifying, capturing, and communicating product gaps or feature requests to internal product and engineering teams.</li> <li><strong>Collaborate with Product Teams</strong> by being the voice of our customers by sharing insights, trends, and product gaps to help shape the product suite and solution roadmap.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Qualifications</strong></h3> <p>Successful candidates are curious, customer-focused, and have a passion for learning. We are looking for individuals with a strong background in technical sales or systems engineering who can effectively communicate complex concepts to both technical and executive audiences.</p> <p><strong>Key Qualifications:</strong></p> <ul> <li>5+ years of experience in a customer-facing technical role such as Technical Sales, Solutions/Systems Engineering, or a related field.</li> <li>Active adoption of the use of AI tools in professional day to day workflows and knowledge on AI security concepts relevant to enterprise customers:  Securing employee AI tool usage,  Governing AI application access, and understanding the data leakage risks posed by generative AI tools</li> <li>Demonstrated experience presenting technical solutions and communicating the value of network and security transformation to senior-level executives.</li> <li>Deep understanding of the modern cybersecurity landscape, including common threats (e.g., malware, ransomware, phishing, botnets) and mitigation strategies.</li> <li>Fundamental knowledge of customer network and application architectures, including hybrid environments leveraging public clouds (Azure, AWS, GCP).</li> <li>Solid grasp of SASE concepts and Zero Trust networking architectures.</li> <li>Hands-on experience with one or more of the following: Secure Web Gateway (SWG), CASB, DLP, DNS security (including DNS over HTTPS), Identity Provider (IdP) integration (SAML, OTP), and SIEM/log analytics platforms.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Fluent in English (written & spoken), Russian and/or Hebrew advantageous</li> <li>Proficiency with networking fundamentals, including routing, subnetting, VPNs, and SD-WAN concepts.</li> <li>Understanding of AI agentic architecture and the security requirements and challenges in implementation at scale.</li> <li>Familiarity with client operating system fundamentals and software distribution methods.</li> <li>Knowledge of the competitive landscape for CDN, WAF, DDoS mitigation, and Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA) solutions.</li> <li>Direct experience with Cloudflare's Zero Trust solutions (Access, Gateway, Browser Isolation) is a significant plus.</li> <li>Strong project management skills, with the ability to work to deadlines and prioritize effectively among competing goals.</li> </ul> <h3 This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. If you are a lawyer who builds, someone who has stopped waiting for better tools and started making them, this is your moment and your place. Send us your CV, a short note on why Legartis, and links to anything you have built or published. Your mission Most companies split this seat across three teams, and that split is exactly the problem. The person who hears the customer describe their workflow should be the person who writes the requirement, and the person who writes the requirement should be able to build the first version themselves. That is you. 1. You translate customer reality into engineering requirements — and into revenue. You sit in customer and expert calls alongside Sales, not as a note-taker but as the person who understands the legal work. In trials and hackathons you coach hands-on: the customer drives, you navigate, and they create the first "wow" moment themselves. When they say "that won't work for us" or "we'll build it ourselves", you answer with a concrete path (a workaround, a workflow, the honest maintenance cost of the alternative) and you leave every conversation with a next step: trial licenses, a hackathon, a scoped rollout. Then you pull out the workflow: what actually happens, in what order, where it breaks, what the customer would pay to never do again. And you write the spec, edge cases, and acceptance criteria that Engineering can build against. 2. You build the skills yourself. You write, test, and ship agent skills and playbooks that solve real customer workflows. You build the evaluation frameworks and test sets that prove they got better rather than just different. When the AI fails on a clause, you diagnose why, at the prompt and context level, and you either fix it or hand Engineering a diagnosis precise enough to act on. 3. You make it repeatable, and therefore sellable. Anything you build once for one customer, you turn into something Sales and Customer Success can run without you. Standard demo environments. A skill library they can reach for. Onboarding that lands in days rather than months. Where Customer Success needs legal depth you step in, fix it, and turn the fix into something the team can handle alone next time. Your success is measured by how rarely you need to be in the room, and by what happens to adoption and expansion when you are not. 4. You are the legal authority in the building. Legal and compliance questions land with you: contract reviews, customer security and data protection questions, the occasional in-house matter which makes roughly ten to fifteen percent of your time. You use our own product to do it, and you tell us honestly when it is not good enough. Your profile The person we picture. There is a name emerging for what we are describing, and it is not "lawyer who is good with computers". It is legal quant : a lawyer who builds their own tooling to practise law, rather than waiting for a vendor to ship it. The distinction that matters to us: plenty of lawyers now use AI. A legal quant builds with it. They look at a workflow and ask how to redesign it from first principles to get the best possible outcome, rather than making the existing process incrementally faster. A note on how we are weighting this role. Three capabilities make someone exceptional here: commercial instinct, legal depth, and technical ability to build. The ideal candidate has all three. We know that person is rare, and we are not going to pretend otherwise by writing a wish list and hoping. So for this role we weight the technical evidence most heavily, because it is the hardest of the three to teach on the job. If you believe you genuinely combine all three, we want to talk to you regardless of how neatly your CV matches the bullets below. Say so in your note and tell us what you have built and what you have sold. 1. Technical track record. You have built things and they exist and ideally you have published some of it. You are fluent with LLMs the way a practitioner is fluent, not a spectator: you know how context windows fail you or why a prompt stopped working. When something breaks you go into the system rather than around it. Scripting, Git, and APIs are a strong plus. 2. Legal foundation. A law degree with a commercial-contracts focus: German-qualified (Bachelor, Master, or Staatsexamen) or an equivalent qualification from another jurisdiction. No bar admission required, no second Staatsexamen required. What we need: you have worked hands-on with German commercial contracts, drafting, reviewing, and negotiating them, and you can hold a conversation with a General Counsel as a peer. 3. Commercial and entrepreneurial track record. You have carried commercial responsibility for something of your own: a freelance client base, a legal tech product, or a company you started. You know what it takes to win a client from a standing start and why "they did not understand the value" is never the customer's fault. If instead you have supported enterprise sales teams in demos, pilots, and expert calls, tell us what you changed about the outcome. You prioritise by impact, you are comfortable deciding without permission, and you would rather ship something imperfect this week than something elegant next quarter. 4. Language. Excellent German and English. German is non-negotiable: our customers are DACH legal teams and the nuance lives in their language. You can run a room of legal buyers, ask the sharp question, and write a specification precise enough to build from. Other EU languages are a plus. Why us? Impact over hype. You define a new discipline at the intersection of law, product, and AI. Your work directly shapes how thousands of legal professionals will operate. No silos. You sit between Product, Engineering, and the customer, with a direct line to all three. The better argument wins, not the higher title. We invest in you. The enterprise motion (multi-stakeholder pilots, procurement cycles, security reviews) is teachable, and we teach it: side by side in real customer calls from week one. Real ownership. Competitive salary and employee stock options (ESOP). Build in public. We want you to keep publishing what you build, because it makes you better and it makes us visible. Offices in Berlin, Leipzig, and Zurich with a flexible hybrid setup. Regular apéros, lunches, and hiking trips as we enjoy the journey together. Process Expectations.
