title: Senior DevOps Engineer
description: Want to work on Software-Defined Defense? At Apex.AI, we develop safety-certified software for mobility systems and intelligent machines. Our products power applications in automotive, trucking, robotics, aerospace, agriculture, industrial automation, and defense systems . We are hiring a Senior DevOps Engineer to design and scale Apex.AI's build and release systems. You will architect and implement our build and release system solutions, which impact developer productivity company-wide and ensure that customers receive high-quality products in a timely manner. In this role, you will work directly with European defense customers and internal product teams to design, build, deploy, and Apex.Alan. You will help customers bring real-world systems to production while contributing improvements and features back into our core platform. Find out more about Apex.Alan here and here . This role is located in our Munich office. Authorization to work in Germany and German language skills are required. What You Bring B.S. or higher degree in a technical field with 5+ years of relevant work experience Proven experience working with cloud infrastructure on AWS, Azure, or GCP Proven experience maintaining a cross-platform build system Proven experience managing CI/CD pipelines Proven ability to script in Python and Starlark Proven experience building C/C++ projects with Bazel Familiarity with GitLab or GitHub Experience navigating Linux-based systems and tools in a terminal Excellent troubleshooting skills Excellent communication skills German language skills Nice To Have Experience with infrastructure management tools such as Terraform Experience with Bazel internals Familiarity with releasing code and binaries to customers Familiarity with cross-compilation Experience with the usage of CMake Experience developing Bazel infrastructure Apex.AI is an international software company specializing in the development of safety-certified, developer-friendly, and scalable software for mobility systems, aiming to accelerate the transition to software-defined vehicles and mobility. Founded in 2017 by Jan Becker and Dejan Pangercic, the company is headquartered in Palo Alto, California, with additional offices in Munich, Stuttgart, Gothenburg, Tokyo, and Pangyo. To date, Apex.AI has raised over $75 million USD from world-class venture, financial and strategic investors including AGCO, Airbus Ventures, Canaan, Continental AG, Daimler Truck, HELLA Ventures, Jaguar Land Rover’s InMotion Ventures, LG Electronics, Lightspeed, Orillion, Toyota Ventures, Volvo Group Venture Capital and ZF. The company’s flagship product, Apex.OS, consists of two core components: Apex.Grace and Apex.Ida. Apex.Grace is an application runtime framework in the form of a software development kit (SDK). It provides a robust framework for developing real-time, reliable, and safe applications. Core APIs are based on ROS 2 APIs with numerous extensions enabling real-time execution, reliable performance, deployment into large fleets, system state management, safety, security, and much more. It is safety-certified to ISO 26262 ASIL D. Apex.Ida is a communication middleware delivering optimal high-performance data transport across use cases. These use cases range from fully autonomous vehicles with dozens of high-resolution cameras to small signals with ultra-high frequencies in safety-critical domains. Its core is based on a shared memory data transport with connectors into DDS, SOME/IP, MQTT, CAN, and many more protocols, all abstracted into a single application-facing API. Additionally, Apex.AI offers: Apex.Alan provides customers with a highly optimized and efficient software integration, development environment, build, test, and delivery process. Apex.OS for V&V enables record and playback of very large and diverse data streams, both time- and data-deterministically, which is crucial for replay, analysis, and performance evaluation of complex autonomous systems. Apex.AI’s software solutions are utilized across a diverse range of industries, including automotive, agriculture, medical, and defense sectors. The products enable developers to efficiently create and deploy safe, reliable, and high-performance applications, thereby accelerating the adoption of software-defined mobility systems. Through its innovative software solutions and strategic partnerships, Apex.AI is at the forefront of transforming the mobility industry, facilitating the development of next-generation vehicles and systems. description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Locations:  Austin or London</strong></p> <p><strong>About the Role</strong></p> <p>Cloudflare Workers, launched in 2017, has evolved from a simple functions-as-a-service offering into a powerful full-stack development platform. Workers empowers developers to build sophisticated applications, leveraging numerous frameworks, tools, and integrations. Wrangler, the CLI for Cloudflare’s developer platform, plays a critical role in this, as do the surrounding tools that developers use including AI coding agents, IDEs and framework integrations.</p> <p>Your mission in this role is to ensure that the “hands-on-keyboard” experience of building Workers is seamless, intuitive, and delightful — getting down to the fine-grained details that matter to developers.</p> <p><strong>What You’ll Do</strong></p> <ul> <li>Talk directly with developers and customers big and small, every day.</li> <li>Drive the strategy, roadmap, and execution for <a href="https://www.npmjs.com/package/wrangler">Wrangler CLI</a>, and the broader developer tooling ecosystem around Cloudflare Workers.</li> <li>Lead initiatives from ideation through launch, ensuring ongoing enhancements based on developer feedback.</li> <li>Engage closely with developer communities to understand their workflows, challenges, and tooling needs.</li> <li>Collaborate closely with internal engineering teams, external framework authors, and open-source maintainers to maximize compatibility and ease-of-use with Workers.</li> <li>Partner cross-functionally with Product Marketing, Developer Relations, Sales, and Customer Support teams.</li> <li>Represent Cloudflare externally at conferences, community events, customer meetings, and developer-focused initiatives.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Examples of Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience</strong></p> <ul> <li> <ul> <li>Proven experience as an EM, PM or founder. You’ve led teams to ship before and can point to impact.</li> <li>Deep empathy for developers and understanding of their workflows, pain points, and how they adopt new tools and platforms. You understand what it’s like to write code that relies on services, tools and systems built by others.</li> <li>Hands-on ability to write code and use AI and the Internet to learn new things fast.</li> <li>Exceptional communication and collaboration skills, adept at working across diverse teams to align on goals and drive execution. You can translate between engineering domains.</li> <li>Passion for design details and polish. You raise the bar for sweating the details.</li> <li>External presentation skills. title: Data Platform Engineer (f/m/d)
description: Your mission We have challenging tasks for you: As a Data Platform Engineer, you will be responsible for building and evolving modern cloud platforms for Data & AI. In doing so, you will combine cloud infrastructure, platform architecture, and modern Data & AI technologies into solutions that create a stable foundation for analytics, data engineering, and AI use cases. In detail, you will: Design, build, and continuously evolve cloud-based Data & AI platforms Develop platform strategies and target architectures together with our clients and implement them technically Design scalable and robust platform architectures that serve as a foundation for data-driven solutions Provision modern cloud infrastructures on Azure or AWS automatically using Infrastructure as Code Work specifically with Terraform or OpenTofu as well as modern CI/CD processes Design and evolve Databricks platforms regarding workspaces, compute, networking, identity, security, and governance Make architecture decisions and establish best practices for performance, security, governance, scalability, and cost optimization Develop reusable platform blueprints, standards, and automations Evaluate new technologies and platform components and integrate them meaningfully into existing architectures Support data, analytics, and AI teams by providing stable and high-performance platforms Contribute to technical concepts, architecture workshops, and the further development of our standards together with our team Your profile What we are looking for You work in a structured manner, think in terms of platforms and architectures, and implement technical solutions cleanly and sustainably. Ideally, you bring to the table: Sound experience in building modern cloud infrastructures and platform architectures Excellent knowledge of at least one cloud platform, ideally Microsoft Azure or AWS Experience with Infrastructure as Code, e.g., Terraform, OpenTofu, Bicep, or comparable technologies A strong understanding of scalable, secure, and maintainable system and platform architectures Experience with technologies in the Data & AI domain, particularly Databricks Knowledge in areas such as cloud networking, identity & access management, security, and governance Basic software development skills, e.g., with Python, as well as experience handling APIs and automation Experience with Git and CI/CD A solid understanding of the requirements that data, analytics, ML, and AI workloads place on a modern platform A completed degree in Computer Science, Business Informatics, or a comparable qualification The ability to quickly learn new technologies and apply them purposefully A structured, self-reliant, and solution-oriented way of working Very good German skills (C2) and good English skills What we would also be happy to see: Experience with Databricks Unity Catalog and governance concepts Experience with Azure Private Link, VNet Integration, or comparable AWS networking concepts Knowledge of Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, or comparable CI/CD solutions Experience with Microsoft Fabric, Azure Data Factory, or other data platform technologies Experience with Landing Zones, platform blueprints, or standardized cloud deployments Experience in client projects and technical architecture workshops Certifications in the context of Databricks, Azure, or AWS Why us? Do you think in terms of platforms and architectures, enjoy working hands-on with Infrastructure as Code, and want to create sustainable foundations for data and AI applications? What awaits you with us: High-end tech & genuine appreciation: Modern Platform Engineering: You will design and automate scalable cloud Data & AI platforms on Azure or AWS. Databricks & Governance Excellence: Whether it's Unity Catalog, workspaces, cloud networking (such as Private Link), or Identity & Access Management—you will design secure, high-performance Databricks environments based on top best practices. Work-Life Balance & Flexibility: We embrace flexible working models—depending on the team and department, our colleagues work hybrid or remote-only. title: Backend Java Engineer
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About Airship</strong></p> <p>Airship is trusted by world’s leading brands such as Alaska Airlines, BBC and The Home Depot to drive revenue growth and customer loyalty with exceptional cross-channel customer experiences. Today, brands are challenged to deliver seamless, unified customer experiences across a fragmented array of channels and devices— apps, websites, email, SMS, wallets and more. </p> <p>Airship’s no-code, AI-powered platform was designed with non-technical, growth-focused teams in mind, making it easy to create, test and orchestrate hyper-personalized experiences across all channels. With the ability to easily enrich customer data and rapidly launch growth experiments, Airship enables brands to deliver consistent, meaningful interactions that accelerate conversion and foster deeper customer relationships.</p> <p>We invite you to be part of our journey in building products and delivering services that touch millions of customers around the world every day.</p> <p>To learn more about us, visit <a href="https://www.airship.com/" target="_blank" data-saferedirecturl="https://www.google.com/url?q=https://www.airship.com/&source=gmail&ust=1727358600004000&usg=AOvVaw3xEidfNT5kaSMR1LbqH2tz">www.airship.com</a>, read our <a href="https://www.airship.com/blog/" target="_blank" data-saferedirecturl="https://www.google.com/url?q=https://www.airship.com/blog/&source=gmail&ust=1727358600004000&usg=AOvVaw2S7rp6uesS3WbpmG9CFOaR">blog</a> or follow us on <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/airship-social" target="_blank" data-saferedirecturl="https://www.google.com/url?q=https://www.linkedin.com/company/airship-social&source=gmail&ust=1727358600004000&usg=AOvVaw2T3DnwhcK_pt63jzkrYdK6">LinkedIn.</a></p></div><h4>About the Role</h4> <p>As a Backend Java Engineer, you will design, develop, and support distributed systems that combine scale with high reliability. You will work on low-latency services that process continuous event streams and support analytical workloads across terabytes of data. Our backend infrastructure runs on Google Cloud Platform. It uses Java-based microservices and SQL and NoSQL databases. Avec plus de 150 collaborateurs engagés et 800 MWc de capacité installée, nous faisons avancer la transition énergétique à pleine vitesse. Nous couvrons toute la chaîne de valeur – du développement et de la construction à la gestion de l’énergie et à l’innovation. Perspektivisch soll die aktive Leadgenerierung und Neukundenansprache weiter ausgebaut werden. Vertriebsprozess: Steuerung des gesamten Sales Cycles vom Erstkontakt über Bedarfsanalyse, Produktvorführung und Angebot bis zum erfolgreichen Abschluss. Technischer Vertrieb: Aufnahme von Anforderungen und Lastenhefte sowie fachliche Mitgestaltung individueller Systemangebote gemeinsam mit den technischen Teams. Angebote & Ausschreibungen: Erstellung von Angeboten und Kalkulationen sowie Bearbeitung industrieller und öffentlicher Ausschreibungen. Kundenentwicklung: Betreuung bestehender Kunden nach dem Abschluss, Koordination von Lieferungen und Services sowie Identifikation von Folgegeschäft. Partnerschaften: Aufbau und Weiterentwicklung von Vertriebs- und Technologiepartnerschaften im In- und Ausland. Dein Profil als technischer Vertrieb Mindestens fünf Jahre Erfahrung im B2B Vertrieb technischer und erklärungsbedürftiger Systeme, idealerweise im Projektgeschäft mit hohem Auftragsvolumen Technischer Hintergrund durch ein Studium, eine Ausbildung oder fundierte praktische Erfahrung im technischen Vertrieb. Sicheres Verständnis für technische Anforderungen und die Fähigkeit, Lastenhefte zu erfassen und Systemangebote gemeinsam mit technischen Teams zu entwickeln. Erfahrung in der Angebotserstellung, Kalkulation und Bearbeitung von Ausschreibungen für industrielle oder öffentliche Auftraggeber. Nachweisbare Erfolge in der Neukundengewinnung und ein starkes Gespür für den Aufbau neuer Geschäftskontakte. Ausgeprägte Verhandlungsstärke und Abschlussorientierung sowie die Fähigkeit, Vertriebsprozesse konsequent vom Erstkontakt bis zum Abschluss zu führen. Bereitschaft, Vertriebsstrukturen eigenständig aufzubauen und Verantwortung für CRM, Pipeline, Angebotsprozesse und Vertriebsaktivitäten zu übernehmen. Fließende Deutschkenntnisse (ab C1) und verhandlungssicheres Englisch. Reisebereitschaft für Kundentermine, Messen und Produktvorführungen (ca. 20% Außendienst, größtenteils im Büro vor Ort) sowie Führerschein Klasse B. Eigenständige, strukturierte und unternehmerische Arbeitsweise mit hoher Kommunikationsstärke und Freude am direkten Kundenkontakt. Nice to have: Erfahrung im Defence oder Behördenumfeld, Kenntnisse in öffentlicher Vergabe, Erfahrung mit Drohnen, Sensorik, maritimen oder autonomen Systemen, Erfahrung im internationalen Vertrieb & Exportkontrolle, Erfahrung im Aufbau von Vertriebsteams. title: Mission Systems Engineer (m/w/d) / Space & Defense Industry
description: About the Company Infinite Orbits GmbH is the German subsidiary of Infinite Orbits SAS, a NewSpace company founded in 2017 that now has more than 200 employees, with locations including Luxembourg, the UK, Spain, and Singapore. The company develops in-orbit servicing solutions built on its own autonomous Rendezvous and Proximity Operations (RPO) technology, spanning awareness, surveillance, inspection, and protection of space assets through to life extension. With its newly established Munich site, Infinite Orbits builds a dedicated local presence in Germany, developing capabilities in business development, R&D, product development, system engineering, production, and mission operations to enable Europe's defense and space sector. About the Role As Mission Systems Engineer, you own the mission. You turn customer needs into feasible, defensible mission concepts for RPO and in-orbit servicing across space segment, ground segment, launch, operations, and user segment, and you define the requirements each segment has to meet. Proposal preparation is at the core of this role: you lead the technical volume of Infinite Orbits Germany's bids and RFI/RFP responses and provide the mission content for funding applications, from the first mission sketch to the submitted document. Working hand in hand with Business Development and the Proposal & Project Manager, you shape the technical solution that qualifies an opportunity and wins it, building on proven product and technology solutions from Engineering in Toulouse and other Group entities. Once contracts are won, you carry your mission concept into execution. As a founding technical hire, you own the analysis that underpins every German proposal and delivery. Job Description Technical proposal lead: Lead the technical volume of RFI/RFP responses and customer proposals and provide mission content for national and European funding applications: mission concept, solution description, feasibility evidence, and technical risks and mitigations. Provide technical input to the compliance matrix, work breakdown structure, schedule, and cost, which the Proposal & Project Manager owns. Bid strategy & win themes: Work with Business Development and the Proposal & Project Manager on bid/no-bid decisions, win themes, and technical discriminators; drive technical reviews and answer clarification questions through to submission. title: Senior Product Manager, Search Infrastructure
description: <h3><strong><span data-ccp-props="{}">The role</span></strong></h3> <p>Tavily, part of Nebius, is the web access layer for AI agents. Over two million developers use us, and our customers include Fortune 500 companies running agents in production.</p> <p>We build and run our own index. That means we own the hard problems directly: crawl coverage at scale, freshness, cost per query, and the quality of what comes back. This role owns that infrastructure as a product.</p> <p>When an agent asks a question, the answer has to be relevant, fresh, fast, and affordable. Those four things pull against each other, and someone has to decide which one gives. That is you. You will set what good means for each use case we serve and the bar a change has to clear before it ships, working closely with our evaluation team, who own how we measure it. You will also shape where our index goes next: what it needs to cover, how fresh it needs to be, and what it has to be good at.</p> <p>The most open part of the job is what comes next. Search is being rebuilt for a consumer that is not a person. Agents do not want one result page, they want to break a problem apart, run many retrievals, and decide what to do next. That changes what search infrastructure should look like, and part of your job is to have a view on where ours should go.</p> <p>The hard part is deciding what good enough means. Perfect coverage, perfect freshness, and low cost cannot all be true at once, and the person in this seat is the one who has to make that call for each use case and defend it.</p> <p>In your first year, we expect you to set a clear quality bar for our search products that the team builds against, have a real influence on where our index goes next, and bring us a point of view on where search infrastructure is heading.</p> <p>This is a hands-on senior IC role with real ownership, reporting to the Director of Product. You will work day to day with our search engineering and research teams, with the evaluation team, and with customer success, who bring us quality feedback from real accounts every week. Our search engineers are deeply experienced in large-scale retrieval, and the product team is small, so you will argue your case directly with the people building it. That only works if you have built at this scale yourself.</p> <p><strong><span data-contrast="auto"><span data-ccp-charstyle="Strong">Your responsibilities will include:</span></span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":true,"134233118":true}"> </span></p> <ul> <li>Set the quality bar and release criteria for search: what good means per use case, and what a change has to clear before it ships. 3.12, asyncio) — translating POST/DELETE into network deployments: resource allocation (IPAM, port/route-distinguisher/GRE-ID pools), Postgres-backed job queues (<code>SKIP LOCKED</code>), retries, rollback on partial failure, deploy/decommission runners, and long-running health-check and reconciliation daemons.</li> <li><strong>The network automation layer</strong> — Ansible + asyncssh/netmiko over ADS to edge and gateway Envoy fleets.</li> <li><strong>Production</strong> — Prometheus/Telegraf metrics and alerting, Bugsnag, customer escalations that span app logic and the network, and billing sync (MRC) for network resources.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Tech stack (what you'll actually touch)</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Languages:</strong> Python (asyncio: aiohttp, uvloop, SQLAlchemy, Ansible / ansible-runner, netmiko, asyncssh, NetBox-style IPAM (pynetbox, netaddr)</li> <li><strong>Proxy / data plane:</strong> Envoy, xDS (ADS, go-control-plane)</li> <li><strong>Vendor & cloud:</strong> Equinix Fabric, Equinix Metal, AWS / Azure / GCP interconnect regions</li> <li><strong>Platform:</strong> Docker/OCI, GitHub Actions, HashiCorp Vault, OpenAPI 3 + Redocly, pytest (unit → e2e), mypy/ruff/black</li> <li><strong>Architecture:</strong> clean/hexagonal (usecases, repository interfaces, adapters) — the service is structured, not a script pile</li> </ul> <p><strong>Who we're looking for</strong></p> <ul> <li>You've built and operated customer-facing REST APIs over real infrastructure — APIs where a POST ends in a router being configured, not just a row inserted — and you've lived with the async-job, rollback, and eventual-consistency problems that creates.</li> <li>Strong async Python in production, and comfortable writing and reviewing Go.</li> <li>Working routing knowledge: you can configure and debug BGP sessions, VRFs, GRE tunnels, NAT, and WireGuard, and read FRR or VyOS configs. Certification not required; hands-on ability is.</li> <li>Postgres beyond ORM basics — migrations on live systems, locking semantics, queue patterns.</li> <li>Fleet automation over SSH — Ansible at production scale, idempotent roles, safe rollout/rollback, drift detection.</li> <li>You've debugged incidents across layers in one sitting — <code>tcpdump</code>, <code>wg show</code>, <code>vtysh</code>, and application logs — ending in either a code fix or a config fix, and knowing which.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Bonus points for</strong></p> <ul> <li>Envoy/xDS control-plane work (go-control-plane, ADS snapshots).</li> <li>Cloud interconnect products — AWS Direct Connect, Azure ExpressRoute, GCP Partner Interconnect, or Equinix Fabric/Metal provisioning APIs.</li> <li>IPAM internals (NetBox or equivalent), address-plan and route-distinguisher design.</li> <li>Linux → VyOS (or equivalent NOS) migration experience on live customer traffic.</li> <li>Mobile core exposure — routing toward PGW/PCEF/EPC, GRE toward packet gateways.</li> <li>OpenAPI spec authorship and public developer documentation.</li> <li>Operating multi-site PoP fleets (bare metal + Equinix-hosted).</li> </ul> <p><strong>What this role is not</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Not a NetOps/NOC role.</strong> The deliverable is software — APIs, control planes, automation — not manual device changes.</li> <li><strong>Not a pure backend CRUD role.</strong> If the network layer in the stack above reads as someone else's problem, this is the wrong fit.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p> </p> <p> </p></div> Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Available Locations: </span></strong><span style="font-size: 12pt;">London (UK)</span></p> <h2><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>About the Role</strong></span></h2> <p>Reporting to the Vulnerability Manager, the VM  Engineer will be responsible for identifying, analysing, and supporting the remediation of vulnerabilities across Cloudflare's Infrastructure and cloud environments.You will work closely with Engineering, Infrastructure, cloud and compliance teams to identify, triage, and drive timely and effective remediation of security vulnerabilities in line with defined SLAs. A key focus of the role will be supporting DOD IL4 and Fedramp preparation, ensuring vulnerability processes, evidence, and tooling align with regulatory and assurance requirements. You will also apply AI-driven tools and methodologies to enhance scanning efficiency, triage accuracy, and automated remediation pathways. We are looking for a proactive, detail oriented individual with the ability to manage multiple remediation activities in parallel.</p> <h2><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Responsibilities</strong></span></h2> <ul> <li>Conduct vulnerability scanning, and perform in-depth analysis of  findings from scanning tools (e.g., Qualys, Nessus, Rapid7), to verify accuracy, identify systemic patterns, and filter out false positives.</li> <li>Triage, validate and prioritise vulnerabilities using risk based approaches to determine real business impact, and working with engineering and compliance teams to agree remediation actions and timelines.</li> <li>Develop, document, and deliver technical remediation guidance and solutions to enable application and infrastructure teams to remediate efficiently and consistently.</li> <li>Support DOD IL4 and Fedramp preparation, by ensuring vulnerability management processes, evidence, reporting, and controls meet regulatory and assurance expectations.</li> <li>Work closely with engineering and service teams to embed vulnerability management into delivery pipelines , operational processes and change management. </li> <li>Leverage AI security tools and automation to streamline triage, pattern recognition, and risk prioritisation.</li> <li>Establish strong relationships with engineering teams to track and report status and remediation progress</li> <li>Manage and track the remediation backlog, maintaining focus on risk reduction and measurable progress.</li> <li>Contribute to the continuous improvement of vulnerability management standards, procedures, and playbooks, ensuring alignment with IL4, Fedramp and other compliance requirements.</li> </ul> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Must-Have Skills</strong></span></p> <ul> <li>Solid understanding of DoD Impact level IL4, FedRAMP, SOC-2, and PCI frameworks.</li> <li>3+ years  Vulnerability Management experience in a heavily regulated environment.</li> <li>Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or security certifications in a related field.</li> <li>Strong communication (written and verbal) and interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively collaborate with technical and non-technical teams.</li> <li>A strong understanding of CVSS (Common Vulnerability Scoring System) and how to apply risk assessment methodologies in a business context to support remediation..</li> <li>Hands-on experience with vulnerability scanning platforms (e.g., Qualys, Nessus, Rapid7 InsightVM).</li> <li>Strong analytical skills to identify patterns in data and distinguish between theoretical risk and actual exploitability.</li> <li>Practical experience using AI-powered security tools or generative AI assistants to accelerate vulnerability triage, code analysis, or remediation guidance.</li> </ul> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Nice-to-Have Skills</strong></span></p> <ul> <li>Experience with scripting languages (e.g., Python) for automation.</li> <li>Proficiency in using ticketing tools like JIRA for managing tickets and tasks.</li> <li>Experience integrating LLMs or AI APIs into cybersecurity workflows and automation pipelines.</li> <li>Hands on experience with Infrastructure pentesting tools.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Equity</strong></p> <p>This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.</p> <p><strong>Benefits</strong></p> <p>Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family.  Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun!  The below is a description of our benefits for employees in the United States, and benefits may vary for employees based outside the U.S.</p> <p><strong>Health & Welfare Benefits</strong></p> <ul> <li>Medical/Rx Insurance</li> <li>Dental Insurance</li> <li>Vision Insurance</li> <li>Flexible Spending Accounts</li> <li>Commuter Spending Accounts</li> <li>Fertility & Family Forming Benefits</li> <li>On-demand mental health support and Employee Assistance Program</li> <li>Global Travel Medical Insurance</li> </ul> <p><strong>Financial Benefits</strong></p> <ul> <li>Short and Long Term Disability Insurance</li> <li>Life & Accident Insurance</li> <li>401(k) Retirement Savings Plan</li> <li>Employee Stock Participation Plan</li> </ul> <p><strong>Time Off</strong></p> <ul> <li>Flexible paid time off covering vacation and sick leave</li> <li>Leave programs, including parental, pregnancy health, medical, and bereavement leave</li> </ul> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. title: Senior OSINT Data Analyst
description: Datenna is a fast-growing tech scale-up combining cutting-edge OSINT and AI technologies to provide governments with critical insights into China's techno-economic landscape. Our platform transforms open-source intelligence into actionable insights through advanced data processing and analysis. The Role: As Senior OSINT Data Analyst you will sit at the core of Datenna’s product operations and act as a domain authority for our data. You will define which foreign-language sources we collect for each region we cover, set and defend the standards that data is held to, and turn complex registry, procurement, and patent material into structured, platform-ready intelligence. You will own major areas of coverage end to end, guide the analysts around you, and be a trusted voice in product decisions. Your mission at Datenna: Analysis and data intelligence Apply deep regional domain knowledge to develop products that identify, map, and classify entities across corporate, academic, defence-industrial, and innovation landscapes, with a focus on state-military-commercial integration, dual-use technologies, state ownership, and technology transfer. Use pattern-recognition skills to connect corporate, state, and military actors, including opaque ownership structures and intermediaries, and generate structured intelligence that feeds directly into Datenna’s platform. Make and defend analytical judgements on entity risk labelling, ownership mapping, and procurement tracking, prioritising platform-ready outputs over long-form research deliverables. Data Collection, quality and lifecycle management Define and own data collection workstreams end to end: identifying, evaluating, and extracting structured information from non-English sources including corporate registries, procurement portals, patent databases, academic repositories, and state media. Manage data across its full lifecycle, from initial acquisition and parsing through cleaning, enrichment, validation, and delivery into Datenna’s platform, maintaining rigorous standards so that every data point is traceable, accurate, and defensible. Work closely with the Data Lead to set and continuously refine data quality benchmarks, turning observations from collection and testing work into improvements to automated pipelines. Product development Play a leading role in Datenna’s data-driven product development cycle, contributing regional domain expertise to the design, testing, and refinement of new platform features and data products. Shape how Datenna’s proprietary risk labelling systems evolve, drawing on hands-on OSINT experience to identify edge cases and improve classification accuracy. Map gaps in Datenna’s data coverage against what customers need, and make the case for the sources, methods, and investment required to close them, including the extension of our approach to new regions. Coordination and collaboration Coordinate between data researchers and software developers to support smooth data processing pipelines, translating analytical requirements into clear technical specifications. Set the methodological standard for OSINT work as the team grows: reviewing outputs, mentoring junior and medior researchers on OSINT tradecraft, and ensuring work meets Datenna’s data quality standards. What makes you a great candidate: 8-10 years of hands-on OSINT experience, including direct collection, verification, and analysis from non-English open sources such as corporate registries, government procurement portals, patent databases, academic repositories, and state media. Demonstrable experience contributing to data-driven product development, whether through structured dataset creation, analytical input into software features, or validation of intelligence platform outputs. Reading proficiency in Chinese at minimum HSK 4 level or equivalent, together with the ability to independently source, interrogate, and extract structured data from foreign-language materials. Working proficiency in Russian is preferred. Strong knowledge of at least one region’s corporate sector, innovation ecosystem, defence-industrial base, industrial policy, and the intersection of state, military, and commercial actors, with the ability to identify entity-level connections across Datenna’s key domains and to learn new jurisdictions quickly. Proficiency in both qualitative and quantitative research methods, with experience producing analytical outputs for non-specialist audiences and presenting findings to customers or senior stakeholders. Familiarity with data analysis tools such as Python, R, or SQL, and comfort working with large structured datasets and contributing to data pipelines. Experience with name-matching and transliteration at scale, for example Chinese or Cyrillic, is an advantage. A postgraduate qualification in Area Studies, International Relations, Security Studies, or a related field is preferred. *Please know that applicants may be subject to a screening process.* AI is part of how we build We use AI tools extensively to move faster and raise quality, and we focus our human attention on the work where judgment, creativity, and responsibility matter most. We expect every candidate to be comfortable using AI in their day-to-day work in a responsible manner and to continuously look for better ways to apply it. Work on globally impactful projects in geopolitical intelligence Lead innovation in OSINT and AI technologies Competitive compensation and benefits Dynamic, international team environment Significant growth opportunities in a scale-up When you apply to this position, we will process your personal data according to our Recruitment Privacy Notice . title: Senior Product Manager (f/m/x)
description: Your Mission This is a company built for growth, not comfort. When you join exmox, you're stepping onto a global, highly competitive playing field, solving real problems in environments that push you beyond your comfort zone. We build high-performing consumer products in one of the most competitive industries there is: mobile gaming, leading one of its largest innovations, a rewarded user engagement and acquisition platform that helps publishers acquire and retain players through rewarding experiences. Senior Product Manager (f/m/x) isn't just about shipping features, it's about building products that perform. Product at exmox means understanding the bigger business picture, considering cross-functional impact across Engineering, Data, Marketing, and Operations, and turning strategy into product decisions that create real value, knowing every change you ship affects millions of users. At exmox, we're also embracing AI as part of how we work, not just what we build. We use AI tools to work smarter, cut down on repetitive tasks and spend our time where it actually moves the needle. If that mindset speaks to you, you'll fit right in. If you're energized by dynamic markets, complex products, and the challenge of building products that perform at scale, we want to hear from you. What You’ll Own: Own one of exmox's highest-impact product domains end-to-end, shaping the reward economy through payout thresholds, tiering, bonuses, promotions, and other key levers that drive profitability. Drive activation, retention, and long-term engagement through onboarding experiences, streaks, quests, progression systems, reactivation flows, and other lifecycle initiatives. Take new growth opportunities from first hypothesis to go/no-go decision, across product, market expansion, partnerships, and distribution. Lead a high-quality experimentation process by defining hypotheses, designing statistically sound A/B tests, interpreting results, and making data-driven product decisions. Partner closely with your dedicated Data Analyst to uncover opportunities, validate assumptions, and continuously improve product performance. Work with Engineering, Design, Commercial, User Acquisition, Customer Support, Fraud, and Leadership to align priorities and deliver impactful product improvements. Represent your product domain directly to leadership, using data, customer insights, and business context to influence strategic decisions. What Success Looks Like: You take ownership quickly: Within your first months, you've become the trusted owner of a critical product domain, confidently driving priorities, making decisions, and reducing dependency on leadership. Growth metrics measurably improve: Your product strategy and experimentation drive meaningful improvements in activation, retention, and long-term user profitability. Product decisions are driven by data: Experiments, user insights, and product analytics provide clear evidence to prioritize opportunities, validate ideas, and confidently decide what to scale - or stop. Cross-functional teams are aligned around outcomes: You partner closely with Engineering, Design, Data, Commercial, and User Acquisition to deliver product improvements that balance user value with business impact. You turn ambitious ideas into scalable growth: Through structured experimentation, clear prioritization, and continuous optimization, you build product experiences that become repeatable growth levers for the business. You outgrow the role: We are hiring for the ceiling, not just the opening. This role is scoped to grow - mentoring other product managers first, and leading a product team as we scale, if that is the direction you want to take. What You Bring Experienced: You bring 5+ years of Product Management experience in consumer-facing digital products, ideally within mobile apps, gaming, marketplaces, subscriptions, ad-tech, fintech, or other high-growth B2C businesses. You have owned consumer product at scale - hundreds of thousands of monthly active users or more. Business-Oriented: You understand that product decisions are business decisions. You're comfortable balancing user needs, commercial objectives, and technical constraints to maximize long-term value. Fluent in Incentives: You have a real feel for why people come back and what makes a reward feel worth the effort. You have designed incentive, reward or progression mechanics and calibrated them so they motivate without eroding margin. Experimentation-Driven: You have extensive experience running A/B tests, defining hypotheses, interpreting data, and making evidence-based product decisions. Statistical thinking comes naturally to you. Data-Literate: You're comfortable working with product metrics and collaborating closely with analysts to uncover insights, measure success, and prioritize opportunities. Strategic & Hands-on: You enjoy defining product strategy while remaining deeply involved in execution - from writing specifications and refining solutions to reviewing experiment results and driving delivery. Collaborative: You build strong partnerships across Product, Engineering, Design, Analytics, Marketing, Commercial, and Leadership, bringing people together around clear product goals. Intellectually Honest: You're comfortable working in ambiguity, take ownership without waiting for direction, and thrive in fast-moving environments where priorities evolve quickly. You also kill your own ideas when the data says so - being wrong early is cheaper than being right late. How We Win Speed is the feature. Speed beats rocket science. We move fast, test fast, and multiply our pace with AI, because action creates information and small wins compound. A fast failure is a lesson we learn from, a slow one is a problem we can't afford. Focus on the essential. Done is better than perfect. We stay focused on what actually moves us forward and protect people's time from anything that doesn't. We're direct in how we communicate too, no rambling, no unnecessary detail. See it. Own it. Solve it. The first to see it is best placed to fix it. We're not a place for comfort, we're a place for doers. "Not my job" isn't in our vocabulary, if you spot something, you help make sure it gets solved. Respect others. Trust multiplies. Respect is non-negotiable. We disagree with ideas, never with people. Trust here is built the same way it is anywhere, through consistency, a thank you, a moment of listening, and owning your mistakes. Perks that help you focus on what matters. Transport subsidy, learning budget, wellness and gym, workation, bi-weekly team lunches, and more. The perks are great, but the real reason people join and stay is the challenge, the ownership, and the drive to win together. Please note: this is not a remote only position, we offer you a flexible hybrid model here in Hamburg, Germany - working from home on Mondays & Fridays, coming to the office on Tuesday, Wednesday & Thursday! title: Senior Field Service Engineer (f/m/d)
description: We see the potential inside everything and everyone. Starting with you. Orbem uses AI to industrialize MRI, delivering non-invasive insight into everything from fruits to eggs to the human body. We are transforming what is becoming the world's largest biological dataset into actionable intelligence to reduce waste, increase quality, and accelerate the shift toward a more sustainable and healthier future. Headquartered and founded in Munich, Germany, with an office now in Houston, Texas, our world-class team is scaling inside-out technology to transform how humanity sees and understands biological matter. Help us see what's possible. Join us. Your Role As a Senior Field Service Engineer, you are the senior technical authority in the field for keeping Orbem's systems running reliably, at customer sites and in our own labs. You own the end-to-end resolution of complex, unplanned service incidents from start to finish, acting as the escalation point when others can't crack a problem. You adapt solutions to local site conditions, mentor junior Field Engineers, and help build the maintenance playbooks that don't fully exist yet. You're also fully qualified to guide installation efforts when the team needs additional senior capacity, making you one of the most versatile and trusted members of our Field Operations team. Note: Travel is required up to 70% (mainly in the EU); a European driver's license is required. Your Day-to-Day Own end-to-end diagnosis and resolution of complex, previously unresolved, or urgent service incidents at customer sites and in our internal labs, without needing to escalate for a resolution. Act as the primary escalation point for difficult repairs raised by junior Field Engineers or Field Service Engineers, and the go-to technical contact for suppliers/partners on-site. Thoughtfully tailor maintenance and troubleshooting approaches to local site conditions, documenting the rationale for any deviation from standard procedure. Own the creation and continuous improvement of maintenance and service SOPs/checklists, driving the PDCA cycle for the servicing function. Mentor and coach junior Field Engineers/Field Service Engineers on troubleshooting best practices and technical judgment. Lead Site Visit Checklist execution and technical problem-solving during installation and upgrade projects when deployed as senior surge capacity. Act as the primary technical feedback loop to Engineering, interpreting field/lab findings, escalating risks, and proposing solutions rather than just reporting raw data. Your responsibilities include: Trusted to own the technical resolution of complex, high-stakes service incidents from first response through root cause, supplier coordination, and documentation, while serving as the senior technical anchor for the wider Field Operations team across both servicing and installation work. Your Experience and Skills You have significant, hands-on experience diagnosing and resolving complex electrical, mechanical, or automation issues in an industrial or field-service environment, ideally including experience as the senior/primary troubleshooter on a team. You have strong working knowledge of electrical diagrams, AutoCAD, and automation/networking concepts (PLC, Modbus, or similar). You are comfortable being the final escalation point for urgent, unplanned technical issues, making autonomous, well-reasoned decisions under time pressure without waiting for sign-off. You have experience mentoring, training, or informally guiding less experienced technical colleagues. You have experience creating or improving technical SOPs, checklists, or maintenance processes, not just executing them. You are willing to travel extensively and can react to short-notice, urgent dispatch needs, including occasional weekend or after-hours support. You hold, or are willing to obtain, relevant electrical/technical certifications (e.g. EFK-equivalent). You are fluent in English (written and spoken), our working language. You are fluent in Italian (written and spoken), enabling direct, seamless support for our growing base of Italian customers and sites. What Makes You Stand Out Experience servicing MRI systems, medical devices, or other highly regulated industrial equipment; a track record of standing up a maintenance function or service SOPs from scratch in a scale-up environment. Additional working proficiency in German and/or Spanish is a strong plus, further extending our on-site language coverage across Europe. Fit to Our Values We Own Every Challenge: we enjoy complexity and thrive under uncertainty. We Strive for Better: we seize any opportunity for growth and challenge the status quo. We are constantly learning and improving. We Imagine New Frontiers: we think beyond “doable” and “reasonable”. We design a sustainable and healthy future together. What We Offer International Environment: Join a team with 40+ nationalities across 5 continents, all driven by a shared purpose: shedding light on the world’s toughest challenges. Comprehensive Benefits: Stock Options: Share in Orbem’s success. Relocation Support: Seamless support for your move to Germany. Learning & Development: €1,750 annual budget for personal growth. Fitness Membership: Access to Urban Sports Club or Wellpass. Childcare Reimbursement: Support for Kita/Kindergarten fees. Deutschland Ticket: Full coverage of public transportation. Work-Life Integration: Flexible Hours & Home Office: Work when and where it suits you. WFH Perks: Get €185 to upgrade your home office + an external monitor on us! 30 Days Paid Leave: Plenty of time to recharge. Personal Leave: Flexibility for life’s important moments. Work From Anywhere: Experience new cultures and environments for up to 60 days per year. Make a Difference: Join an ambitious, fast-growing team working on breakthrough technology. In our scale-up environment, you'll have the freedom to lead your projects and make an impact. We provide a platform for you to explore, innovate, and define your vision for the future. At Orbem, we're committed to helping you discover your strengths, and while we aim to teach you, we also want to learn from you. Your Team: You'll become part of our diverse and international team. Learn more about the team members, their work, and challenges here: https://orbem.ai/company/ At Orbem, we're committed to building a smart, diverse team, and we recognize that self-doubt can prevent talented individuals from applying. If you feel you don't meet every requirement, we'd love to hear from you anyway! title: Senior Sales Manager Germany
description: 🏨 The Company Resilience Care, a leading player in remote medical monitoring and a partner in clinical research, is a French company founded in 2021 with a single mission: to provide better care. Our company offers telemonitoring solutions in oncology, psychiatry, and gastroenterology, based on the collection of ePROs combined with AI technologies. These solutions rely on a monitoring platform for healthcare professionals—enabling the early detection of side effects for continuous and proactive care—and a mobile app for patients, empowering them to measure and manage their symptoms using tailored resources. Our solutions optimize patient care, continuously enrich our understanding of patients throughout their healthcare journey, and accelerate clinical research through the collection, structuring, and in-depth analysis of real-world data. Today, our solutions are deployed in routine care for 42,000 patients across more than 200 healthcare facilities, as well as within the framework of around twenty academic and industrial clinical trials. Through this, we put data at the service of healthcare and therapeutic innovation, driven by the ambition to enable every patient to benefit from personalized medicine. In Germany, Resilience Care started building the market for telemonitoring in 2025. We work with university hospitals, hospital groups and medical practices, run clinical studies at German sites, and are actively involved in shaping the framework for telemonitoring reimbursement. 📝 Your Role In a few words As our first Senior Sales Manager in Germany, you own new-business sales for our telemonitoring solutions: you build the pipeline, lead complex sales cycles with medical practices, hospitals and hospital groups, and close the contracts that bring telemonitoring into routine care. title: DevOps Engineer

We've spent years watching talented engineering teams lose momentum to the same frustrating bottleneck: waiting. Waiting for CI to finish. Waiting for builds to complete. Waiting for tests to run. Something that would seamlessly integrate with our workflows and the tools teams already love—but make everything dramatically faster and more cost-effective. Today, we're already accelerating hundreds of companies around the world, helping them ship features instead of waiting for infrastructure. title: Country Executive
description: The finance function is broken. Everyone building for it is boring. Fast-growing multi-entity companies get two options: duct-tape a Frankenstack, or surrender to a corporate ERP and its consultant army. Both are bad. Both are beatable. Beating them market by market is this job. Light is the AI-native financial platform for modern companies. Fast to implement, intuitive to use, smarter every month. We call it organic software. Legora, Lovable, and Fuse Energy run on it. Product ships something worth shouting about every single week. What we don't have is a single person on the ground in your country. THIS IS NOT A COUNTRY MANAGER ROLE. Most first-in-market hires get a quota, a deck, and a flight. They repeat the London pitch in a local accent and forward complaints to HQ. This is the opposite. This is a founding hire for someone who wants far more scope than their years of experience would get them anywhere else. No entity. No local team. No local playbook. You are Light's first boots on the ground in your market, and within a year you should know that market's complexity - its rules, its buyers, its excuses - better than anyone else. It's not a leadership title. It's the seed of one. Do this right and there's a real path: stand up an entity, hire a team around you, move into product, or run the region as GM. WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING. Sitting across from finance leaders. Real conversations, not discovery calls off a script. You find out what they actually need - the thing behind the thing they asked for - and you come back with it written down clearly enough for engineers to build against. Being the connective tissue. Customer, product, commercial. What you learn in-market changes how Light builds and how Light sells. You are the wire between them, and the wire has to carry current in both directions. Owning the local rulebook. Compliance, regulation, filing, the specific ways finance is done badly in your country. You're the person in the room who genuinely knows this, and you make sure it shows up in the product and in the pitch. Having a public point of view. Ideally you arrive with a finance background and an opinion on what "doing finance right" looks like here. Bring it into the market, into the roadmap, and into how every prospect sees Light. Relationships, events, brand presence - built from zero, by you. Closing, with London behind you. Our sales team helps you manage and push deals over the line. You bring the market and customer understanding that makes those conversations land. They support you; they don't carry you and you don't carry it alone. HOW WE'LL KEEP SCORE. This isn't a pure revenue seat, but growing your country's ARR is the primary goal and you're tied directly to that number. A starting point will be set on what you're measured against on day one and you have to prove your worth. WHAT WE'LL ASK FOR. The thing you built from nothing. A company, a market, a GTM motion, a product. Something that existed because you hacked through a messy sale with no playbook. First question in the first call. Credibility in front of a CFO. A finance background ideally, or enough substance that a finance leader takes you seriously the moment you walk in. You can't be the voice of the market without an ear for the buyer. 2+ years as a founder or co-founder. Ex-founder or very early operator. We want the scar tissue. 6+ years somewhere fast. High-growth tech, top-tier strategy consulting, investment banking, or similar. Or a body of work that makes the number irrelevant. Structured thinking under mess. Exceptional analytical instincts, applied to markets nobody has mapped for you yet. Fluency in your market's language and in English. Both, properly. Extra credit: exposure to accounting, enterprise software, fintech or SaaS as a user, buyer or advisor; time spent presenting to senior finance stakeholders; an existing finance network in your market - or a demonstrated, unembarrassed intent to build one. THE GOOD STUFF. 💸 Competitive salary plus potential stock options. 🏝 25 days annual leave plus public holidays where you're based. 🚀 A genuine chance to build a market from the ground up and grow with it. 🥳 Regular socials and company off-sites - the last one was in Italy. 🌍 Time with the team in London, Copenhagen, Munich, NY, Paris and wherever the action is. HOW TO APPLY. Show us who you are, not just your CV. Tell us what you built and what it did in numbers. Then answer the only question that matters: why this one? Anyone can say they want to work at a startup. A generic AI-written cover letter with no craft behind the prompt will be obvious - and is its own kind of answer. If this reads as too much scope for one person: it is. That's the seat. Light is an equal opportunity employer. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: AI Support Engineer Lead
description: About Dust Work is being rewritten, and the people holding the pen are the ones who actually run it. With enterprise-grade governance, flexible model choice, and a collaborative interface for humans and agents to work together, Dust empowers AI Operators at the world’s fastest-moving companies to rewire how work gets done. With 70%+ weekly active users, people stick with Dust as much as they do with Slack and Notion. We don't get piloted and shelved. We land once, and spread. We're at an exciting stage of our journey, and growing fast. We're serving great customers like Datadog, 1Password, Cursor, Clay, Vanta and Persona, and aim to x5 our growth by the end of 2026. Dust is backed by Sequoia with a determined team of optimists (coming from Stripe, OpenAI, and Stanford) who like to focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously while doing so. The Generalist named us among the Future 50 . Summary At Dust, we're building for a new kind of AI Operator : people who rethink and rebuild how their teams work around AI. Not “how can AI help us do this faster?” but “if AI existed from day one, would we even do this the same way?” As our AI Support Engineering Lead , you'll own how Support is built and scaled at Dust. This is a deeply hands-on role. You'll take on the hardest customer issues when our agents fall short, but your job isn't simply to resolve them. You'll look for the pattern behind each issue and turn what you learn into better agents, automation, tooling, documentation, and product improvements. Over time, you'll help grow the team and shape how Support Engineering operates as Dust scales. You'll define, ship, and continuously iterate on the systems that make this possible: AI agents, automation workflows, classification systems, knowledge systems, and tooling built on top of Dust itself. You'll dogfood the product harder than almost anyone at the company and set the standard for how the rest of the Support Engineering team does the same. We're looking for someone who wants to lead from the work: technically strong, obsessed with building better systems, and excited to shape both the team and the function as we grow. What you'll do Build the AI systems that do the work Set the technical direction for the support stack: what gets automated, in what order, and to what standard. You make the calls, not just the builds. Design, ship, and maintain AI agents and automation workflows that reduce manual support load: think ticket classification, acknowledgment automation, response drafting, incident detection, and proactive user outreach. Identify recurring categories of issues and engineer them out of existence through automation, documentation, prompt iteration, or product feedback. Build and maintain tooling (MCP integrations, Dust agents, internal scripts) that increase the team's capacity without increasing headcount. Define and own the "Support as a Product" backlog. You decide what goes on it, coach the team to execute it, and hold the bar on what shipped means. Run support when the systems fall short Hire, onboard, and develop the support engineers around you. You're not just resolving tickets and building systems, you're growing the people who will. Set the standard for how complex issues get handled at Dust. You take the hardest tickets yourself. The team knows what good looks like because they've watched you do it. Investigate complex issues across logs, code, and internal tooling to identify root causes and provide clear answers to customers. Handle escalated cases with precise, accessible communication for both technical and non-technical audiences. Systematically analyze agent-generated responses for inconsistencies and iterate on prompts, documentation, and tooling until human intervention is minimal. Bridge customer pain to product improvements Represent support at the engineering and product level. You synthesize signal, prioritize it, and push it through with enough context that it actually moves things, not just relays it. Build strong working relationships with engineers and customer-facing teams to ensure efficient, high-context escalations. Own the feedback loop end-to-end: when agents fail due to missing or incorrect information, close the gap across engineering, product, and documentation. Requirements Every candidate and employee's success is measured against the same 3 dimensions: Aptitude, Attitude and Agency. Aptitude Function-building experience: You've defined or significantly shaped a support engineering function before: built the operating model, set the standards, hired into the team, or rebuilt a broken process from scratch. High technical aptitude: comfortable reading code, analyzing logs, navigating codebases, and troubleshooting distributed systems. You're not stopped by a stack trace. AI fluency at builder level: track record of building custom agents, automations, or workflows using AI tools (Dust, Cursor, Claude Code, n8n, etc.); not just prompting. Exceptional prioritization: You know what to solve immediately, what to automate, what to escalate, and, critically, what to delegate and to whom. You make these calls for yourself and for the team, fast and without second-guessing. People leadership: You've coached and developed engineers and know how to set expectations, give direct feedback, and raise the performance of the people around you. Bidirectional communication: can translate technical concepts to non-technical audiences and speak technical language fluently with engineers. Build/Run mindset: You believe the best Support Engineering teams don't just resolve issues. They build systems that prevent those issues from recurring. Attitude Builder mentality: You instinctively automate repetitive work rather than accepting inefficient systems, and you hold your team to the same standard. Resilience-empathy paradox: You can absorb customer frustration without taking it personally while still deeply caring about the user experience. Leads by example: You're not above the queue. When something is hard, you take it. Exceptional prioritization: You know what to solve immediately, what to automate, and what to escalate. Thrives in ambiguity: You enjoy building systems from scratch in environments where many processes are still undefined. Low ego, team player: You share knowledge freely and care about the success of the broader team. Agency High ownership: You define what needs to be done as often as you execute it. You don't wait for someone to tell you the function has a gap. Systems-first thinking: You focus on eliminating categories of work, not simply resolving tickets faster. You hold yourself and the team accountable to that distinction. Pattern recognition to repeatability: You turn recurring issues into scalable systems, automations, workflows, or documentation that eliminate future occurrences. Deep investigation instincts: You investigate as far as possible before escalating, providing engineering teams with thoughtful, high-context information when collaboration is needed, and you coach the team to do the same. Even if you don’t meet every requirement above, we still encourage you to apply. We care deeply about curiosity, potential, and determination, and we know exceptional people don’t always fit neatly into a checklist. Benefits & Compensation Competitive compensation based on level and experience 100,000€ - 160,000€ Significant equity package at a Sequoia-backed startup Health benefits for you and your dependents New MacBook Pro or Linux machine, monitor, keyboard, etc. Opportunity to travel between our Paris and San Francisco offices Regular team events and off-sites Location We're prioritizing building our team with an in-person culture at our offices in Paris, London, San Francisco, and New York because we value the magic that happens when talented people work closely together. We have an office-first culture. Some of the best things about building at Dust are the energy, the fast decisions, and the unexpected conversations that unlock a hard problem, which happen because we are in the same room. Being together is not a formality, it is how we do our best work, and it is something we actively protect. That said, we hire people with strong judgement and we extend that trust to how they manage their time. When working from home makes more sense for what you need to get done that day, we trust you to make that call. Why Dust The models are powerful enough. What's missing is the product layer where AI meets how companies actually work. That's what we're building: the infrastructure that lets any team turn scattered knowledge and tools into coordinated execution with agents they build, own, and run themselves. We use Dust ourselves every day. We get to shape how humans and agents collaborate while solving our own problems with the product we ship. That loop is rare, and it's why we move fast. If you're excited about defining a new category and want to join a determined team of optimists who focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously, we'd love to talk. Even if you don't check every box in our requirements, we encourage you to apply. We value diverse perspectives and backgrounds, and we're more interested in your potential and passion than a perfect match to our checklist. Learn how we think and work. Our product constitution, a story about our mission Your Next Co-Worker Isn’t Human , Stanislas Polu , VivaTech 2026. A conversation about AI agents taking on larger parts of work and how teams collaborate with them. Dust: Gabriel Hubert on Enterprise AI , Gabriel Hubert , Nasdaq, published May 7, 2026. title: Head of ClinOps Data Management RWD/RWE
description: À propos de Lifen Chez Lifen, nous pensons que les données médicales peuvent transformer le système de santé, à condition qu’elles soient accessibles. Mieux les faire circuler, c’est réduire la charge administrative, mieux coordonner les soins et accélérer la recherche clinique. Depuis 2015, nous développons des solutions qui aident les professionnels de santé à partager les informations médicales et les chercheurs à exploiter des données de santé. Plus de 150 personnes travaillent chez Lifen, depuis nos bureaux et à distance. Nous avons connecté 800 hôpitaux et 150 000 professionnels de santé en France. Notre équipe L’équipe Clinical Ops intervient au cœur de nos projets de recherche clinique fondés sur des données de santé. Elle transforme des documents médicaux en données structurées, nécessaires à la constitution de cohortes patients et à la préparation des exports utilisés dans nos projets de recherche. Aujourd’hui, l’équipe structure environ 100 à 200 cas patients par semaine . Notre ambition : tripler cette capacité dans les 9 prochains mois, tout en maintenant un haut niveau de qualité des données. Pour y parvenir, nous cherchons une personne capable de reprendre le management de l’équipe, mais surtout de piloter le flux de production, d’anticiper la charge et de porter une démarche d’amélioration continue avec les équipes Produit, IA et Engineering. C’est un rôle à la croisée du management opérationnel, de la RWD et de l’amélioration de processus . Ce que tu feras chez nous Ta première mission sera de reprendre le pilotage de la production des cohortes afin d’en améliorer simultanément la qualité, la capacité de traitement et le niveau d’automatisation . Concrètement, tu seras amené·e à : Manager et faire grandir l’équipe Clinical Ops, en donnant un cadre clair aux priorités et en organisant l’activité quotidienne. Anticiper la charge et piloter la capacité de production afin de limiter les bottlenecks et de mieux absorber les variations de volume. Construire les outils de pilotage nécessaires pour avoir une vision fine du flux : volumes de patients, capacité de traitement, taux d’erreur, points de blocage et charge de l’équipe. Construire et orchestrer une roadmap d’amélioration continue permettant progressivement d’augmenter la capacité de traitement. Porter cette roadmap auprès des équipes Produit, IA et Engineering : rendre les besoins opérationnels visibles, suivre les livrables R&D et créer le rythme nécessaire pour que les améliorations soient effectivement délivrées. Garantir la qualité des cohortes et contribuer à la préparation des exports de données nécessaires aux projets de recherche. Ce que nous attendrons de toi Dans les premiers mois, nous attendrons de toi que tu développes une compréhension très fine du flux Clinical Ops : où se trouvent les blocages, comment évolue la charge et quels leviers permettent réellement d'améliorer la production. Ton succès se mesurera notamment à ta capacité à mettre en place un pilotage fiable de l’activité, à réduire les erreurs et les bottlenecks et à créer, avec les équipes Produit et R&D, un rythme d’amélioration continue suffisamment soutenu pour accompagner notre changement d’échelle. À horizon 9 mois, l’objectif est clair : passer d’environ 100–200 à 300–600 cas patients structurés par semaine, sans multiplier les ressources par trois. Ce que nous recherchons Must-have Nous chercherons en priorité trois éléments dans ton parcours : Une expérience réussie en startup ou scale-up , dans un environnement où les process, outils et responsabilités restaient à construire. Une expérience concrète de la Real-World Data / Real-World Evidence , idéalement autour de la constitution ou de l'exploitation de cohortes patients. Un background santé ou scientifique te permettant de comprendre les enjeux liés aux données médicales et à la recherche clinique. Nous attendons également : Une expérience confirmée de management d’équipe opérationnelle . Une expérience de structuration et de pilotage d’une activité complexe à partir de données et de KPI. Une capacité à passer d’un problème opérationnel très concret à un plan d’amélioration structuré. Une expérience de collaboration étroite avec des équipes Produit, Data/IA ou Engineering . Une capacité à faire avancer une roadmap transverse et à créer de l’accountability autour des livrables. Nice-to-have Un parcours en data management, biostatistiques, épidémiologie ou dans un domaine scientifique proche. Une expérience de structuration de registres, bases de données de santé ou cohortes RWD. Une familiarité avec les enjeux de recherche clinique et les interactions avec les autorités de santé. Une bonne compréhension des usages de l’IA et de l’ingénierie appliqués aux données de santé. Ta manière de travailler Tu as une vraie “just do it mentality” : face à un problème imparfaitement cadré, tu commences par comprendre les faits, tu structures le problème et tu mets rapidement en place les premières solutions. Tu es particulièrement à l’aise dans les environnements où il faut créer les outils plutôt que simplement les utiliser. Si le dashboard dont tu as besoin pour piloter ton équipe n’existe pas, tu es capable de le définir et de le mettre en place. Tu es structuré·e et organisé·e, mais pas bureaucratique.
