title: Embedded Engineer
description: Accelerating embodied AGI. The next ten years of AI will not be won in software. They will be won in the physical world: in factories, hospitals, kitchens, fields, and homes. The companies that own that data will own the century. MicroAGI is building it. We are a data research and deployment lab. Atlas captures the manual work inside Europe’s industrial champions, trains foundation models on it, and deploys the right robot onto the floor, with no teleoperation and no interruption to the line. Shift records how physical work actually happens and turns it into training-ready data. We were founded by former Formula 1 engineers from Red Bull Racing and Mercedes, together with a researcher from the Alan Turing Institute. Our $55M seed round, the largest in German history, was led by Hummingbird with Northzone, LocalGlobe, Village Global, and redalpine. We are based in Munich, with our research centre in Zürich and teams in London, New York, and Istanbul. We are now building the engineering and research teams that will take Atlas into new industries. Our models learn from data captured in the physical world, by hardware we design and build ourselves. As Embedded Engineer, you will own the firmware that runs on that hardware, from the first register write to the moment data leaves the device, so that what reaches our ML team is clean, synchronized, and trustworthy. What You Will Do Write and own the firmware for our data-capture hardware: sensors, motion-capture rigs, custom IoT setups, and prototype robots. Build real-time data acquisition: drivers, DMA, buffering, and streaming from many sensors at once without dropping a sample. Solve multi-sensor synchronization, calibration, and time-stamping so every data point lines up across devices and modalities. Bring up new boards with our Electrical Engineer and turn fresh hardware into working devices fast. Build the path from device to dataset: communication protocols, on-device logging, and handoff into our data pipeline. Work shoulder to shoulder with ML engineers. Your firmware decides what their training data looks like, and a timing bug can quietly ruin months of data. Make firmware reliable in the field: testing, OTA updates, error handling, and diagnostics that tell us what went wrong. Requirements Up to 5 years writing production firmware for embedded or IoT systems. Strong C/C++, experience with an RTOS (FreeRTOS, Zephyr, or similar), and deep familiarity with microcontrollers (STM32, ESP32, NXP, or similar). Hands-on experience with peripheral interfaces and protocols: SPI, I2C, UART, USB, BLE, CAN, or similar. Experience integrating sensors in firmware: IMUs, cameras, depth sensors, force sensors, or similar. A strong understanding of how firmware decisions affect data quality, especially for EMG/EEG sensing: ADC configuration, sample rate, jitter, filtering, and buffering. You know that a great model on a noisy signal still loses to a decent model on a clean one, and you write code accordingly. Comfortable debugging at the hardware boundary with a logic analyzer, oscilloscope, and debugger. Genuinely curious about ML: you read papers, you have trained at least one model end to end, and you understand that dataset quality beats model architecture choice. High agency: you don't wait to be told what to do. You are comfortable in 0-to-1 ambiguity, where the spec is "figure out what the spec should be". Discreet: you handle confidential hardware roadmaps and customer data with care. Fluent in English. German is a plus. Nice to Have A background in robotics, motion capture, or wearable devices. Experience with real-time or hard-deadline systems: audio, video sync, or robotic control loops. Experience with embedded Linux, time-sync protocols (PTP or similar), or low-power design. Familiarity with ML training pipelines. Even if you don't run them, you can read a training script. Open-source firmware contributions. Experience taking firmware from prototype to small-batch production: test fixtures, provisioning, and certification support. Who Will Thrive at MicroAGI Everyone we hire is assessed on the same four traits: Mission and vision: you care about what we are building and why it matters, and your past choices show it. Intensity: you work at a pace that matches the size of the opportunity, and you sustain it. Entrepreneurial: you start things nobody asked for, and you finish them. Raw IQ: you learn fast, reason from first principles, and get sharper when the problem changes. This is for you if: You would rather own a problem end to end than wait for a spec. You use AI every day, and you can tell a correct answer from a plausible one. You want to work in person, in the office, with people who are very good at what they do. This is not for you if: You are looking for a predictable 9-to-5. You would forward output you cannot explain. "That’s not my job" feels like a reasonable answer. How We Hire We read every application and reply within five working days. Talent Screen (30 min): a first conversation, both ways. Technical or Functional Interview (60 min): how you think when the problem changes. Your Work (60 min): bring something you are proud of and walk us through it. Leadership (30 min): a conversation with our CEO. Coworking Day (engineering and research roles): a day building with the team on a real problem. Then a decision, usually within a few days. Pay Transparency Compensation includes base salary and equity. The salary range for this role is shown on this posting. What We Offer Agency: real ownership from day one, and decisions that actually matter. Freedom: to choose how you solve the problem, without layers of approval. A seat on a rocketship: one of Europe’s fastest-growing deep-tech companies, at the earliest stage. Free food and drinks in the office. Equal Opportunity MicroAGI welcomes applications from everyone. We assess candidates on their work and potential, regardless of ethnic origin, gender, religion or belief, disability, age, or sexual identity. Find Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

Independent and solution-oriented mindset: Comfortable operating in fast-paced, international environments. How We Win Speed is the feature. Speed beats rocket science. title: Account Executive
description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Account Executive based in France. As an Account Executive, you will drive business growth across Europe by selling cutting-edge cloud infrastructure technology to enterprise customers, cloud providers, and fast-growing AI and developer platforms. You will own the entire sales cycle, from prospecting and discovery to technical evaluations, pilot programs, commercial negotiations, and closing deals. Working closely with the founding team and technical experts, you will help customers understand how next-generation microvirtualization can improve workload isolation, security, and infrastructure efficiency. You will build a qualified pipeline through strategic outbound campaigns, industry networking, and targeted account development. As an early sales hire, you will have a direct influence on the go-to-market strategy, sales processes, and future growth of the commercial organization. This fully remote opportunity combines entrepreneurial ownership, technical learning, and uncapped earning potential in a rapidly evolving AI and cloud infrastructure market. Accountabilities Build, manage, and grow a European sales pipeline targeting enterprise infrastructure teams, cloud and hosting providers, and high-growth AI and developer technology companies. Own the full sales cycle, from identifying and qualifying prospects to conducting discovery calls, coordinating technical evaluations, negotiating commercial terms, and securing signed contracts. Develop and execute targeted outbound strategies in collaboration with go-to-market engineers, identifying priority accounts, key decision-makers, and effective messaging to generate qualified opportunities. Lead customer conversations and engage economic buyers early, building relationships with CTOs, platform engineering leaders, security teams, procurement professionals, and other stakeholders involved in complex purchasing decisions. Coordinate product demonstrations, technical deep dives, and proof-of-concept or pilot programs alongside founders and field engineers to demonstrate product value and accelerate customer adoption. Translate technical capabilities into clear business outcomes, showing customers how lightweight microvirtual machines can improve workload isolation, infrastructure utilization, security, and deployment speed. Apply structured qualification methodologies, including MEDDPICC, to assess deal quality, understand decision-making processes, identify risks, and convert successful pilots into long-term production commitments. Develop commercial proposals tailored to customer requirements, including usage-based pricing, minimum commitments, dedicated deployments, and bring-your-own-cloud arrangements. Identify opportunities for account expansion by working closely with field engineers and existing customers to understand evolving infrastructure needs and increase adoption. Represent the business at industry conferences, cloud-native events, AI infrastructure gatherings, and regional meetups, building relationships and converting networking opportunities into qualified pipeline. Collaborate with go-to-market engineers to develop creative prospecting campaigns, improve sales automation, and refine outreach strategies based on market feedback and campaign performance. Contribute to the development and continuous improvement of the sales playbook, sharing insights on customer needs, competitive positioning, objections, and emerging market trends with the founding team and product organization. Maintain accurate records in HubSpot, manage pipeline reporting, and provide reliable forecasts to support business planning and sales execution. Support opportunities across the United States when needed, coordinating with the wider team and accommodating regular calls during European evening hours. Help shape the future sales organization by establishing repeatable processes, sharing best practices, and contributing to the onboarding and development of future sales hires. Requirements: At least 4 years of experience in quota-carrying sales or closing roles, selling technical products to engineering-oriented buyers. Proven experience selling technical solutions, ideally within cloud infrastructure, DevOps, developer tooling, virtualization, serverless computing, or related technology markets. Demonstrated ability to build a sales pipeline from scratch through outbound prospecting, account research, networking, and targeted engagement strategies. Strong understanding of effective outbound sales practices, with the ability to develop compelling messaging, prioritize accounts, and guide others in improving prospecting performance. Experience managing complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles involving technical evaluations, proof-of-concept programs, and extended decision-making processes. Ability to engage confidently with technical and economic buyers, including CTOs, platform engineering leaders, security stakeholders, procurement teams, and legal departments. Sufficient technical knowledge to discuss virtualization, containers, Kubernetes, cloud infrastructure, and related technologies credibly with engineering teams, combined with the curiosity and motivation to deepen your expertise. Experience converting pilots, proofs of concept, or technical evaluations into signed commercial agreements. Familiarity with usage-based pricing, consumption-based business models, minimum commitments, or other flexible commercial structures. Strong prospecting, negotiation, presentation, and relationship-building skills, with the ability to make customers feel comfortable while maintaining a rigorous, analytical approach to sales. Excellent spoken and written English, with additional languages considered an advantage. A high degree of ownership, initiative, adaptability, and learning agility, with the ability to identify problems, take action independently, and continuously improve how work gets done. Strong analytical skills and a data-driven approach to pipeline management, deal qualification, forecasting, and sales performance. Willingness to attend industry events, travel regularly to customers across Europe, and occasionally travel to the United States. Availability to work remotely from a European location within approximately two hours of Central European Time (CET), with flexibility to accommodate regular calls during US business hours. Nice to have: Experience using AI tools to research accounts, personalize outreach, generate pipeline, automate sales workflows, and improve deal execution. Familiarity with HubSpot or comparable CRM and sales pipeline management platforms. A degree in computer science, engineering, or another technical discipline. Previous experience selling compute infrastructure, serverless platforms, sandboxing technologies, databases, Kubernetes tooling, or related developer infrastructure products. Knowledge of the competitive landscape across cloud infrastructure and developer platforms, including solutions such as Modal, E2B, Daytona, Fly.io, Northflank, Vercel, and Firecracker-based platforms. An established network among European platform engineering teams, cloud providers, systems integrators, or infrastructure decision-makers. Experience working with channel partners, resellers, cloud providers, or systems integrators to develop and close opportunities. Previous experience as an early sales hire at a startup, with an appreciation for the ownership, pace, and adaptability required to build a sales function from an early stage. Benefits: Competitive base salary with uncapped commission, providing significant earning potential tied to sales performance. Meaningful equity participation, allowing you to share in the long-term growth of the business. Fully remote working environment within Europe, with a preferred time zone of CET ±2 hours. Direct access to the founding team, including hands-on coaching, technical support during sales conversations, and guidance on complex deals. Opportunity to join an early-stage sales team and help shape the commercial strategy, sales playbook, and future structure of the organization. The chance to sell an established technology already used in production by enterprise customers, with additional opportunities progressing through the pipeline. Exposure to fast-growing markets spanning AI infrastructure, cloud computing, serverless workloads, secure sandboxing, and developer platforms. Close collaboration with technical experts and go-to-market engineers, providing opportunities to deepen your technical knowledge and improve sales effectiveness. Regular opportunities to attend leading industry conferences, cloud-native events, AI infrastructure gatherings, and customer meetings across Europe, with occasional travel to the United States. A fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment that rewards initiative, experimentation, continuous learning, and measurable impact. The opportunity to make a meaningful contribution to the company's growth during a pivotal stage of its development. title: Waiter - Cecconi's Amsterdam
description: <h3><strong>About us ... </strong></h3> <p>Cecconi’s Amsterdam, part of the global Soho House brand, brings classic Italian dining to life in a vibrant, elegant setting. Known for its timeless dishes, buzzing atmosphere, and exceptional service, Cecconi’s offers an inspiring environment for hospitality professionals passionate about great food and genuine guest experiences. Cecconi’s serves hand-made pasta, seafood and dishes from Italy using the finest ingredients. In addition to the original restaurant in Mayfair, London, Cecconi’s has locations in Miami, West Hollywood, Istanbul and Berlin.</p> <div> <p><strong>The Role</strong></p> <p>Our aim is to hire skilled and passionate <strong>Waiters</strong> to join the team at <strong>Cecconi's Amsterdam</strong>.</p> <p>We're looking for people who take genuine pride in their craft. At Cecconi's, great hospitality goes beyond taking orders and serving food. It's about anticipating guest needs, building meaningful connections and delivering experiences that keep guests coming back.</p> <p>You'll work alongside passionate hospitality professionals who hold themselves to high standards and are committed to excellence. As a Waiter, you'll manage your own section, build relationships with guests and play a key role in delivering the warm, attentive service Cecconi's is known for.</p> <p><strong>What You'll Do</strong></p> <ul> <li>Deliver warm, personable and professional service throughout the guest journey</li> <li>Confidently guide guests through our food and beverage menus</li> <li>Manage a busy section while maintaining exceptional attention to detail</li> <li>Build genuine relationships with members, regular guests and visitors</li> <li>Work collaboratively with kitchen, bar and floor teams to deliver a seamless experience</li> <li>Consistently uphold Cecconi's and Soho House service standards</li> <li>Support private events and other operational areas when require</li> </ul> <p><strong>What We're Looking For</strong></p> <ul> <li>Previous experience as a Waiter or in a guest-facing hospitality role</li> <li>Experience working within a busy, fast-paced service environment</li> <li>Naturally warm, engaging and guest-focused</li> <li>Strong communication skills and a collaborative mindset</li> <li>Ability to remain calm and organised during high-volume service periods</li> <li>Passion for food, beverage and hospitality</li> <li>Flexible availability, including evenings, weekends and public holidays</li> <li>Fluent English required; additional languages are a plus</li> </ul> <p>This role is ideal for hospitality professionals who love the energy of a full restaurant, take pride in managing a bustling section and enjoy building relationships with guests who return time and time again. At Cecconi's, you'll be part of a thriving service environment where outstanding hospitality is appreciated and recognised.</p> <p>If you're passionate about hospitality, thrive in a fast-paced environment and want to work alongside some of the industry's most talented professionals, we'd love to hear from you.</p> </div> <p><strong>Benefits </strong></p> <p>Cecconi's offers competitive compensation packages that feature global benefits and perks. description: Rügamer & Steiner ist eine E-Commerce-Agentur aus Düsseldorf. Wir betreuen über 150 Onlineshops und generieren für unsere Kunden jährlich über 200 Mio. € Umsatz. Jetzt bauen wir unser eigenes Marketing auf. Du übernimmst diesen Bereich: mehr Neukunden, mehr und bessere Bewerber, eine Marke, die man kennt. Deine Aufgaben Du baust unser Marketing auf und setzt Maßnahmen um, die neue Kunden bringen. Du entwickelst das Personal Branding der Gründer, zunächst auf LinkedIn. Du planst die Inhalte, schreibst die Posts und produzierst sie gemeinsam mit den Gründern. Du baust die nächsten Kanäle mit auf: eigener Newsletter, YouTube, Podcast. Du produzierst Content für Instagram und für unsere Ads, für Kunden und für Bewerber. Konzept, Text, Video und Schnitt liegen in deiner Hand. Du steuerst deine Projekte eigenständig von der Idee bis zur Veröffentlichung und nimmst den Gründern so viel Arbeit wie möglich ab. Dein Profil Du schreibst sehr gut: Hooks, Posts, Skripte, Ad-Texte, Newsletter. Du verstehst, wie eine B2B-Zielgruppe denkt und was Geschäftsführer von Onlineshops lesen und anklicken. Du hast ein ästhetisches Gespür für Video und Bild und weißt, was auf LinkedIn, Instagram und YouTube funktioniert. title: Traineeship Aftersales Servicecontracten
description: Sta jij aan het begin van je carrière en wil je ontdekken hoe techniek, klantbelang en commercie samenkomen binnen een professionele automotiveorganisatie? Dan is dit traineeship echt iets voor jou! Bij BAS Truck Center , officieel dealer van Volvo en Renault Trucks, leer je hoe we klanten zekerheid bieden over onderhoud, reparaties en voertuigbeschikbaarheid. Je start met het ondersteunen van de contractadministratie en groeit door naar een zelfstandige rol waarin je contracten analyseert, calculaties opstelt en collega’s adviseert. Onderweg leer je onze organisatie, vestigingen en de wereld van trucks en aftersales goed kennen. Je werkt binnen Business Support , dat onze servicevestigingen in Veghel, Nijmegen, Veldhoven en Tilburg ondersteunt op het gebied van techniek, processen, training, automatisering, servicecontracten, onderdelenbeheer, leveranciersbeheer en inkoop. Jouw carrièrepad Je groeit door van ondersteuner naar zelfstandig Servicecontract Coördinator van de gehele contractportefeuille. Fase 1: De basis leren Je leert onze organisatie, systemen, contractvormen en werkwijzen kennen. Je verzamelt, controleert en verwerkt contractgegevens en ondersteunt bij standaardcalculaties, offertes en wijzigingen. Fase 2: Zelfstandig coördineren Je beheert een deel van de contractportefeuille, bewaakt looptijden, kilometrages en onderhoudsafspraken en signaleert afwijkingen in gebruik, voertuiggegevens en planning. Ook ondersteun je accountmanagers en servicevestigingen bij contractvragen. Fase 3: Analyseren en adviseren Je analyseert onderhoudshistorie en contractprestaties, denkt mee over passende contractconstructies en adviseert over herrekeningen, verlengingen en aanpassingen, met oog voor de commerciële en financiële gevolgen. Wat ga je leren? Gegevens voor servicecontracten verzamelen, controleren en verwerken; Standaardcalculaties en offertes opstellen; Contractlooptijden, kilometrages en onderhoudsafspraken bewaken; Afwijkingen in contractgebruik en voertuiggegevens signaleren; Accountmanagers en servicevestigingen ondersteunen bij contractvragen; Onderhoudshistorie en contractprestaties analyseren; Voorstellen doen voor herrekeningen, verlengingen en contractaanpassingen; Contractgegevens vertalen naar een onderbouwd advies, met oog voor de commerciële en financiële gevolgen. Waarom dit traineeship interessant is Een servicecontract bepaalt wanneer een truck onderhoud krijgt, welke kosten gedekt zijn en hoe betrouwbaar de klant de weg op kan. Jij leert wat er achter die cijfers zit. Zo bouw je kennis op van klanten, voertuigen, onderhoud, calculaties en commercie, en leg je een stevige basis voor een carrière in aftersales of Business Support. Wij bieden jou Salaris ruim boven CAO, afhankelijk van jouw ervaring; Uitstekende secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden, zoals pensioen en opleidingsmogelijkheden; Een centrale, veelzijdige rol binnen de aftersalesorganisatie waarin je direct bijdraagt aan klanttevredenheid; De ruimte om ownership te pakken en jouw ideeën om te zetten in concrete resultaten; Persoonlijke en professionele ontwikkeling via onder andere onze BAS Academy; Een informele en ondernemende werksfeer waarin snel geschakeld wordt; Een borrel om de week af te sluiten en het jaarlijkse BAS feest, wij zijn namelijk niet vies van een feestje. Een recent afgeronde mbo-4- of hbo-opleiding, bijvoorbeeld (Technische) Bedrijfskunde of MKB; Plezier in werken met cijfers, gegevens en systemen; Nieuwsgierigheid naar techniek, automotive of bedrijfsprocessen; Een nauwkeurige werkhouding, en je wilt begrijpen waarom iets op een bepaalde manier gebeurt; Je durft vragen te stellen en staat open voor feedback; Je legt makkelijk contact met verschillende collega’s; De ambitie om verantwoordelijkheid op te bouwen en door te groeien naar een zelfstandige, analytische en adviserende rol. Wij zijn BAS! BAS Group is een wereldwijd opererend familiebedrijf waarin verschillende gespecialiseerde BAS-bedrijven samenkomen. Met expertise in inkoop, verkoop, onderhoud, verhuur en wagenparkbeheer bieden wij complete oplossingen voor transport en logistiek. Of het nu gaat om trucks, trailers, bedrijfswagens of bouw- en landbouwmachines, onze bedrijven versterken elkaar en helpen klanten vooruit met efficiënte en innovatieve dienstverlening. Binnen BAS Group ga jij aan de slag bij BAS Truck Center. Als officieel Volvo en Renault Truck dealer staan we dagelijks klaar om transportondernemers te ondersteunen met onderhoud, reparaties en service voor alle merken trucks, trailers en lichte bedrijfswagens. In onze moderne, volledig papierloze werkplaatsen werken we met de nieuwste technieken en zetten we ons in voor kwaliteit en klanttevredenheid. Samengevat: bij BAS gaan we altijd vol gas en is geen dag hetzelfde. Met meer dan 1.000 collega's proberen wij onszelf iedere dag een stukje beter te maken voor onze klanten. Daarbij staan Brabantse nuchterheid, passie, teamwork en ondernemerschap voorop. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Afstudeerstage IT
description: Bij BAS, Europa’s grootste dealer in commerciële voertuigen én officieel Volvo en Renault Trucks dealer, krijg jij de kans om je te ontwikkelen binnen IT in de automotive branche. Ben jij op zoek naar een afstudeerstage vanaf januari/ februari 2027? Dan is dit iets voor jou! BAS World groeit hard, en IT speelt daarin een sleutelrol. Binnen ons IT-team liggen verschillende afstudeeropdrachten klaar die elk een echt vraagstuk uit ons IT-landschap aanpakken. Elke opdracht heeft een eigen team dat je dagelijks begeleidt. Zo breng je je kennis in de praktijk en kickstart je samen met ons jouw carrière. Mogelijke afstudeeropdrachten 1. Continuous performance & load testing (Engineering) BAS World wil het aantal voertuigadvertenties online ongeveer 20 keer zo groot maken. In deze opdracht zorg je dat onze websites en systemen die groei aankunnen. Je onderzoekt welke (AI-gedreven) testtools passen bij onze stack. Daarna bouw je samen met het IDP-team een testsuite die dagelijks automatisch draait in de pipeline. Het resultaat is een productieklare testopzet en een advies over knelpunten en capaciteit. Past bij: Software Engineering, DevOps, Infrastructure. 2. Kleine AI-agents voor de business (Data / AI engineering) In deze opdracht werk je als interne consultant binnen één afdeling, bijvoorbeeld Logistiek. Je spreekt gebruikers, brengt hun processen en knelpunten in kaart en bepaalt waar AI het meeste oplevert. Daarna bouw je één of meer kleine AI-agents op basis van de services en data die we al hebben. Je test ze en verbetert ze tot ze echt gebruikt worden in het dagelijkse werk. Past bij: AI, Data Science, Business IT, Software Engineering, als je graag dicht op eindgebruikers werkt. 3. Realtime monitoring & bottleneck-analyse voor Thinkwise-applicaties (Engineering) Verschillende kernapplicaties draaien op het low-code platform Thinkwise. Als gebruikers traagheid melden, kost het nu weken om de oorzaak te vinden. In deze opdracht bouw je monitoring die de performance over de hele stack realtime inzichtelijk maakt: van UI en applicatielaag tot database en netwerk. Die performance komt live op een scherm op de werkvloer van onze developers. Daarnaast ontwikkel je rapportage- en analysetooling waarmee developers bottlenecks precies kunnen aanwijzen en oplossen waar ze ontstaan. Zo vinden we problemen in uren in plaats van weken. Past bij: Software Engineering, Infrastructure, DevOps, met interesse in performance en observability. 4. Problem management & ITSM-procesoptimalisatie (System & Application Management) Onze Servicedesk en het S&AM-team krijgen veel meldingen binnen in Jira. Terugkerende problemen worden nog te weinig bij de bron opgelost. In deze opdracht breng je de ITSM-processen in kaart en leg je ze vast: processtromen, werkinstructies en rollen. Je toetst ze aan good practices zoals ITIL. Daarna ontwerp en implementeer je problem management als een vast proces, zodat terugkerende issues structureel verdwijnen. Past bij: Business IT & Management, IT Service Management of verwant. 5. Datagedreven leadgeneratie met FleetCareXL & BAS World (Product) Via FleetCareXL weten we precies hoe voertuigen onderhouden worden en wat dat kost. De verkoophistorie van BAS World vertelt ons veel over restwaardes. In deze opdracht combineer je deze twee databronnen in een proof of concept. Die berekent het ideale vervangmoment: wanneer onderhoudskosten gaan stijgen terwijl de restwaarde nog hoog is. Dat levert kostenbesparing op voor klanten en leads voor in- en verkoop. De opdracht kan ook andersom worden ingevuld. Dan onderzoek je hoe we FleetGuide selfservice of fullservice actief kunnen aanbieden aan klanten van BAS World. Past bij: Data Science, Business Analytics, Software Engineering, met commerciële interesse. Kortom: veel verantwoordelijkheid, veel samenwerking en een opdracht met echte impact. Wij bieden jou Een stagevergoeding van €500,- bruto per maand voor een fulltime stage én reiskostenvergoeding ; Een inhoudelijke en uitdagende afstudeeropdracht met zichtbare impact; Dagelijkse begeleiding vanuit het team dat jouw opdracht host; De mogelijkheid om onderdeel uit te maken van ons gedreven en enthousiaste IT-team; Bij goede prestaties uitzicht op een vaste functie binnen BAS . Bij BAS zeggen we namelijk niet voor niets: “Bij BAS heb je geen baan maar een carrière!”; Een vaste kruk bij de VrijMiBo en jouw naam op de gastenlijst voor onze bedrijfsuitjes en feestjes. Je volgt een HBO-opleiding richting Software Engineering, DevOps, Data Science, AI, Business IT & Management, IT Service Management of een gerelateerde opleiding; Je vindt het leuk om systemen en processen te verbeteren en oplossingen te bouwen die echt gebruikt worden; Je bent nieuwsgierig en hebt de drive om te leren en jezelf te ontwikkelen. Wij zijn BAS! We zijn actief sinds 1962. Sindsdien vestigden wij onze naam als een betrouwbare kracht in de Automotive. Als familiebedrijf zijn wij wereldwijd actief in kopen, onderhouden en verkopen van vrachtwagens, trekkers, trailers, bouwmachines, bedrijfswagens en landbouwmachines. Al onze kennis en ervaring verwerkten we daarnaast in de ontwikkeling van basworld.com. Hier verbinden we kopers en verkopers met elkaar en helpen we hen om snel, gemakkelijk en veilig te handelen. Onze ambitie voor BAS kent geen grenzen. Rijd jij voorop om BAS naar het volgende niveau te brengen? Samengevat: bij BAS gaan we altijd vol gas en is geen dag hetzelfde. Met meer dan 1.000 collega’s proberen wij onszelf iedere dag een stukje beter te maken voor onze klanten. Daarbij staan Brabantse nuchterheid, passie, teamwork en ondernemerschap voorop. title: Senior Service Designer, Food Systems & Fulfillment (f/m/x)
description: <h2><strong>The role</strong></h2> <p>The Enterprise UX practice at HelloFresh is a cross-functional team that brings physical and digital product and service experiences to life through strategic research, service design, prototyping, and storytelling. We are dedicated to transforming enterprise ways of working by applying structured methods like Definition Sprints, Service Blueprinting, and AS-IS and TO-BE mapping, creating meaningful & effective enterprise experiences to shape the future of HelloFresh’s Supply Chain.<br>As a Senior Service Designer, you will leverage your research and service design expertise to shape compelling visions for both product and process improvements. You will deeply investigate current ways of working—identifying key data archetypes, mapping AS-IS states, and collaboratively defining desired TO-BE workflows. Your insights will identify the most impactful opportunities for investment. You will closely collaborate with product, engineering, users and operational stakeholders to design, prototype, and validate scalable solutions aligned with our Enterprise Design System.</p> <h3>About the Domain</h3> <p>The wider Food Systems Alliance owns technology that enables a lean and sustainable procurement process from Suppliers to HelloFresh facilities and improves customer experience with accurate ingredient data flow and optimal ingredient quality. Optimising cost of ingredients, providing customers with the freshest and best ingredients, and enabling buying decisions that reduce excess stock and other forms of inventory waste are just some of the focus areas for this alliance.</p> <h2><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Conduct and lead</strong> strategic Definition Sprints to uncover user needs, validate hypotheses, and collaboratively define clear next steps for design and development.</li> <li><strong>Map</strong> current (AS-IS) enterprise processes and systems, identifying pain points and opportunities, then collaboratively design optimized (TO-BE) processes, particularly within the Food Systems alliance  - the cluster that takes care of supply chain management topics within Hello Fresh..</li> <li><strong>Partner and inspire</strong> other enterprise designers to excel in service design and prototyping, nurturing growth within the team.</li> <li><strong>Deeply understand</strong> the user journeys and workflows of Recipe Developers, Menu Planners, and Buyers, building strong stakeholder relationships to advocate effectively for these users.</li> <li><strong>Develop and align</strong> design concepts and prototypes with the Enterprise Design System to ensure scalability and consistency across enterprise tooling.</li> <li><strong>Form collaborative partnerships</strong> with POs, engineers, and researchers, using influence to elevate UX solutions and challenge broader assumptions within internal product teams.</li> <li><strong>Mentor and coach</strong> designers in creating user experiences demonstrating pride in craft, clarity, and effectiveness.</li> <li><strong>Create</strong> UX/UI flows and experiences that elegantly address complex enterprise problems with delightful, user-centric solutions.</li> <li><strong>Facilitate</strong> clear communication across teams, leveraging structured storytelling methods to amplify your impact.</li> </ul> <p>Above all, we are looking for people who will <strong>make HelloFresh</strong> <strong>better.</strong> We believe there are many different ways of developing skills and we love diverse experiences! So even if you don’t “tick all the boxes” but think you’d thrive in this role, we would really like to learn more about you.</p> <h2><strong>What you’ll bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li>4+ years of product design experience, particularly within enterprise or B2B contexts.</li> <li>Proven track record in applying structured service design methodologies such as Definition Sprints, AS-IS/TO-BE mapping, and Service Blueprinting.</li> <li>Additional experience leading projects, mentoring, or directly managing design team members.</li> <li>A portfolio demonstrating impactful, user-centered enterprise experiences and a high level of craft.</li> <li>Expertise in visual design, interaction design, UX writing, and UI design.</li> <li>Mastery of Figma and familiarity with relevant prototyping and service design tools.</li> <li>Excellent communication skills in English, capable of articulating complex concepts clearly to diverse stakeholders.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <h2><strong>What we offer</strong></h2> <p>Elevate your lifestyle! Join one of Europe's fastest-growing tech powerhouses in a dynamic phase of expansion.</p> <ul> <li>Immerse yourself in a diverse global community of 90+ nationalities.</li> <li>Enjoy a competitive compensation package that goes beyond the norm, with perks like a HelloFresh- subsidized Pension Scheme, Berlin relocation support, and a Hybrid working model.</li> <li>Elevate your lifestyle with exclusive discounts on your weekly HelloFresh box and office meals.</li> <li>Invest in your growth with a German language learning budget, and access to the HelloFresh Academy.</li> <li>Plus, we've got your well-being covered with mental health support, transportation perks, and working-parent-friendly benefits. From our 24/7 gym access,wellbeing platforms like Headspace and Spill, to sabbatical leave options, HelloFresh is not just a workplace; it's a lifestyle of perks and possibilities!</li> </ul> <p>#DESIGN</p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: SAP S/4Hana Key User / Fachbereichskoordinator
description: SAP S/4HANA Fachbereichskoordinator (m/w/d) Über uns Wir sehen die Halbleiterindustrie als Raum voller Möglichkeiten. Wir sehen Chancen. Und wir sehen das enorme Potenzial unserer Graphenlösungen, die Branche grundlegend zu verändern. Wir laden dich ein, diesen Wandel mitzugestalten und mit unserem konsequent menschenorientierten Ansatz kluge Köpfe für eine gemeinsame Vision zu vereinen. Unsere Vision: Zeige allen, dass du grundlegende Veränderungen bewirken kannst. Beweise mit deinem Wissen und deinen Fähigkeiten, dass Dinge auch anders gemacht werden können. Gemeinsam verändern wir die Art und Weise, wie die Welt miteinander verbunden ist. Über unsere Technologie Die Halbleiterindustrie benötigt zunehmend leistungsfähigere Chips mit höherer Bandbreite und geringerem Energieverbrauch. Unsere Technologie bietet dafür eine Lösung: Wir verbinden Chips zu leistungsstarken Computernetzwerken mit hohem Datendurchsatz und geringer Latenz. Der Schlüssel liegt in den besonderen physikalischen Eigenschaften von Graphen. Sie ermöglichen es uns, elektronische Datenverarbeitung mit photonischer Kommunikation zu verbinden, sodass unzählige Chips nahezu so miteinander interagieren können, als wären sie ein einziger. Unsere Innovation im Bereich der Graphenphotonik hebt Rechenleistung und Energieeffizienz auf ein völlig neues Niveau. Kurz gesagt: Wir verbinden Chips zu leistungsstarken und energieeffizienten Netzwerken und überwinden damit bestehende Grenzen der Konnektivität in der Halbleiterindustrie. Wir liefern die Graphenlösung. Deine Rolle Die Black Semiconductor GmbH sucht einen SAP S/4HANA Fachbereichskoordinator (m/w/d) , der als zentrale Schnittstelle zwischen den Fachbereichen und externen SAP-Beratern agiert und sicherstellt, dass geschäftliche Anforderungen effektiv in geeignete Systemlösungen übersetzt werden. Du betreust und pflegst unsere SAP S/4HANA Systemlandschaft über die Bereiche Finance, Logistik, Einkauf und Supply Chain hinweg. Dabei treibst du die kontinuierliche Verbesserung von Geschäftsprozessen, die Optimierung des Systems und die erfolgreiche Umsetzung von Änderungen voran. Deine Verantwortlichkeiten Zentrale Ansprechperson für die Fachbereiche Finance, Logistik, Einkauf und Supply Chain sowie für externe SAP-Beratungspartner Aufnahme, Analyse und Übersetzung fachlicher Anforderungen in klare funktionale Spezifikationen und Systemverbesserungen Betreuung und Pflege der SAP S/4HANA Umgebung zur Sicherstellung eines stabilen und effizienten Systembetriebs Koordination und Steuerung von Änderungsanforderungen, Systemoptimierungen und kleineren Konfigurationsanpassungen in Zusammenarbeit mit internen und externen Ansprechpartnern Erstellung und Pflege der Dokumentation zu Systemkonfigurationen, Geschäftsprozessen, Testergebnissen und individuellen Anpassungen Das bringst du mit Abgeschlossenes Studium der Wirtschaftsinformatik, Informationssysteme, Betriebswirtschaftslehre oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation 3–4 Jahre praktische SAP Erfahrung in einem Deep-Tech- oder vergleichbar komplexen betrieblichen Umfeld Sicherer Umgang mit neu aufgebauten oder sich weiterentwickelnden SAP S/4HANA Systemlandschaften sowie fundiertes Verständnis der Geschäftsprozesse in den Modulen FI/CO, MM und SD Fundierte Kenntnisse in SAP S/4HANA und dessen Anwendung entlang durchgängiger Geschäftsprozesse Erfahrung in der Zusammenarbeit mit externen SAP Beratungspartnern und funktionsübergreifenden Business Operations Teams, einschließlich Anforderungsaufnahme, Tests und Change Management, idealerweise unterstützt durch Tools wie SAP Cloud ALM Ausgeprägte Kommunikationsfähigkeiten in Deutsch und Englisch sowie eine strukturierte, lösungsorientierte und eigenständige Arbeitsweise im Umgang mit Fachbereichen, IT-Teams und externen Dienstleistern Unsere Unternehmenskultur Menschen vor Prozessen Bei Black Semiconductor steht der Mensch im Mittelpunkt. Flexibilität ist für uns entscheidend - wir gestalten die Arbeit so, dass sie sich deinem Leben anpasst und nicht umgekehrt. Wir setzen auf eine gesunde Balance zwischen Beruf und Privatleben und schaffen ein Umfeld, in dem deine Arbeit sinnvoll und bereichernd ist. Unsere Prozesse sind auf Menschen ausgerichtet, damit du dich auf das Wesentliche konzentrieren kannst. Lass uns gemeinsam wachsen Dein Potenzial hat für uns höchste Priorität. Wir geben dir den Freiraum, nachhaltige Veränderungen zu bewirken, und fördern deine Entwicklung durch eine Kultur des kontinuierlichen Lernens. Wir investieren in deine fachliche und persönliche Weiterentwicklung. Deine Gesundheit und Zukunft zählen Dein Wohlbefinden steht für uns an erster Stelle. Wir bieten dir ein umfassendes Leistungspaket mit attraktiven Versicherungsleistungen, betrieblicher Altersvorsorge und virtuellen Aktienoptionen, um deine mentale, körperliche und finanzielle Gesundheit zu unterstützen. Deine Sicherheit und dein Wohlbefinden sind uns wichtig – heute und in Zukunft. Wir leben Offenheit Zusammenarbeit und Vielfalt bilden die Grundpfeiler unserer Unternehmenskultur. Wir setzen auf Offenheit und fördern Vertrauen und gegenseitigen Respekt. Individualität ist unsere gemeinsame Stärke – sie treibt Innovationen voran und bringt uns als Unternehmen weiter. Wir verbinden Chips – und Menschen Wir freuen uns über Bewerbungen qualifizierter Menschen mit unterschiedlichsten Hintergründen. Wir fördern ein inklusives und unterstützendes Arbeitsumfeld, in dem Zusammenarbeit, Innovation und persönliches Wachstum zählen. Werde Teil unseres Teams und gestalte mit uns den Wandel in der Halbleiterindustrie. Kannst du dir vorstellen, diese Rolle bei Black Semiconductor zu übernehmen? Dann lass uns ins Gespräch kommen! title: Account Executive 🇫🇷 (Small Businesses)
location: Paris, France; Bordeaux, France; Lyon, France; Marseille, France; Biarritz, France; Nantes, France; Annecy, France
description: Health can’t wait . Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t. Alan exists to end the wait. Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way. So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience. We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture . We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR. Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond. Are highly organized with exceptional follow-up skills ; Have empathy and are passionate about understanding and solving prospects' problems; Can influence through persuasion, negotiation, and consensus-building; Have a deep understanding of value drivers in recurring revenue business models; Have a great attitude and ability to collaborate in a small team; Are eager to learn fast and make an impact from day 1; Are based in (or willing to relocate to) Paris, Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes or Biarritz. For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the B1-C0 level range . If you're still wondering whether this could be the best move for you, take a look at this article from Lucie Leflour, our Sales Lead in France. Everything else is a plus. We care about having a diversity of experiences, profiles and backgrounds in our team. 🙌 Perks & Benefits At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need , and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers. Therefore, we offer: Fair rewards . Generous equity packages complement your base salary, for permanent contracts only. Flexible office with hybrid setup . Amazing office space at our Paris HQ or sponsored co-working hubs in Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes or Biarritz. All the tools you need . Top of the range equipment: Macbook Air, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and Bose noise-canceling headphones. Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours . Organize your time as you wish. Delightful healthcare insurance: Extremely comprehensive health insurance - 100% for you and your children, 90-100% for partners depending on your country (permanent contracts only). Transport . Generous transit benefit Learning & Training opportunities . A highly flexible training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises. Personal growth through coaching : At Alan, coaching isn't just a perk - it's core to who we are. Every Alaner is paired with a dedicated coach from day one, who helps maximize their impact, nurture engagement, and navigate Alan's values to develop their full potential. Learn more about our coaching culture . Parental leave . Extended parental leave for all new parents, for permanent contracts only. Important note: we hire people, not roles. If you're excited about this opportunity but don't check every box, we'd love to hear from you. Everyone, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply as it can only bring learnings or success. If you identify yourself as a woman : Did you know that research shows women often apply only when meeting 100% of requirements? Remember, this is just a guide, not a checklist. description: About the role Gauss Fusion is aiming to build the first commercial scale fusion power plant based on the stellarator concept and is seeking an experienced mechanical engineer to lead on development of the robotic maintenance approach. The fusion environment within the reactor is very aggressive, and in-vessel components such as the breeder blanket and divertor will need to be replaced on a regular basis as the materials become damaged by the radiation. Due to the environment inside the device, and in order to maintain a high overall availability, the maintenance must be done robotically using automated systems to extract and replace the components and bring the removed ones to a hot cell for separation, waste treatment, and recycling. Gauss Fusion is looking for an innovative mechanical design engineer with experience in robotics to lead the work defining and developing the maintenance approach for the Gauss stellarator power plant and its key stellarator systems. While the magnetic configuration will be designed to maximise access to the reactor, the complex geometry poses a challenge to fixations and kinematics, and inventive approaches to the problem are required. Main responsibilities Manage the Gauss Fusion maintenance approach to meet the requirements of a commercial scale fusion power plant design: Develop workable approaches to achieving high power plant availability, taking account of engineering and physics requirements across the reactor. Integrate these remote maintenance requirements into plant layout specifications. Define approaches to minimising hot cell inventory through efficient handling of removed components. Lead development of the breeder blanket and divertor segmentation and fixations resulting from these approaches. Lead development of remote maintenance testing and demonstration systems for the reactor. Qualification and educational requirements Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering or related field, master’s or Ph.D. preferred. Technical experience: Minimum of 6 years of experience in mechanical engineering, preferably in large-scale engineering projects. Experience in designing complex mechanical systems, preferably in the energy or nuclear industry. Familiarity with CAD software and engineering analysis tools. Experience with digital mock-up will be an asset Familiarity with maintenance, inspection and intervention systems Familiarity with system engineering processes, requirements management and verification activities. Strong understanding of mechanical design principles and engineering mechanics. Proficiency in structural analysis, finite element analysis (FEA), and kinematic analysis. Ability to manage multidisciplinary teams and coordinate with other engineering disciplines. Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

description: Introduction The selected person will join the Technopolis Group Data Science Unit (DSU), whose members work across different country offices. Our growing team brings together diverse academic backgrounds and a shared passion for developing data science applications to improve policymaking. The DSU contributes to policy consulting projects and conducts R&D to develop and test new applications, sometimes in collaboration with internal and external partners. Its work includes record linkage, classification, natural language processing, web scraping, generative AI and dynamic visualisations. As an intern, you will work alongside experienced data scientists and policy consultants, applying and developing your technical skills to address real-world policy questions. About this job The role of the intern in data science for public policy will be to support the data science components of policy evaluations , sectoral studies and strategic consultancy projects. Our clients include French regional councils, the French Development Agency (AFD), ADEME, the European Commission and multilateral development banks. You will be part of the DSU and collaborate with colleagues across policy areas, including science, technology and innovation, economic development, the green transition, international cooperation and health. You may also contribute to internal R&D and business development activities, particularly the preparation of data science approaches for project proposals. No previous professional experience is required. Relevant coursework, academic research and personal coding projects will be considered. We are looking to recruit a full-time intern for at least 6 months starting in Automn 2026 . Internship should be sponsored by the intern’s university (stage conventionné). Your profile We are looking for a curious and motivated individual who enjoys working with data and wants to understand how data science can inform public policy. Suitable candidates should have: Master’s-level studies in data science, computer science, statistics, economics, engineering or another relevant discipline with a strong quantitative component, and be eligible for a university-sponsored internship. Practical programming skills in Python, demonstrated through coursework, research or personal projects, and the ability to write and understand their own analytical code. Good foundations in statistics and quantitative analysis, together with an interest in economics and public policy and in interpreting analytical results in their policy context. Basic familiarity with machine learning or natural language processing, and an interest in using generative AI and large language models programmatically through APIs for data processing, text analysis and knowledge extraction. A careful and structured approach to working with data, including attention to data quality, validation, documentation and reproducibility. An interest in public policy and in using data science to support evidence-based policymaking , particularly in areas such as science, technology and innovation, economic development, the green transition or health policy. Fluency in French and English, good communication skills and an ability to work collaboratively in an international and multicultural environment. A third language would be an asset. Your responsibilities Working under the guidance of experienced colleagues, you will: Support the design and implementation of data science analyses to answer policy questions, writing code in Python. Collect, clean, link and validate data from multiple sources, including open datasets, databases and web-based sources. Help develop and test analytical workflows, potentially involving machine learning, NLP and LLM APIs for classification, text analysis and knowledge extraction. Contribute to indicators, scoreboards and visualisations, including dashboards where relevant, to make findings accessible to different audiences. Interpret and communicate results, helping prepare reports, methodological documentation and presentations for clients. Contribute to the DSU’s R&D and proposal preparation, for example by exploring new datasets, testing methods or developing small prototypes. Our offer We offer a paid internship in Paris, with hands-on experience at the intersection of data science and public policy. You will work with an international, multidisciplinary team, receive guidance from experienced colleagues and contribute to both client projects and the development of new analytical applications. Many of our interns become full-time staff at Technopolis or go on to pursue opportunities in the public and private sectors. Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Product Analytics Chapter Lead
description: About Finom Finom is a European tech startup headquartered in Amsterdam, and we’re on a journey towards revolutionizing the financial landscape for entrepreneurs worldwide. Our mission is to develop an all-in-one financial B2B solution that integrates banking functions, accounting, financial management, and invoicing into a seamless, mobile-first platform. We recently closed a €115 million Series C equity round (around $133 million), bringing our total funding to approximately $346 million. This significant investment follows a $105 million growth funding round from General Catalyst, a long-term backer since 2021 known for supporting companies like Airbnb, HubSpot, KAYAK, and Stripe. Finom's platform goes beyond traditional banking, offering invoicing and a growing suite of features, including AI-enabled accounting, aiming to simplify financial management for entrepreneurs. We're actively expanding our reach across key EU markets like Germany, France, the Netherlands, Italy, and Spain. At Finom, we’re not just redefining the entrepreneurial experience — we’re empowering our employees to make a real difference. Your work matters, and your impact extends far beyond product metrics. We nurture innovation and an inspiring work environment where bold ideas thrive, prioritizing thorough research, swift implementation of solutions, and ensuring that every effort we make benefits our users, employees, partners, and our business as a whole. Maintaining our start-up spirit, we prioritize thorough research, swift implementation of solutions, and ensuring that every effort we make benefits our users, employees, partners, and, of course, our business. About the Role Product decisions at Finom are made fast, and we want them made on evidence. You join the Growth & Activation product stream as its analyst, working with PMs and engineers on how new customers discover the product, start using it, and grow with it. There is no established way of doing product analytics here yet, so you define it: how experiments are designed, how metrics are named and counted, what a readout looks like. You come with your own approach rather than waiting for one to be handed to you. What you'll do Work with the product managers and other stakeholders in the stream. Agree priorities with them, and look for the problems worth solving instead of waiting for a request to arrive. Bring recommendations to the business, including opportunities it does not see on its own. Define the metrics for the stream: what activation means, what we expect from the funnel, how each number is counted, and how it stays consistent with the way the rest of the company counts the same things. Design the tests. Hypothesis, primary metric, audience split, duration, and how the result gets read once it lands. Automate that work, so running a test is routine and not a small project every time. Build the infrastructure for testing at scale, with external tools or our own, so a testing culture can spread across the product teams. What you bring Product analytics done end to end, with decisions that changed the roadmap behind it. Fluent in SQL, confident in Python, and solid on experimentation and causal methods/ You have chosen or built tooling for tests and metrics before. You use AI tools in your daily work, not occasionally. A partner to stakeholders rather than a person who executes tickets. Proactive, you bring the problems and the hypotheses yourself. You take an ambiguous problem, structure it, and explain your reasoning to product and business people. English at C1 or above Nice to have Product analytics built from scratch Experience where conversion volumes are low: B2B, long sales cycles, small samples. What You Will Get In Return Make a genuine impact on the product Join our upward trajectory, and grow with us. We provide the resources and opportunities for continuous personal and professional development, empowering you to make a genuine impact on our evolving product. Work in the EU Embark on this exciting journey with us and enjoy the flexibility of traveling and working remotely or in a hybrid model across Europe. Become a stock options holder Unlock your inner entrepreneur and align your aspirations with ours through our Stock Options Program. This exciting opportunity is available to every team member, from junior team members to our founders. Receive unwavering support and care Finom stands by you at every step, embodying our commitment to your well-being and success reflected in our modern, friendly, and eco-conscious corporate culture. We offer constant support and care to ensure your Finom experience is successful and fulfilling. Work & Swim program Immerse yourself in our exclusive Work & Swim Program. Spend one month in a comfortable corporate apartment in enchanting Cyprus. It's the ideal opportunity to strike the perfect work-life balance while enjoying breathtaking Mediterranean views. Equal Opportunity Statement At Finom, we're an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We embrace diversity and invite applications from all walks of life. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability status, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. title: Maintenance Supervisor
description: Activeer je potentieel en kom werken bij NORIT, wereldleider in de productie van actieve kool! Kom ons team versterken als Maintenance Supervisor in Zaandam. In deze functie ben je verantwoordelijk voor het voorbereiden, bewaken en coördineren van dagelijkse correctieve en preventieve onderhoudswerkzaamheden. Je geeft leiding aan monteurs en werkvoorbereiders en werkt nauw samen met contractors om een veilig en betrouwbaar onderhoudsproces te garanderen. Jouw belangrijkste verantwoordelijkheden zijn: Voorbereiden, bewaken en coördineren van dagelijkse correctieve en preventieve onderhoudswerkzaamheden aan mechanische, elektrische, sanitaire en instrumentatiesystemen, Leidinggeven aan het team van onderhoudsmonteurs en werkvoorbereiders, Coördineren van werkzaamheden die door leveranciers en contractors worden uitgevoerd, Adviseren over en controleren van de werkvoorbereiding, Adviseren over, controleren en waar nodig aanpassen van het jaarlijkse preventieve onderhoudsplan in het ERP-systeem, Deelnemen aan de voorbereiding en uitvoering van onderhouds- en investeringsprojecten, waaronder onderhoudsstops en plantmodificaties, Toezien op de naleving van de veiligheidsvoorschriften van NORIT door contractors, Toezicht houden op de dagelijkse werkzaamheden van monteurs, leveranciers en contractors. Requirements Een afgeronde technische opleiding op mbo- of hbo-niveau, Meer dan 10 jaar relevante maintenance-ervaring binnen een chemische of petrochemische productieomgeving, Aantoonbare ervaring in een leidinggevende maintenancefunctie, Goed in staat om prioriteiten te stellen en het overzicht te bewaren, Uitstekende communicatieve vaardigheden op zowel productie- als managementniveau, Een praktische, hands-on instelling en sterk probleemoplossend vermogen, Stressbestendig en in staat om effectief te handelen in een dynamische productieomgeving. Benefits Wat bieden wij: Een bruto jaarsalaris van €60.000 tot €80.000, inclusief vakantiegeld en een 13e maand, afhankelijk van jouw kennis en ervaring, Een verantwoordelijke leidinggevende functie binnen een technische productieomgeving, De mogelijkheid om direct bij te dragen aan de veiligheid en betrouwbaarheid van onze productie-installaties, Samenwerking met ervaren collega’s, leveranciers en contractors, Een werkomgeving waarin veiligheid, eigenaarschap en continue verbetering centraal staan. Over NORIT NORIT heeft een geschiedenis van 100 jaar in het innoveren en ontwikkelen van actieve kool voor diverse toepassingen. Wij helpen bedrijven, gemeenten en eindgebruikers te genieten van schonere en veiligere productie. Een divers aanbod van onze producten zuivert, ontkleurt of dient als katalysator in industriële processen. NORIT Activated Carbon is er trots op een toonaangevende wereldwijde leverancier van actieve kooloplossingen te zijn, maar onze ambitie eindigt hier niet. Wij streven ernaar om onze aanwezigheid in verschillende landen te vergroten en te versterken. In Nederland heeft NORIT twee productiefaciliteiten in Zaandam en Klazienaveen en één bedrijfs- en R&D-centrum in Amersfoort. Hier produceren we actieve kool van verschillende kwaliteiten voor farmaceutische, cosmetische, voedsel-, gas-, vloeistof- en andere toepassingen. We delen een reeks waarden die ons verenigen, zoals veiligheid en focus op mensen, passie voor innovatie en gerichte groei, evenals continue verbetering. Wij werken als één team van collega’s en gedragen ons alsof wij de eigenaren van het bedrijf zijn. Wij heten mensen die deze waarden delen van harte welkom om zich bij ons bedrijf aan te sluiten en NORIT te helpen versterken als een geavanceerde wereldspeler Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

description: About Us Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected. The Role We are looking for a Senior Design Release Manager to join our Airframe Team in Lausanne. In this role, you will bridge the gap between initial mechanical concept and full-scale manufacturing, taking complete ownership of the manufacturing dossier for our composite structures and airframe modules. From day one, you will drive Design for Manufacturability and Design for Assembly directly inside the design loop, before parts are frozen. You will set and hold the release standard, define geometric dimensioning and tolerancing, manage engineering change orders, and act as the single authority signing off on product transfer gates to manufacturing. What You Will Do Manufacturing Dossier Ownership: Own and maintain the complete transfer package for your designated airframe module, including controlled drawing packages, bill of materials structures, material and finish specifications, critical characteristics, and acceptance criteria. Design Loop Integration: Collaborate directly with mechanical design engineers early in the design phase to optimize composite layups, bonded joints, tooling interfaces, and tolerance stack-ups while design changes are still fast and low cost. Transfer Gate & Release Authority: Serve as the final authority on product release packages, evaluating transfer readiness against gate standards before handing hardware over to manufacturing operations. Disposition & Configuration Management: Manage engineering change orders and serve as the single technical contact for drawing dispositions, non-conformance reviews, and design clarification requests from the production line. Supplier & Manufacturing Alignment: Work closely with production operations and external suppliers to evaluate manufacturing constraints for composite structures and precision assemblies. Feedback & Continuous Improvement: Analyze initial production build data and floor feedback to refine manufacturing dossiers and update gate standards for future design iterations. What We Are Looking For Background: B.Sc . or M.Sc . in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Materials Science, or a related technical discipline. Composite Structures & Manufacturing: Strong working knowledge of composite materials, layup sequences, tooling limitations, cure cycles, and bonded structural joints. Drawing & Package Control: Proven experience owning released drawing packages, managing structured bill of materials, and running engineering change order workflows. Early Stage Execution: Demonstrated success integrating manufacturing and assembly principles directly into active design reviews rather than conducting post-design audits. Language Skills: Professional proficiency in both English and French to work fluidly across design engineering and French-speaking production teams. What We Offer Direct ownership in defining the release and manufacturing transfer standards for high-performance defense airframes. Active collaboration with design engineers early in the development cycle where engineering decisions carry high leverage. High-visibility technical impact across fast-scaling, hardware-centric production programs. We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI. title: Characterization Lead
description: At Kandou , we are redeﬁning the economics of AI infrastructure. Our mission is to democratise AI by signiﬁcantly reducing the Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) of hardware systems — a critical barrier to scalable adoption. Our proprietary MIMO-over-copper technology powers a high-performance, chiplet-based AI memory fabric that is both scalable and energy-efficient . Unlike traditional interconnects, our solution reduces power consumption signiﬁcantly while preserving high bandwidth and ultra-low latency — unlocking unprecedented efficiency for AI training and inference at scale. As Characterization Lead, you will own performance characterization of Zinal retimer silicon and the Randa Active Electrical Cable (AEC) channel. This is a Principal / Senior Staff individual contributor role with hands-on technical leadership. Your measurements will establish datasheet limits, channel classes and guard-bands for validation, manufacturing and customer specifications. Based primarily in Lausanne, you will work with silicon, signal integrity and validation teams, including channel characterization partners in Taiwan. Responsabilities · Lead silicon and channel characterization from measurement planning and bench setup through analysis, limit derivation and documented hand-off to validation. · Characterize TX/RX SerDes performance across process, voltage and temperature: swing, jitter, sensitivity, equalization, adaptation, CDR lock, BER bathtubs and shmoos. · Own channel measurements to at least 50 GHz, including de-embedding, insertion/return loss, mixed-mode S-parameters and common-mode and mode-conversion behavior. · Establish reference-paddle baselines and channel classes by gauge, reach and frequency; correlate HTDR-derived metrics with calibrated VNA measurements. · Derive datasheet limits and guard-bands from measured distributions, accounting for uncertainty, sample coverage and aging; maintain traceable datasets and limit revisions. · Assess carrier-loading and forwarded-clock tradeoffs using measured channel data and simulation, and translate the findings into supported configurations and characterization limits. · Characterize power, energy per bit and thermal behavior across operating modes and corners; investigate equalizer noise amplification and channel/thermal interactions. · Coordinate shared laboratory equipment and characterization milestones with validation teams; lead technical reviews and deliver limits in time for downstream qualification and screening. Essential Experience · 10 to 14 years of experience in SerDes/silicon characterization and/or high-speed channel and signal integrity characterization following degree completion. · Direct ownership of a characterization program whose results became datasheet limits or qualification thresholds for a shipping product. · Strong VNA measurement experience to 50 GHz or beyond, including de-embedding, mixed-mode S-parameters (Sdd/Scc/Scd/Sdc) and insertion/return-loss mask interpretation. · Hands-on TX/RX SerDes characterization, jitter decomposition, BER bathtubs, PVT shmoos and equalization/adaptation analysis. · Demonstrated common-mode and mode-conversion measurement depth, with the ability to distinguish channel behavior from fixture and calibration artifacts. · Statistical characterization and guard-band derivation across corners, with clear treatment of measurement uncertainty, sample size and aging. · Experience with VNAs, oscilloscopes of at least 50 GHz bandwidth, BERTs, jitter instrumentation, thermal forcing and ATE characterization load boards. · BS in Electrical Engineering or equivalent, with the technical communication and coordination skills to hand off defensible limits to validation and manufacturing teams. Essential Experience · Characterization leadership for shipping 100G/lane or 200G/lane retimers, PHYs, AECs or AOCs. · Deep mixed-mode characterization where common-mode behavior affects information transport and link margin. · Experience producing datasheet limits that a separate validation team independently qualified. · Multi-carrier or proprietary coding schemes, including OFDM-style subcarriers and space-time coding, and their characterization implications. · Published work or patents in channel modeling, de-embedding or SerDes characterization. · MS or PhD with a concentration in communications, RF/microwave engineering or signal integrity. description: The AI orchestration of your wildest imagination. n8n is the open workflow orchestration platform built for the new era of AI. We give technical teams the freedom of code with the speed of no-code, so they can automate faster, smarter, and without limits. Backed by a fiercely inventive community and 500+ builder-approved integrations, we’re changing the way people bring systems together and scale ideas for impact. Since our founding in 2019, we’ve grown into a diverse team of over 260 - working across Europe and the US, connected by a shared builder spirit and with our centre of gravity in Berlin. Along the way, we’ve: Cultivated a community of more than 650,000 active developers and builders Earned 190K+ GitHub stars, making us one of the world’s Top 40 most popular projects Backed by top investors, from Sequoia’s first German seed to our SAP's recent strategic investment - bringing us to a $5.2bn valuation That’s the company we’ve built. Now we’d love to see what you can build. If you’re applying, try n8n out - whether you’re technical or not - and share a screenshot of your first workflow with us. The easiest place to start is here: app.n8n.cloud/register . We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us. 🎯 Your main goal will be to turn n8n's pricing and packaging into a deliberate, data-informed growth lever - one that scales revenue and adoption across our entire go-to-market, from our 1.5 million-strong community to global Enterprise accounts. To do so, here's what you'll own: BUILD THE ANALYTICAL FOUNDATION FOR PRICING Build and own the model connecting unit economics, agent run cost, willingness-to-pay, gross margin, and customer value. Maintain competitive and market intelligence so our pricing keeps pace with a category that's shifting fast. Run pricing experiments and turn the results into documented, reusable learnings. DESIGN OUR PRICING & PACKAGING ARCHITECTURE Shape plan design and packaging across our community, self-serve, and Enterprise tiers, plus add-ons like our startup and charity plans. Design pricing for new SKUs and consumption-based models as our product and cost-to-serve evolve around AI Assistant and n8n Connect. Build packaging frameworks and decision tools that product teams use directly to launch new features. DRIVE AND ROLL OUT PRICING DECISIONS Lead cross-functional pricing decision-making and secure buy-in across Product, Sales, Marketing, Finance, RevOps, and Data. Own the rollout of major pricing changes end-to-end, from decision to launch to measured impact. Build and own our pricing frameworks: list pricing, discount guardrails, decision rubrics, grandfathering rules, and usage-based billing decisions. Requirements Must-have 📈 Pricing leadership in B2B SaaS : You have 6+ years in pricing, monetisation, or commercial strategy, including at least one full cycle leading a major pricing model transition — subscription to consumption, seat-based to usage-based, or a platform repricing. ⚡ Hands-on with modern pricing models : You've personally designed and rolled out consumption-based, outcome-based, or AI-native pricing at a company past $100M ARR. 🔀 Both self-serve and Enterprise motions : You've owned pricing on both sides of the funnel — self-serve/PLG (activation, conversion, tier design, funnel experimentation) and Enterprise, sales-led (packaging for large accounts, deal economics, discount governance). n8n monetises both, so fluency in one motion only isn't enough. 🧮 Deep analytical rigour : You build the financial model yourself and reason fluently about unit economics, cost-to-serve, gross margin, willingness-to-pay, and elasticity. 🔌 Billing fluency, technical and operational : You understand event metering, rating, entitlements, proration, overage, and revenue recognition well enough to design pricing that's actually operable — and you've partnered with a Billing function on invoicing, dunning, true-ups, and disputes. 🛠️ Empathy for technical users and buyers : You understand where, how, and why developers and technical buyers assign value across a product experience. 🧩 Frameworks over bottlenecks : You've built packaging frameworks and decision tools that product teams use independently, rather than routing every pricing decision through you. 🤝 Cross-functional influence : You bring Product, Finance, Sales, Customer Success, Engineering, and Billing into alignment on contentious commercial decisions. 🧭 Motivated by scope, not headcount : You're energised by owning a global, high-stakes topic as an individual contributor, with analytical support from Data and RevOps and rollout support from Program Management. Nice-to-have 🎓 Formal pricing training : You've been trained at Simon-Kucher or the pricing practice of another consultancy, and you bring that rigour with you. 🧑‍💻 Developer tools experience : You've priced products sold to engineers and technical teams. 🌍 Open source or freemium background : You know how to design pricing that converts a free community into paying customers without breaking trust. Why join us? At n8n, pricing won't be an afterthought argued about in the margins of someone else's roadmap - it'll be your function to build. You'll be our first dedicated pricing hire, which means low-hanging fruit everywhere and real scope to shape how a $5.2bn company monetises across community, self-serve, and Enterprise, in 100+ countries and across both cloud and self-hosted. You'll work directly with leaders in Product, Sales, Finance, and RevOps, and you'll see your decisions land in our ARR in months, not years. You'll join a supportive, remote-first team that values autonomy, experimentation, and continuous learning. Sound like a challenge you're excited to take on? Apply now - and help us build the future of automation. n8n is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We can sponsor visas to Germany; for any other country, you need to have existing right to work. Our company language is English. You care about diversity and inclusion? We do too! Check out our Diversity, Inclusion and Belonging initiatives at n8n ( https://www.notion.so/n8n/Diversity-inclusion-and-belonging-n8n-c1bec2fff536422d868b1a438d990e35 ). Location disclaimer: If you see multiple job postings for the same role, it is most likely because we're hiring remotely for this role and posting in different locations to make sure every potential candidate can see the role. Please apply to the location you're the most likely to work from in the future. Benefits Competitive compensation 💸 – We offer fair and attractive pay. Ownership 💪 – Our core value is to “empower others,” and we mean it—you’ll get a slice of n8n with equity. Work/life balance 🏖️ – We work hard but ensure you have time to recharge: Europe: 30 days of vacation, plus public holidays wherever you are. US: 20 vacation days, 8 sick days, plus public holidays wherever you are. Health & wellness 🩺 – Europe: We provide benefits according to local country norms.* US : Multiple low-premium, low-deductible medical plans with coverage for individuals and families—plus a no-cost premium HDHP option with a pre-seeded HSA—along with dental and vision coverage. Future planning 💰 – Europe: We provide pension contributions according to local country norms.* US: 401(k) retirement plan with a 4% employer match. Financial security 🛡️ – Europe: We provide benefits according to local country norms.* US: Company-paid short-term and long-term disability insurance, plus life insurance to support you and your loved ones. Career growth 📈 – We hire rising stars who grow with us! You’ll get €1K (or equivalent) per year to spend on courses, books, events, or coaching to level up your skills. A passionate team 🤩 – We love our product, and we prove it with regular hackathons where we see who can build the coolest thing with it! Remote-first 🌏 – Our team works remotely across Europe, with regular off-sites for team bonding. Some roles, like sales in the US, are hybrid—please check the job description. Giving back 🤝 – We're big fans of open source, and you'll get $100 per month to support projects you care about. Transparency 🙏 – We all know what everyone’s working on, how the company is doing—the whole shebang. * Country-specific details are provided in your contract. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Commercial Director - Bern (m/f/d)
description: Intro Willkommen bei Sanoptis – einem führenden Netzwerk moderner Augenkliniken und augenärztlicher Praxen mit über 580 Standorten in ganz Europa. Unsere Vision ist es, Wohlbefinden und Lebensqualität durch erstklassige augenärztliche Behandlung zu verbessern. Unser innovatives, dezentrales Modell ermöglicht es unseren Partnerstandorten, unabhängig zu operieren und sich auf die individuellen Bedürfnisse ihrer Patienten zu konzentrieren.
